races.name: Svirfneblin

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin are fast and observant but relatively weak and emotionally distant. They gain -2 Strength, +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, and -4 Charisma.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin are humanoids with the gnome subtype.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin are Small creatures and thus gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty to their CMB and CMD, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

effects.sourceText: +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty to their CMB and CMD, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

standardTraits.name: Speed
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin have a base speed of 20 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin begin play speaking Gnome and Undercommon. Those with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aklo, Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Goblin, Orc, and Terran. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Defensive Training
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin gain a +2 dodge bonus to Armor Class.

effects.sourceText: +2 dodge bonus to Armor Class.

standardTraits.name: Fortunate
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin gain a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on all saving throws.

standardTraits.name: Spell Resistance
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin have spell resistance (SR) equal to 11 + their class levels.

standardTraits.name: Skills
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin gain a +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks; this improves to a +4 bonus underground. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks and Perception checks.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks;
+2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks and Perception checks.

standardTraits.name: Stonecunning
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin gain stonecunning (as dwarves.)

standardTraits.name: Svirfneblin Magic
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin add +1 to the DC of any illusion spells they cast. Svirfneblin also gain the following spell-like abilities: Constant-nondetection; 1/day-blindness/deafness (DC 12 + Charisma modifier), blur, disguise self; caster level equals the svirfneblin's class levels.

standardTraits.name: Hatred
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin receive a +1 bonus on attack rolls against humanoid creatures of the reptilian and dwarf subtypes due to training against these hated foes.

effects.appliesWhen: against humanoid creatures of the reptilian and dwarf subtypes due to training against these hated foes
effects.sourceText: +1 bonus on attack rolls against humanoid creatures of the reptilian and dwarf subtypes due to training against these hated foes.

standardTraits.name: Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin can see perfectly in the dark up to 120 feet.

standardTraits.name: Low-Light Vision
standardTraits.description: In addition to their ability to see perfectly in the dark up to 60 ft, svirfneblin have low-light vision, allowing them to see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

alternateTraits.name: Healthy
alternateTraits.description: Svirfneblin gain a +4 bonus on Fortitude saves against disease and poison, including magical diseases. This racial trait replaces fortunate.

effects.appliesWhen: against disease and poison, including magical diseases
effects.sourceText: +4 bonus on Fortitude saves against disease and poison, including magical diseases.

alternateTraits.name: Stalwart Watcher
alternateTraits.description: Some svirfneblin seek to thwart the schemes of evil fey. Those who still keep to this mission gain a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against fey creatures and a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects. This racial trait replaces hatred and skilled.

effects.appliesWhen: against fey creatures and a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects
effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against fey creatures and a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects.

alternateTraits.name: Stoneseer
alternateTraits.description: Svirfneblin add +1 to the caster level of any spells with the earth descriptor they cast. Svirfneblin also gain the following spell-like abilities: Constant-nondetection; 1/day-magic stone, stone shape, stone tell; caster level equals the svirfneblin's class levels. This racial trait replaces Svirfneblin magic.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add one extract formula from the alchemist's list to the alchemist's formula book. This formula must be at least one level below the highest formula level the alchemist can create.
Add one spell known from the oracle spell list. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level the oracle can cast.

Add DR 1/magic to the ranger's animal companion. Each additional time the ranger selects this benefit, the DR/magic increases +1/2 (maximum DR 10/magic). If the ranger ever replaces his animal companion, the new companion gains this DR.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: Drow are nimble and manipulative. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, and -2 Constitution.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Drow are humanoids with the elf subtype.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Drow are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Drow have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Weapon Familiarity
standardTraits.description: Drow are proficient with the hand crossbow, rapier, and shortsword.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Drow begin play speaking Elven and Undercommon. Drow with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Abyssal, Aklo, Aquan, Common, Draconic, Drow Sign Language, Gnome, or Goblin. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Immunities
standardTraits.description: Drow are immune to magic sleep effects and gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells and effects.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells and effects.

standardTraits.name: Spell Resistance
standardTraits.description: Drow possess spell resistance (SR) equal to 6 plus their total number of class levels.

standardTraits.name: Keen Senses
standardTraits.description: - Drow gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

standardTraits.name: Spell-Like Abilities (Su)
standardTraits.description: Drow can cast dancing lights, darkness, and faerie fire, once each per day, using their total character level as caster level.

standardTraits.name: Poison Use
standardTraits.description: Drow are skilled in the use of poisons and never risk accidentally poisoning themselves.

standardTraits.name: Superior Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Drow have superior darkvision, allowing them to see perfectly in the dark up to 120 feet.

standardTraits.name: Light Blindness
standardTraits.description: As deep underground dwellers naturally, drow suffer from light blindness. Abrupt exposure to any bright light blinds drow for 1 round. On subsequent rounds, they are dazzled as long as they remain in the affected area.

alternateTraits.name: Ambitious Schemer
alternateTraits.description: Seduction and treachery are tools for advancement in drow society, even for the martially inclined. Drow with this racial trait may choose either Bluff or Diplomacy as a class skill, and gain a +2 bonus on such skill checks. This racial trait replaces keen senses.

effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on such skill checks.

alternateTraits.name: Ancestral Grudge
alternateTraits.description: The enmity between the drow and elves and dwarves is long-standing and deeply entrenched. Drow with this racial trait gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls against humanoids with the dwarf or elf subtypes (with the exception of drow) because of their special training against these reviled foes. This racial trait replaces poison use.

effects.appliesWhen: against humanoids with the dwarf or elf subtypes (with the exception of drow) because of their special training against these reviled foes
effects.sourceText: +1 bonus on attack rolls against humanoids with the dwarf or elf subtypes (with the exception of drow) because of their special training against these reviled foes.

alternateTraits.name: Blasphemous Covenant
alternateTraits.description: Since their twisted beginnings, the drow have consorted with demons. Some drow have strong ties with these creatures and may call upon ancient and obscene associations to sway demonic cooperation. Drow with this racial trait gain a +2 bonus on Diplomacy checks made against unbound creatures with the demon subtype. Furthermore, demons conjured with any summon spell gain +2 hit points per Hit Die. Lastly, the cost of bribes or offerings for any planar ally spell cast by these drow to summon a demon is reduced by 20%. This racial trait replaces keen senses and poison use.

effects.appliesWhen: against unbound creatures with the demon subtype
effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on Diplomacy checks made against unbound creatures with the demon subtype.

alternateTraits.name: Champion of Dark Powers
alternateTraits.description: Some drow offer themselves to dark patrons, particularly demon lords. Drow with this racial trait apply their spell resistance only against spells with the good or healing descriptor or against spells cast by a divine spellcaster who worships a good-aligned deity. Anytime a drow with this racial trait casts a spell with the evil descriptor, the DC to resist the spell's effects increases by 2. This modifies the spell resistance racial trait.

alternateTraits.name: Defensive Training
alternateTraits.description: Many drow cities are frequently beset by attacks from aberrations, prompting the residents train themselves to defend against them. Drow gain a +4 dodge bonus to AC against aberrations. This racial trait replaces drow immunities, keen senses, and poison use.

effects.sourceText: +4 dodge bonus to AC against aberrations.

alternateTraits.name: Poison Minion (4 RP)
alternateTraits.description: Drow sometimes augment their slaves and frontline warriors by making them toxic, causing their bodies to internally produce mawbane poison (see below). The resulting poisonous creature makes a potent weapon in the effort to discourage neighboring monsters. Any creature that hits such a character with a bite attack is immediately exposed to its poison. The save DC for this poison is equal to 10 + 1/2 the character's Hit Dice + the character's Constitution modifier. Mawbane Poison-ingested; save Fortitude as above; frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect 1d2 Constitution damage; cure 1 save. Drow can take this trait in place of drow immunities, light blindness, spell resistance, and weapon familiarity.

alternateTraits.name: Seducer
alternateTraits.description: Certain drow possess an innate understanding of the darkest desires that lurk in every heart. Drow with this racial trait add +1 to the saving throw DCs for spells and spell-like abilities of the enchantment school. In addition, drow with a Wisdom score of 15 or higher may use charm person once per day as a spell-like ability (caster level equal to the drow's character level). This racial trait replaces drow immunities.

alternateTraits.name: Stalker
alternateTraits.description: The lands outside of drow cities, from rough-hewn tunnels to rocky caverns, are treacherous to navigate. Drow with this racial trait may move through difficult terrain without penalty while underground. In addition, drow with a Dexterity of 13 or higher gain Nimble Moves as a bonus feat. This racial trait replaces the spell-like abilities racial trait.

alternateTraits.name: Sure Step (2 RP)
alternateTraits.description: Adventurers can spend their whole careers in the alleys and sewers of large cities or the tunnels of the Underworld. Characters with this trait suffer no movement penalties when blinded or moving in darkness. Drow can take this trait in place of keen senses.

alternateTraits.name: Surface Infiltrator
alternateTraits.description: Some drow dwell close to the surface lands, either because they serve drow causes or they were exiled. Drow with this racial trait gain low-light vision, allowing them to see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light. This racial trait replaces the darkvision and light blindness racial traits.

alternateTraits.name: Underworld Guide (2 RP)
alternateTraits.description: Those who brave the lightless tunnels below the world's surface learn to identify the dangerous phenomena that characterize the Underworld. Characters with this trait gain a +2 bonus on initiative checks, and on saves against traps and hazards when underground (from a lifetime of dodging accursed pools, cave-ins, and green slime). Drow can take this trait in place of keen senses.

effects.appliesWhen: against traps and hazards when underground (from a lifetime of dodging accursed pools, cave-ins, and green slime)
effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on initiative checks, and on saves against traps and hazards when underground (from a lifetime of dodging accursed pools, cave-ins, and green slime).

alternateTraits.name: Voice in the Darkness (2 RP)
alternateTraits.description: Prerequisite(s): Charisma 13+. Characters who practice coercion and intimidation in the Underworld or on the Shadow Plane learn to do so in dim light or no light at all. As long as they are in dim light or darker conditions, characters with this trait gain a +2 bonus on Intimidate and Stealth checks. Drow can take this trait in place of weapon familiarity.

effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on Intimidate and Stealth checks.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add +10 minutes to the duration of the alchemist's mutagens.
The antipaladin adds +1/4 to the number of cruelties he can inflict.

Select one domain power granted at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + the cleric's Wisdom modifier. The cleric adds +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that domain power.
Choose the disarm or reposition combat maneuver. Add +1/3 to the Fighter's CMB when attempting this maneuver (maximum bonus of +4).
Add a +1/2 bonus on Bluff checks to feint and pass secret messages.
Add one spell known from the sorcerer spell list. This spell must have the curse, evil, or pain descriptor, and be at least one level below the highest spell level the sorcerer can cast.

Select one arcane school power at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + the wizard's Intelligence modifier. The wizard adds +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that arcane school power.

standardTraits.description: Grabbing appendages (6 RP) Trox have a small group of appendages that are useful for little more than to aid in grappling. They gain Improved Grapple as a bonus feat, and can maintain a grapple and still make attacks with their main appendages.

alternateTraits.name: Tremorsense
alternateTraits.description: Some trox have developed a closeness to the earth that helps them thwart the invisibility of their duergar enemies. They gain tremorsense to a range of 30 feet. This racial trait replaces frenzy and burrow.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Aquatic elves are nimble, both in body and mind, but their form is frail. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, and -2 Constitution.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Aquatic elves are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Aquatic elves are Humanoids with the elf and aquatic subtypes. Creatures with the aquatic subtype can move in water without making Swim checks. Aquatic creatures always treat Swim as a class skill.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Aquatic elves have a base speed of 30 feet and a swim speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Aquatic elves begin play speaking Common and Elven. Elves with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Celestial, Draconic, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, and Sylvan. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Elven Immunities
standardTraits.description: Aquatic elves are immune to magic sleep effects and gain a +2 racial saving throw bonus against enchantment spells and effects.

standardTraits.name: Keen Senses
standardTraits.description: Aquatic elves receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

standardTraits.name: Elven Magic
standardTraits.description: Aquatic elves receive a +2 racial bonus on caster level checks made to overcome spell resistance. In addition, elves receive a +2 racial bonus on Spellcraft skill checks made to identify the properties of magic items.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Spellcraft skill checks made to identify the properties of magic items.

standardTraits.name: Weapon Familiarity
standardTraits.description: Aquatic elves are proficient with rapiers, short swords, tridents, and treat any weapon with the word "elven" in its name as a martial weapon.

standardTraits.name: Low-Light Vision
standardTraits.description: Aquatic elves can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

alternateTraits.name: Deep Sea Dweller
alternateTraits.description: Aquatic elves who live far beneath the surface have adapted to the inhospitable conditions of the ocean depths. Aquatic elves with this racial trait gain darkvision with a range of 60 feet and cold resistance 5. This racial trait replaces low-light vision and elven immunities.

effects.sourceText: cold resistance 5

alternateTraits.name: Surface Features
alternateTraits.description: Some aquatic elves appear almost indistinguishable from surface elves. Their coloring, height, and weight all suggest those of a surface elf, and the webbing between their digits is almost transparent. Aquatic elves with this racial trait gain a +4 bonus on Bluff and Disguise checks when attempting to pass themselves off as surface elves. This racial trait replaces keen senses.

effects.appliesWhen: when attempting to pass themselves off as surface elves
effects.sourceText: +4 bonus on Bluff and Disguise checks when attempting to pass themselves off as surface elves.

alternateTraits.name: Surfacer Antagonist
alternateTraits.description: Aquatic elves generally distrust humans, but for some, the suspicion has become festering hatred. Those who have lost loved ones to human aggression or have watched humans loot artifacts from venerated undersea ruins view all humans as enemies. Aquatic elves with this racial trait receive a +1 bonus on attack rolls against humans. This racial trait replaces elven magic.

effects.sourceText: +1 bonus on attack rolls against humans.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add 1/4 to the arcanist's caster level when casting spells with the water descriptor.
Add 1 skill rank to the cavalier's mount. If the cavalier ever replaces his mount, the new mount gains these bonus skill ranks.

Add 1 hit point to the druid's animal companion. If the druid ever replaces her animal companion, the new animal companion gains these bonus hit points. For a druid whose nature bond gives her a cleric domain, select one cleric domain power at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + the druid's Wisdom modifier. The druid adds 1/2 to the number of uses per day of that domain power.

Choose a weapon from the following list: rapier, short sword, trident, or any weapon with "elven" in its name. Gain a +1/2 bonus on critical hit confirmation rolls made while using that type of weapon (maximum bonus +4). This bonus does not stack with those gained through Critical Focus and similar effects.

Add one spell from the cleric, druid, or wizard spell list with the water descriptor to the magus's spellbook. This spell must be at least 1 level below the highest spell level he can cast. This spell is treated as 1 level higher unless it also appears on the magus spell list.
Choose a weapon from the following list: longbow, shortbow, or any weapon with "elven" in its name. Reduce the penalty on ranged attack rolls underwater made with this weapon by 1.
As long as the summoner's eidolon has a swim speed, add 5 feet to its swim speed (max +20 feet).
When casting a witch spell underwater, add 1/3 to the effective caster level of the spell for the purpose of determining the spell's duration.
Add 1 to the wizard's caster level check when attempting to cast a spell with the fire descriptor underwater.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Astomoi ever pursue enlightenment through self-denial and are psychically attuned to their surroundings, but their delicate bodies are more susceptible to the physical dangers of the world. They gain +2 Intelligence and +2 Wisdom but suffer -2 Constitution.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Astomoi are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Speed
standardTraits.description: Astomoi have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Astomoi begin play knowing Common, but as they have no mouths, they cannot speak. They have telepathy with a range of 100 feet. Astomoi with high Intelligence scores can choose any of the following languages: Abyssal, Aklo, Celestial, Elven, Gnome, Infernal, and Sylvan. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Scent
standardTraits.description: Astomoi have the scent special ability.

standardTraits.name: Telepathic Senses
standardTraits.description: Astomoi can't speak or see, but can mentally sense the area within 60 feet, as per darkvision, and can speak telepathically. An astomoi can't see anything beyond 60 feet. An astomoi must provide thought components for spells that normally require verbal components. It can use language-dependent abilities with its telepathy, but not abilities that depend on audible components.

standardTraits.name: Sensitive Breath
standardTraits.description: Astomoi take a -2 penalty on saving throws against disease and inhaled poisons.

standardTraits.name: Mouthless
standardTraits.description: Astomoi don't need to eat or drink to survive. Instead, they absorb the essence of food and drink; this consumes the nutrients of the meal as though it had been eaten, rendering the food useless to others. Astomoi consume potions and other ingested materials in the same fashion. Since they never actually ingest anything, they can't normally be exposed to ingested poisons.

standardTraits.description: Changelings are frail, but are clever and comely. They gain +2 Wisdom, +2 Charisma, -2 Constitution.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Changelings are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Changelings are humanoids with the changeling subtype.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Changelings have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Changelings begin play speaking Common and the primary language of their host society. Changelings with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aklo, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Gnoll, Goblin, and Orc.

standardTraits.name: Natural Armor
standardTraits.description: Changelings have a +1 natural armor bonus.

standardTraits.name: Claws
standardTraits.description: Changelings' fingernails are hard and sharp, granting them two claw attacks (1d4 points of damage each).

standardTraits.name: Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Changelings see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

standardTraits.name: Hulking Changeling
standardTraits.description: (Annis Hag): The changeling gains a +1 racial bonus on melee damage.

standardTraits.name: Pyrophile
standardTraits.description: (Ash Hag): The changeling gains a +1 racial bonus on damage rolls when using spells with the fire descriptor. This bonus increases by 1 for every 4 levels the changeling has beyond 1st.

effects.appliesWhen: when using spells with the fire descriptor
effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus on damage rolls when using spells with the fire descriptor.

standardTraits.name: Green Widow
standardTraits.description: (Green Hag): The changeling gains a +2 racial bonus on Bluff checks against creatures that are sexually attracted to her.

effects.appliesWhen: against creatures that are sexually attracted to her
effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Bluff checks against creatures that are sexually attracted to her.

standardTraits.name: Sea Lungs
standardTraits.description: (Sea Hag): The changeling may hold her breath for a number of rounds equal to three times her Constitution before she risks drowning.

standardTraits.name: Gaze Blindness
standardTraits.description: (Mute Hag): The changeling gains a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against gaze attacks.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against gaze attacks.

standardTraits.name: Heartstone Heritor
standardTraits.description: (Night Hag): The changeling gains a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against disease.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against disease.

standardTraits.name: Ice Climber
standardTraits.description: (Winter Hag): The changeling gains a +5 racial bonus on Climb checks on icy or slippery surfaces.

effects.sourceText: +5 racial bonus on Climb checks on icy or slippery surfaces.

standardTraits.name: Inscrutable
standardTraits.description: (Blood Hag): The Sense Motive check DC to gain a hunch about the changeling increases by 5.

standardTraits.name: Wind Breaker
standardTraits.description: (Storm Hag): The changeling is treated as two size categories larger for the purpose of resolving wind effects.

alternateTraits.name: Hag Magic
alternateTraits.description: Some changelings develop a gift for spellcasting instead of their mothers' overtly fearsome traits. A changeling with this trait displays one or more stark white streaks in her hair as a child. The DCs of any saving throws against enchantment spells she casts increase by 1, and if her Charisma score is 11 or higher, she also gains the following spell-like abilities, usable once per day each: dancing lights, detect magic, disguise self, and pass without trace. The caster level of these spell-like abilities is equal to the changeling's character level. The DC for these spell-like abilities is equal to 10 + the spell's level + the changeling's Charisma modifier. This racial trait replaces the claws and natural armor racial abilities.

alternateTraits.name: Hag Magic
alternateTraits.description: Some changelings have an innate talent for magic. They can choose one 1st- or 0-level spell from the witch spell list that does not have a material component costing more than 1 gp. They can use the chosen spell as a spell-like ability once per day if it is a 1st-level spell or three times per day if it is a 0-level spell (caster level equal to the changeling's character level). This racial trait replaces natural armor.

alternateTraits.name: Mist Child
alternateTraits.description: When the changeling has concealment or total concealment, the miss chance of attacks against her increases by 5%. This racial trait replaces hulking changeling.

alternateTraits.name: Object of Desire
alternateTraits.description: The changeling adds +1 to her caster level when casting charm person and charm monster. This replaces green widow.

alternateTraits.name: Ocean's Daughter
alternateTraits.description: The changeling gains a +1 trait bonus on Swim checks. She automatically succeeds at Swim checks made to avoid nonlethal damage from swimming. This racial trait replaces sea lungs.

effects.sourceText: +1 trait bonus on Swim checks.

alternateTraits.name: Witchborn
alternateTraits.description: Most changelings are talented witches. They gain a +2 bonus to Intelligence and Charisma instead of a +2 bonus to Wisdom and Charisma. This racial trait alters the changeling's racial ability score modifiers.

effects.sourceText: +2 bonus to Intelligence and Charisma instead of a +2 bonus to Wisdom and Charisma.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add +1/2 to the oracle's level for the purpose of determining the effects of the oracle's curse ability.
The rogue gains 1/6 of a new rogue talent.

Add one spell from the witch spell list to the witch's familiar. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level she can cast. If the witch ever replaces her familiar, the new familiar knows these bonus spells.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Deep one hybrids are hearty and devout, but tend to be somewhat slow and awkward in their movements. They gain +2 Constitution and +2 Wisdom but suffer -2 Dexterity.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Deep One Hybrids are Humanoids with the Human and Deep One subtypes.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Deep One Hybrids are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Speed
standardTraits.description: A deep one hybrid's base speed is 20 feet, as it walks with a shuffling gait. A deep one hybrid has a swim speed of 30 feet, and gains a +8 racial bonus on all Swim checks.

effects.sourceText: +8 racial bonus on all Swim checks.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Deep one hybrids begin play speaking Aklo and Common. Hybrids with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Abyssal, Aquan, Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Gnome, Goblin, Halfling, Orc, and Undercommon. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Natural Armor
standardTraits.description: A deep one hybrid's thick skin and dense fatty tissues grant it a +1 natural armor bonus to AC.

effects.sourceText: +1 natural armor bonus to AC.

standardTraits.name: Final Change (Su)
standardTraits.category: Misc. Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: A deep one hybrid ages at the same rate as a half-orc. A mere 1d12 months after a deep one hybrid reaches venerable age (at 60 years old), it dies a painful, agonizing death, only to have its body transform into that of a mature deep one. This transformation functions as the reincarnate spell, with the newly formed deep one gaining the following modifications to its physical ability scores: +6 Strength, -2 Dexterity, and +6 Constitution.

standardTraits.name: Sea Longing (Ex)
standardTraits.category: Misc. Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: Every 24 hours a deep one hybrid spends in an area more than 10 miles from the sea, it must succeed at a DC 20 Will save or take 1 point of Wisdom drain.

standardTraits.name: Take to the Water (Ex)
standardTraits.category: Misc. Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: A deep one hybrid can hold its breath 10 times longer than a human can, and gains a +2 bonus on Initiative checks and Reflex saving throws while swimming.

effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on Initiative checks and Reflex saving throws while swimming.

standardTraits.name: Low-Light Vision
standardTraits.category: Senses Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: A deep one hybrid can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of dim light.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Gillmen are vigorous and beautiful, but their domination by the aboleths has made them weak-willed. They gain +2 Constitution, +2 Charisma, and -2 Wisdom.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Gillmen are humanoids with the aquatic subtype.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Gillmen are Medium creatures and thus have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Gillmen have a base speed of 30 feet on land. As aquatic creatures, they also have a swim speed of 30 feet, can move in water without making Swim checks, and always treat Swim as a class skill.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Gillmen begin play speaking Common and Aboleth. Gillmen with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aklo, Aquan, Draconic, and Elven. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Enchantment Resistance
standardTraits.description: Gillmen gain a +2 racial bonus to saving throws against non-aboleth enchantment spells and effects, but take a -2 penalty on such saving throws against aboleth sources.

effects.appliesWhen: against non-aboleth enchantment spells and effects, but take a -2 penalty on such saving throws against aboleth sources
effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus to saving throws against non-aboleth enchantment spells and effects, but take a -2 penalty on such saving throws against aboleth sources.

standardTraits.name: Water Dependent
standardTraits.description: A gillman's body requires constant submersion in fresh or salt water. Gillmen who spend more than one day without fully submerging themselves in water risk internal organ failure, painful cracking of the skin, and death within 4d6 hours.

standardTraits.name: Amphibious
standardTraits.description: Gillmen can breathe both water and air.

alternateTraits.name: Deep Gillman
alternateTraits.description: Some gillmen live in the deeper ocean and almost never visit the land above the sea. Such gillmen gain darkvision to a range of 60 feet and resist cold 5, in order to survive the lightless depths. This racial trait replaces amphibious and enchantment resistance.

alternateTraits.name: Riverfolk
alternateTraits.description: Some gillmen groups live in colonies along vast riverways, and have adapted to living on land for much longer periods. Gillmen with this trait have a thin coating of natural oil that keeps their skin from cracking even without water. However, this natural oil also makes such gillmen particularly susceptible to flames, and they gain vulnerability to fire. This racial trait replaces water dependent.

alternateTraits.name: Slimehunter
alternateTraits.description: Gillmen with this trait are from lineages that have fought against aboleths since the aberrations rescued their human ancestors. They receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against aboleth spells, spell-like abilities, and supernatural abilities. This racial trait replaces enchantment resistance.

effects.appliesWhen: against aboleth spells, spell-like abilities, and supernatural abilities
effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against aboleth spells, spell-like abilities, and supernatural abilities.

alternateTraits.name: Submerged
alternateTraits.description: Gillmen who live in deep water are accustomed to the gloom of the depths. Though these gillmen can venture onto land, they are uncomfortable doing so and must return to the ocean sooner than other gillmen. Gillmen with this racial trait gain low-light vision but must submerge themselves in water every 12 hours or die within 2d4 hours. This modifies their water dependent racial trait.

alternateTraits.name: Taskmaster
alternateTraits.description: The aboleth fleshcrafters created some gillmen as overseers among their kin, allowing them to exude pheromones into the air or water. Generations later, the descendants of these taskmaster gillmen retain the ability to influence others. Gillmen with this trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy checks. This racial trait replaces enchantment resistance.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy checks.

alternateTraits.name: Throwback
alternateTraits.description: Some gillmen are throwbacks to their land-dwelling human ancestors. Gillmen with this racial trait do not have the amphibious trait, have the human subtype instead of the aquatic subtype, have no swim speed or bonuses to the Swim skill, cannot breathe water, and do not have the water dependent racial trait.

alternateTraits.name: Truthseer
alternateTraits.description: Gillmen with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against non-aboleth illusion spells or effects, but they take a -2 penalty on such saving throws against aboleth sources. This racial trait replaces enchantment resistance.

effects.appliesWhen: against non-aboleth illusion spells or effects, but they take a -2 penalty on such saving throws against aboleth sources
effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against non-aboleth illusion spells or effects, but they take a -2 penalty on such saving throws against aboleth sources.

alternateTraits.name: Venomkissed
alternateTraits.description: Some gillmen display an innate resistance to the toxic creatures of the deep. In gillman communities, venomkissed gillmen take on the dangerous task of domesticating jellyfish, octopuses, sea snakes, and other venomous creatures. Solitary venomkissed gillmen make their homes near beds of poisonous coral and anemones, using the creatures as natural defense. Gillmen with this racial trait gain a +2 racial saving throw bonus against poison. This racial trait replaces enchantment resistance.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add 1/2 to the bard's Bluff checks to fool someone and gain a +1/2 bonus on the bard's Sense Motive checks to sense enchantments.
Add +1 to the fighter's CMD when resisting two combat maneuvers of the character's choice.
Increase the total number of points in the investigator's inspiration pool by 1/3.
Increase the medium's spirit bonus by 1/6.
Add 1 foot to the monk's swim speed. In combat, this option has no effect unless the monk has selected it five times (or another increment of five).
The rogue gains 1/6 of a new rogue talent.
Add one spell known from the sorcerer spell list. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level the sorcerer can cast.
Add one spell from the wizard spell list to the wizard's spellbook. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level he can cast.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Kitsune are agile and companionable, but tend to be physically weak. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, and -2 Strength.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Kitsune are Medium creatures and thus have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Kitsune are humanoids with the kitsune and shapechanger subtypes.

standardTraits.name: Base
standardTraits.description: Speed: Kitsune have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Kitsune begin play speaking Common and Sylvan. Kitsune with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: any human language, Aklo, Celestial, Elven, Gnome, and Tengu. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Agile (Ex)
standardTraits.description: Kitsune receive a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics checks.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics checks.

standardTraits.name: Change Shape (Su)
standardTraits.description: A kitsune can assume the appearance of a specific single human form of the same sex. The kitsune always takes this specific form when she uses this ability. A kitsune in human form cannot use her bite attack, but gains a +10 racial bonus on Disguise checks made to appear human. Changing shape is a standard action. This ability otherwise functions as alter self, except that the kitsune does not adjust her ability scores and can remain in this form indefinitely.

effects.sourceText: +10 racial bonus on Disguise checks made to appear human.

standardTraits.name: Kitsune Magic (Ex/Sp)
standardTraits.description: Kitsune add +1 to the DC of any saving throws against enchantment spells that they cast. Kitsune with a Charisma score of 11 or higher gain the following spell-like ability: 3/day-dancing lights (caster level equals the kitsune's level).

standardTraits.name: Natural Weapons (Ex)
standardTraits.description: In her natural form, a kitsune has a bite attack that deals 1d4 points of damage.

standardTraits.name: Low-Light Vision
standardTraits.description: Kitsune can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

alternateTraits.name: Duplicitous
alternateTraits.description: Many kitsune prefer to avoid the attention they often attract from human neighbors and attempt to convince all around them that they are human. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Bluff and Disguise checks. This racial trait replaces kitsune magic.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Bluff and Disguise checks.

alternateTraits.name: Fast Shifter (Su)
alternateTraits.description: You were born with an innate talent for switching between your natural forms. Using your racial change shape ability is a move action instead of a standard action. This racial trait replaces kitsune magic.

alternateTraits.name: Gregarious (Ex)
alternateTraits.description: Even among your own kind, your gift for making friends stands out. Whenever you successfully use Diplomacy to win over an individual, that creature takes a -2 penalty to resist any of your Charisma-based skill checks for the next 24 hours. This racial trait replaces agile.

alternateTraits.name: Keen Kitsune
alternateTraits.description: Although amiable, kitsune are notoriously clever and cunning, often far more than they seem. Such characters gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity and Intelligence instead of Dexterity and Charisma. This racial trait alters the kitsune's ability score modifiers.

effects.sourceText: +2 bonus to Dexterity and Intelligence instead of Dexterity and Charisma.

alternateTraits.name: Multilingual
alternateTraits.description: Although most kitsune speak only Common, some quickly learn other human languages in order to give themselves an edge when dealing with humanity. They speak Common, Sylvan, and the racial language of their human form's ethnicity, and they can learn any language they want (except Druidic and other secret languages) if they have high Intelligence scores. This racial trait replaces agile as well as a kitsune's normal languages.
replaces: agile as well as a kitsune's normal languages

alternateTraits.name: Skilled
alternateTraits.description: Some kitsune focus on diversifying their skill set in order to better blend in with their human peers. They gain an additional skill rank at 1st level and one additional skill rank whenever they gain a level. This racial trait replaces agile and kitsune magic.

alternateTraits.name: Superior Shapeshifter
alternateTraits.description: Some talented kitsune take more naturally to shapeshifting than magic, and develop that gift. They gain Fox Shape as a bonus feat at 1st level, ignoring its prerequisites. This racial trait replaces kitsune magic.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Gain 1/6 of a new Magical Tail feat. Any kitsune character can choose this bonus upon gaining a level in her favored class.
When casting arcanist enchantment spells, add 1/3 to the effective caster level, but only for the purpose of determining duration.
Add a +½ bonus on Bluff checks to lie and a +½ bonus on Diplomacy checks to gather information.
Increase the number of times per day the brawler can use martial flexibility by 1/4.
Add 1/4 to the cavalier's banner bonus.
Add a +½ bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks to change a creature's attitude.
Add 1/3 to damage rolls the fighter makes with weapon attacks against an opponent that he is flanking or that is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC.
Increase the number of mesmerist tricks the mesmerist can use per day by 1/3.

Reduce the penalty for not being proficient for one weapon by 1. When the nonproficiency penalty for a weapon becomes 0 because of this ability, the oracle is treated as having the appropriate Martial or Exotic Weapon Proficiency feat for that weapon.
The rogue gains +1/6 of a new rogue talent.

Add one enchantment spell from the sorcerer/wizard spell list that isn't on the shaman spell list to the list of spells the shaman knows. This spell must be at least 1 level below the highest spell level the shaman can cast.
Add +¼ to the DC of enchantment spells.
Increase the total number of points in the swashbuckler's panache pool by 1/4.
Add 1/2 to the Disguise bonus provided by seamless guise.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Kuru are abnormally fast and hardy, but bloodlust clouds their thinking. Kura gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, and -2 Intelligence.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Kuru begin play speaking Kuru. Kuru with high Intelligence scores can choose bonus languages from the following: Abyssal, Common, Polyglot, Undercommon. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Bite Attack
standardTraits.description: Kuru possess a natural bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage.

standardTraits.name: Blood Courage (Ex)
standardTraits.description: Once per day when a kuru makes a saving throw against a fear effect, he can roll the saving throw twice and take the better result. He must decide to use this ability before the saving throw is attempted.

standardTraits.name: Cannibalistic Vitality (Ex)
standardTraits.description: When a kuru hits a living creature with its bite attack, he gains 1 temporary hit point by ingesting the target's blood. This ability does not work on creatures that do not have blood.

standardTraits.name: Low-Light Vision
standardTraits.description: Kuru can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

standardTraits.name: Light Sensitivity
standardTraits.description: Kuru are especially sensitive to bright light (kuru have light sensitivity).

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Merfolk are graceful, hale, and beautiful. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, and +2 Charisma.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Merfolk are Medium creatures and thus have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed (Slow Speed)
standardTraits.description: Merfolk have a base speed of 5 feet. They have a swim speed of 50 feet.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Merfolk are humanoids with the aquatic subtype.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Merfolk begin play speaking Common and Aquan. Merfolk with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aboleth, Aklo, Draconic, Elven, and Sylvan. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Armor
standardTraits.description: Merfolk have a +2 natural armor bonus.

standardTraits.name: Legless
standardTraits.description: Merfolk have no legs, and therefore cannot be tripped.

standardTraits.name: Low-Light Vision
standardTraits.description: Merfolk have low-light vision allowing them to see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

standardTraits.name: Amphibious
standardTraits.description: Merfolk are amphibious, but prefer not to spend long periods out of the water.

alternateTraits.name: Darkvision
alternateTraits.description: Some Merfolk favor the lightless depths over shallower waters. Merfolk with this racial trait gain darkvision with a range of 60 feet and light sensitivity. This racial trait replaces low-light vision.

alternateTraits.name: Seasinger
alternateTraits.description: The beautiful voices of the merfolk are legendary. A seasinger gains a +2 racial bonus on Perform (sing) checks and a +1 racial bonus to the save DC of language-dependent spells. This racial trait replaces low-light vision.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Perform (sing) checks and a +1 racial bonus to the save DC of language-dependent spells.

alternateTraits.name: Secret Magic
alternateTraits.description: Merfolk sometimes manifest magical powers they are unwilling to explain to non-merfolk, leading scholars to speculate that the magic originates from the merfolk's rumored eldritch patrons. Such merfolk have only a 40-foot swim speed, but they add +1 to the DC of any enchantment spells they cast, and if they have a Charisma score of 13 or higher, they gain the ability to cast the following spell-like abilities: At will-speak with animals (aquatic animals only); 1/day-fins to feet (self only), hydraulic push. This racial trait replaces the armor racial trait and alters the merfolk's movement speed.

alternateTraits.name: Strongtail
alternateTraits.description: A few merfolk have broad, strong tails that are more suited for land travel than the typical merfolk tail. Merfolk with this racial trait have a land speed of 15 feet and a swim speed of 30 feet.

alternateTraits.name: Unexpected Ally
alternateTraits.description: Merfolk with this racial trait gain a +2 bonus on Diplomacy checks to influence a creature's attitude. In addition, merfolk with this racial trait gain a +1 racial bonus on checks to perform the aid another action. This replaces low-light vision.

effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on Diplomacy checks to influence a creature's attitude.
+1 racial bonus on checks to perform the aid another action.

favoredClassBonuses.description: The bard learns 1/6 of a new bardic masterpiece. (The bard selects the masterpiece once he has made this selection six times and must meet its prerequisites when it is selected.)
Add +1 hit point to the druid's animal companion. If the merfolk ever replaces her animal companion, the new animal companion gains these bonus hit points.
The mesmerist learns 1/4 of a new trick.
Add a +1/4 bonus on combat maneuver checks to grapple or trip.
Add one spell known from the oracle spell list. This spell must be at least 1 level below the highest level spell the oracle can cast.
Add +1 hit point to the ranger's animal companion. If the ranger ever replaces his animal companion, the new animal companion gains these bonus hit points.
Add one spell from the skald's spell list to the skald's known spells. This spell must be at least 1 spell level below the highest level of spell the skald can cast.
Add +1/2 to the sorcerer's caster level when determining the range of any spells with the water descriptor.
Add 1 to the witch's caster level for one of her patron spells (to a maximum of +3 caster level to any one spell).

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Nagaji are strong and have forceful personalities, but tend to ignore logic and mock scholastic pursuits. They gain +2 Strength, +2 Charisma, and -2 Intelligence.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Nagaji are Medium creatures and thus have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Nagaji are humanoids with the reptilian subtype.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Nagaji have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Nagaji begin play speaking Common and Draconic. Nagaji with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: any human tongue, Abyssal, Aklo, Celestial, Draconic, Giant, Infernal, and Sylvan. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Armored Scales
standardTraits.category: Defense Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: Nagaji have a +1 natural armor bonus from their scaly flesh.

standardTraits.name: Resistant (Ex)
standardTraits.category: Defense Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: Nagaji receive a +2 racial saving throw bonus against mind-affecting effects and poison.

standardTraits.name: Serpent's Sense (Ex)
standardTraits.category: Feat and Skill Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: Nagaji receive a +2 racial bonus on Handle Animal checks against reptiles, and a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

effects.appliesWhen: against reptiles, and a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks
effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Handle Animal checks against reptiles, and a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

standardTraits.name: Low-Light Vision
standardTraits.category: Senses Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: Nagaji have low-light vision allowing them to see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

alternateTraits.name: Hypnotic Gaze (Sp)
alternateTraits.description: The nagaji's gaze is so intense it stops others in their tracks. Once per day, it can attempt to hypnotize a single target, as per the spell hypnotism (caster level equal to the nagaji's Hit Dice). The DC of this effect is equal to 11 + the nagaji's Charisma modifier. The effects of the hypnotic gaze only last a single round. This racial trait replaces serpent's sense.

alternateTraits.name: Serpent Affinity
alternateTraits.description: Nagaji clerics with this racial trait and the Scalykind domain use their domain powers and spells at +1 caster level. This increase is a racial bonus. This racial trait replaces resistant.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add +1 on Craft (alchemy) checks to craft poison and +1/3 on the DCs of poisons the alchemist creates.

Add 1 foot to the base speed of the cavalier's mount. This has no effect in combat unless the cavalier has selected this reward five times (or another increment of five). If the cavalier ever replaces this mount, the new mount gains this bonus to its speed.
Add +1 to the fighter's CMD when resisting a grapple or trip attempt.

Add 1/5 to the Hit-Die limit and the total number of Hit Die affected with each enchantment or illusion spell the mesmerist casts. This bonus stacks with the mesmerist's mental potency class feature and is applicable under the same conditions as that ability.
Add +1/4 point to the monk's ki pool.
Add 1/6 to the oracle's level for the purpose of determining the effects of one revelation.
Add 1/2 minute to the duration of the paladin's divine bond with her weapon.
Add 1 skill rank to the ranger's constrictor snake or viper snake animal companion.
Gain 1/6 of a new slayer talent.
Add 1/2 to the sorcerer's caster level when determining the duration of transmutation spells she casts that target the sorcerer or spells she casts with the poison descriptor.
Add +1 hit point to the summoner's eidolon.

Add 1/2 to the number of times per day the warpriest can use blessings, although he can use these additional blessings only for Charm, Magic, Nobility, Rune, or Scalykind (Pathfinder Player Companion: Advanced Class Origins 25) blessings.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Orang-pendaks are strong and intuitive, but not particularly clever. They gain +2 Strength and +2 Wisdom but suffer -2 Intelligence.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Orang-pendaks are Small creatures and gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty on combat maneuver checks and to CMD, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

effects.sourceText: +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty on combat maneuver checks and to CMD, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

standardTraits.name: Base
standardTraits.description: Speed: Orang-pendaks have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Orang-pendaks begin play speaking Sasquatch. Orang-pendaks who have high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aklo, Common, Draconic, Goblin, Grippli, Sylvan, Vanaran, and Vishkanya. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Forest Walker (Ex)
standardTraits.category: Feat and Skill Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: Orang-pendaks gain a +4 bonus on Climb and Stealth checks in forests and jungles.

effects.sourceText: +4 bonus on Climb and Stealth checks in forests and jungles.

standardTraits.name: Simian Empathy (Ex)
standardTraits.category: Feat and Skill Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: Orang-pendaks gain a +4 racial bonus on Handle Animal and wild empathy checks with apes and monkeys.

standardTraits.name: Tear Apart (Ex)
standardTraits.category: Feat and Skill Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: Orang-pendaks have powerful upper bodies and gain a +2 racial bonus on Strength checks to break or burst an object. This bonus also applies on combat maneuver checks to sunder with their unarmed attacks.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Strength checks to break or burst an object.

standardTraits.name: Low-Light Vision
standardTraits.category: Feat and Skill Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: Orang-pendaks can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

standardTraits.name: Own Two Feet (Ex)
standardTraits.category: Weakness Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: Orang-pendaks are extremely unnerved whenever they are riding another creature or on a vehicle, and they take a - 2 penalty on ability checks, attack rolls, damage rolls, saving throws, and skill checks when doing so.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Reptoids are both manipulative and strong, but they're deliberate in their movements. They gain +2 Strength and +2 Charisma but suffer -2 Dexterity.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Reptoids are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Speed
standardTraits.description: Reptoids have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: All reptoids begin play speaking Common and Reptoid. Reptoids with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want (except for secret languages, such as Druidic). See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Low-Light Vision
standardTraits.description: Reptoids can see twice as far as humans in dim light.

standardTraits.name: Scales
standardTraits.description: When in its natural form, a reptoid has a +1 natural armor bonus.

standardTraits.name: Cold-Blooded (Ex)
standardTraits.description: Reptoids receive a +2 racial saving throw bonus against mind-affecting effects and poison.

standardTraits.name: Natural Weapons (Ex)
standardTraits.description: When in its natural form, a reptoid has a bite attack and two claw attacks that deal 1d3 points of damage each.

standardTraits.name: Change Shape (Su)
standardTraits.description: A reptoid can assume the appearance of a specific single Medium humanoid. The reptoid always takes this specific form when it uses this ability. The reptoid gains a +10 racial bonus on Disguise checks to appear as that type of humanoid. This ability otherwise functions as alter self, except the reptoid does not adjust its ability scores. A reptoid can select a new humanoid form by spending 1 week preparing itself for the change, but can then no longer assume its previous humanoid form.

effects.sourceText: +10 racial bonus on Disguise checks to appear as that type of humanoid.

standardTraits.name: Mental Potency (Ex)
standardTraits.description: A reptoid's mental effects can affect more powerful creatures or a greater number of creatures than normal. Both the Hit Die limit and the total number of Hit Dice affected by each enchantment or illusion spell it casts increase by 1. For enchantment and illusion spells it casts that target a number of creatures greater than one, the number of creatures affected also increases by one (so a spell that targets one creature per level would be affected, but a spell that targets only one creature would not be). This ability stacks with the mesmerist's ability of the same name.
