Add +1/3 to the druid's natural armor bonus when using wild shape.
Add a +2 bonus on rolls to stabilize when dying.
The fighter gains 1/2 point of DR/- against nonlethal damage (maximum DR 10/-).
Add a +1/3 bonus on attack rolls when using the pistol whip deed.
Add 1 hit point to the hunter's animal companion. If the hunter replaces his animal companion, the new animal companion gains these bonus hit points.
Add a +1/2 bonus on Intimidate checks and Knowledge checks to identify creatures.
Gain a +1/3 bonus on critical hit confirmation rolls made while using studied combat (maximum bonus of +5). This bonus does not stack with those gained through Critical Focus and similar effects.
[see errata at right] Add 1/3 point of fire damage to fire-element blasts that deal fire damage.
Add +1/2 point of fire damage to spells that deal fire damage cast by the magus.
When gaining a taboo, the medium can use spirit surge without incurring influence an additional 1/4 time per day.
Increase the mesmerist's bonus damage from painful stare by 1/2 point.
Add +1 to the monk's CMD when resisting a grapple and +1/2 to the number of stunning attacks he can attempt per day.
Deal an additional 1/2 point of damage with focus powers.
Add one spell known from the oracle spell list. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level the oracle can cast.
Add +1/3 on critical hit confirmation rolls made while using smite evil (maximum bonus of +5). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
Gain a +1 bonus on concentration checks required because of taking damage while casting spells from the psychic class.
Add +1 hit point to the ranger's animal companion. If the ranger ever replaces his animal companion, the new animal companion gains these bonus hit points.
Add +1/3 on critical hit confirmation rolls made while using sneak attack (maximum bonus of +5). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.

Add one spell from the cleric spell list that isn't on the shaman spell list to the list of spells the shaman knows. This spell must be at least 1 level below the highest spell level the shaman can cast.
Increase the skald's total number of raging song rounds per day by 1.
Gain a +1/3 bonus on critical hit confirmation rolls made while using sneak attack (maximum bonus of +5). This bonus doesn't stack with those gained through Critical Focus and similar effects.
Add +1/2 point of fire damage to spells that deal fire damage cast by the sorcerer.
Add 1 hit point to the spiritualist's phantom.
Add +1 hit point to the summoner's eidolon.

Gain a +1/3 bonus on all critical hit confirmation rolls made while using the precise strike deed (maximum bonus of +5). This bonus doesn't stack with those gained through Critical Focus and similar effects.
Add 1/2 to the DC increase from unshakable.
Gain a +2 bonus on rolls to stabilize when dying.
Add +1 skill rank to the witch's familiar. If the half-orc ever replaces her familiar, the new familiar gains these bonus skill ranks.
Add a +1 bonus on concentration checks made due to taking damage while casting wizard spells.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Halflings are nimble and strong-willed, but their small stature makes them weaker than other races. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, and -2 Strength.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Halflings are Small creatures and gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty to their CMB and CMD, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

effects.sourceText: +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty to their CMB and CMD, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Halflings are humanoids with the Halfling subtype.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed (Slow Speed
standardTraits.description: ): Halflings have a base speed of 20 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Halflings begin play speaking Common and Halfling. Halflings with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, and Goblin. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Fearless
standardTraits.description: Halflings receive a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws against fear. This bonus stacks with the bonus granted by halfling luck.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on all saving throws against fear.

standardTraits.name: Halfling Luck
standardTraits.description: Halflings receive a +1 racial bonus on all saving throws.

effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus on all saving throws.

standardTraits.name: Sure-Footed
standardTraits.description: Halflings receive a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics and Climb checks.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics and Climb checks.

standardTraits.name: Weapon Familiarity
standardTraits.description: Halflings are proficient with slings and treat any weapon with the word "halfling" in its name as a martial weapon.

standardTraits.name: Keen Senses
standardTraits.description: Halflings receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

alternateTraits.name: Adaptable Luck
alternateTraits.description: Some halflings have greater control over their innate luck. This ability gives them more options for how they can apply their good fortune from day to day, but also narrows its scope. Three times per day, a halfling can gain a +2 luck bonus on an ability check, attack roll, saving throw, or skill check. If halflings choose to use the ability before they make the roll or check, they gain the full +2 bonus; if they choose to do so afterward, they only gain a +1 bonus. Using adaptive luck in this way is not an action. This racial trait replaces halfling luck.

effects.sourceText: +2 luck bonus on an ability check, attack roll, saving throw, or skill check.

alternateTraits.name: Acquisitive
alternateTraits.description: Halflings with this trait receive a +2 racial bonus on Appraise checks. This bonus increases to +4 when used to determine the most valuable item visible in a treasure hoard. This racial trait replaces keen senses.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Appraise checks.

alternateTraits.name: Attentive
alternateTraits.description: Halflings with this trait receive a +2 racial bonus on Sense Motive checks. This bonus increases to +4 to notice when someone is enchanted or possessed. This racial trait replaces keen senses.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Sense Motive checks.

alternateTraits.name: Behind the Veil (1 RP)
alternateTraits.description: Characters with this trait gain a +2 bonus on Bluff and Sleight of Hand checks while benefiting from concealment or cover. Halflings can take this trait in place of weapon familiarity.

effects.appliesWhen: while benefiting from concealment or cover
effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on Bluff and Sleight of Hand checks while benefiting from concealment or cover.

alternateTraits.name: Blessed
alternateTraits.description: Halflings with this trait receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against curse effects and hexes. This bonus stacks with the bonus granted by halfling luck. This racial trait replaces fearless.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against curse effects and hexes.

alternateTraits.name: Caretaker
alternateTraits.description: Humans often entrust halfling families with the care of children and animals, a task that has helped them develop keen insight. Such halflings gain a +2 racial bonus on Sense Motive checks. In addition, when they acquire an animal companion, bonded mount, cohort, or familiar, that creature gains a +2 bonus to one ability score of the character's choice. This racial trait replaces halfling luck, sure-footed, and weapon familiarity.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Sense Motive checks.

alternateTraits.name: Craven
alternateTraits.description: While most halflings are fearless, some are skittish, making them particularly alert. Halflings with this racial trait gain a +1 bonus on initiative checks and a +1 bonus on attack rolls when flanking. They take a -2 penalty on saves against fear effects and gain no benefit from morale bonuses on such saves. When affected by a fear effect, their base speed increases by 10 feet and they gain a +1 dodge bonus to Armor Class. This racial trait replaces fearless and halfling luck.

effects.sourceText: +1 bonus on initiative checks and a +1 bonus on attack rolls when flanking.
+1 dodge bonus to Armor Class.

alternateTraits.name: Creepy Doll
alternateTraits.description: Glassy eyes and porcelain skin make some halflings look more like dolls than living creatures. If they cease moving and pretend to be a doll while they aren't being observed, they can use the Stealth skill without cover or concealment. A successful Stealth check still allows other creatures to notice the halfling; they just believe the halfling is a doll, similar to the freeze universal monster ability (without being able to take 20). In addition, they take no size penalty on Intimidate checks against larger humanoids. The racial trait replaces keen senses and sure-footed.

alternateTraits.name: Danger Detection
alternateTraits.description: Halflings with this racial trait gain a +4 racial bonus on Perception checks to notice a creature using Stealth, as well as Perception checks to notice a weapon being drawn or a hidden trap (or similar signs of danger, subject to the GM's discretion). This replaces keen senses.

effects.sourceText: +4 racial bonus on Perception checks to notice a creature using Stealth, as well as Perception checks to notice a weapon being drawn or a hidden trap (or similar signs of danger, subject to the GM's discretion).

alternateTraits.name: Deep Jungle
alternateTraits.description: Some reclusive halfling tribes flourish in tropical locales. These halflings begin play speaking only Halfling (in addition to any additional languages gained from having a high Intelligence score), rather than Common and Halfling. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Survival checks and are proficient with blowguns. In addition, they have the poison use ability (they never risk poisoning themselves accidentally). This racial trait alters halflings' languages and replaces sure-footed and weapon familiarity.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Survival checks and are proficient with blowguns.

alternateTraits.name: Dimdweller (2 RP)
alternateTraits.description: Whenever characters with this trait benefit from concealment or full concealment due to darkness or dim light, they gain a +2 racial bonus on Intimidate, Perception, and Stealth checks. Halflings can take this trait in place of weapon familiarity.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Intimidate, Perception, and Stealth checks.

alternateTraits.name: Driven Worker
alternateTraits.description: Many halfling families have developed techniques to accomplish work faster and more efficiently, whether to contribute to the community or to please overbearing masters. These halflings gain a +4 racial bonus on checks with one Craft, Perform, or Profession skill. This racial trait replaces sure-footed.

effects.sourceText: +4 racial bonus on checks with one Craft, Perform, or Profession skill.

alternateTraits.name: Dusksight (2 RP)
alternateTraits.description: When making ranged attacks, characters with this trait can reroll the miss chance granted by cover to any target in dim light, and take the better of the two rolls. The miss chance for total concealment applies normally. Halflings can take this trait in place of keen senses.

alternateTraits.name: Evasive Nomad
alternateTraits.description: Halflings with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Reflex saves, but they take a -2 penalty on saving throws against fear effects. This replaces fearless.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Reflex saves, but they take a -2 penalty on saving throws against fear effects.

alternateTraits.name: Festive
alternateTraits.description: Once per day, a halfling with this racial trait can grant an ally within 60 feet a +2 luck bonus on one skill check as a free action; this bonus can be applied after the ally's check result is determined. This replaces sure-footed.

effects.sourceText: +2 luck bonus on one skill check as a free action;

alternateTraits.name: Fey Magic (2 RP)
alternateTraits.description: The character has a mystic connection to one terrain type, selected from the ranger's favored terrain list. The character selects three 0-level druid spells and one 1st-level druid spell. If the character has a Charisma score of 11 or higher, when in the selected terrain, she gains these spells as spell-like abilities that can be cast once per day. The caster level for these effects is equal to the user's character level. The DC for the spell-like abilities is equal to 10 + the spell's level + the user's Charisma modifier. These spells are treated as being from a fey source for the purposes of the druid's resist nature's lure class feature and similar abilities. This trait replaces keen senses.

alternateTraits.name: Fey-Quickened
alternateTraits.description: You gain Run as a bonus feat and a +2 racial bonus on initiative checks. This racial trait replaces fearless and keen senses.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on initiative checks.

alternateTraits.name: Fey Thoughts (1 RP)
alternateTraits.description: Select two of the following skills: Acrobatics, Bluff, Climb, Diplomacy, Disguise, Escape Artist, Fly, Knowledge (nature), Perception, Perform, Sense Motive, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, Swim, or Use Magic Device. The selected skills are always class skills for the character. This trait replaces fearless.

alternateTraits.name: Fleet of Foot
alternateTraits.description: Some halflings are quicker than their kin but less cautious. Halflings with this racial trait move at normal speed and have a base speed of 30 feet. This racial trait replaces slow speed and sure-footed.

alternateTraits.name: Halfling Jinx
alternateTraits.description: Halflings with this racial trait gain the ability to curse another creature with bad luck at will as a standard action. This curse has a range of 30 feet, and you must be able to see the target and have line of effect to it. The target gets a Will saving throw to resist this jinx (DC = 10 + 1/2 your level + your Charisma modifier). If your target makes this saving throw, it is immune to your jinx ability for 24 hours. A jinxed creature takes a -1 penalty on all saving throws. This jinx lasts for 24 hours or until you attempt to use your jinx again. A jinx is a supernatural ability, is not mind-affecting, does not allow spell resistance, and can affect any kind of creature not immune to luck effects. This replaces halfling luck.

alternateTraits.name: Human Shadow
alternateTraits.description: Halflings seem to pop up wherever humans are found, in part because they actively support and move with human explorers, settlers, and travelers without drawing attention to themselves. These halflings can use Stealth to hide behind creatures at least one size category larger than themselves, without any other source of concealment or cover. As long as the halflings are within 30 feet of a human, they gain a +2 racial bonus on Sleight of Hand checks and Stealth checks. This racial trait replaces keen senses and sure-footed.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Sleight of Hand checks and Stealth checks.

alternateTraits.name: Ingratiating
alternateTraits.description: Halflings often survive at the whims of larger, more aggressive races. Because of this, they go out of their way to make themselves more useful, or at least entertaining, to larger folk. Halflings with this racial trait gain a +2 bonus on skill checks for a single Perform skill of their choice, and Perform is always a class skill for them. They also gain a +2 bonus on Craft and Profession checks. This racial trait replaces keen senses and sure-footed.

effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on skill checks for a single Perform skill of their choice, and Perform is always a class skill for them.
+2 bonus on Craft and Profession checks.

alternateTraits.name: Irrepressible
alternateTraits.description: Halflings with this trait receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against dominate and possession effects. This bonus stacks with the bonus granted by halfling luck. This racial trait replaces fearless.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against dominate and possession effects.

alternateTraits.name: Joyous Companion (2 RP)
alternateTraits.description: Halflings enjoy the companionship of copper dragons and other lighthearted representatives of dragonkind and learn to share the joyousness of that bond with others. When halflings with this trait cast spells or use spell-like abilities of the abjuration school or with the emotion descriptor, they can confer a +1 morale bonus on saves versus fear on all adjacent allies for a number of rounds equal to the spell's level. This trait replaces fearless and weapon familiarity.

effects.appliesWhen: versus fear on all adjacent allies for a number of rounds equal to the spell's level
effects.sourceText: +1 morale bonus on saves versus fear on all adjacent allies for a number of rounds equal to the spell's level.

alternateTraits.name: Low Blow
alternateTraits.description: Some halflings train extensively in the art of attacking larger creatures. Halflings with this racial trait gain a +1 bonus on critical confirmation rolls against opponents larger than themselves. This racial trait replaces keen senses.

alternateTraits.name: Luckbringer (2 RP)
alternateTraits.description: Halflings with this trait learn to share their luck with others much in the way a gold dragon can imbue objects with good fortune. Once per day as a standard action, a halfling with this trait can confer good luck on a single non-magical token (such as a button or a ring). Any creature carrying this token gains a +1 luck bonus on Will saves. This effect lasts for 1 hour. This trait replaces lucky.

effects.sourceText: +1 luck bonus on Will saves.

alternateTraits.name: Outrider
alternateTraits.description: Some halflings specialize in mounted combat. Halflings with this racial trait gain a +2 bonus on Handle Animal and Ride checks. This racial trait replaces sure-footed.

effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on Handle Animal and Ride checks.

alternateTraits.name: Polyglot
alternateTraits.description: Some halflings, especially those who spend a lot of time traveling, develop a talent for learning new languages. These halflings gain a +2 racial bonus on Linguistics checks, and it is always a class skill for them. Halflings with this racial trait also begin play with the ability to speak Common, Halfling, and any one other language of their choice (except for secret languages, such as Druidic) in addition to bonus languages due to high Intelligence. They still gain the normal list of halfling bonus languages. This racial trait replaces keen senses and alters the halfling language racial trait.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Linguistics checks, and it is always a class skill for them.

alternateTraits.name: Practicality
alternateTraits.description: Halflings value hard work and common sense. Halflings with this racial trait gain a +2 bonus on any one Craft or Profession skill, as well as on Sense Motive checks and saves against illusions. This racial trait replaces fearless and sure-footed.

effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on any one Craft or Profession skill, as well as on Sense Motive checks and saves against illusions.

alternateTraits.name: Resourceful
alternateTraits.description: Halflings with this trait do not take any penalties for using improvised weapons. This trait counts as the Catch Off-Guard or Throw Anything feats for the purpose of qualifying for feats. This racial trait replaces sure-footed and weapon familiarity.

alternateTraits.name: Secretive Survivor
alternateTraits.description: Halflings from poor and desperate communities, most often in big cities, must take what they need without getting caught in order to survive. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Bluff and Stealth checks. This racial trait replaces sure-footed.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Bluff and Stealth checks.

alternateTraits.name: Shadowhunter (2 RP)
alternateTraits.description: Characters with this trait deal 50% weapon damage to incorporeal creatures when using non-magical weapons (including natural and unarmed attacks), as if using magic weapons. They also gain a +2 bonus on saving throws to remove negative levels, and recover physical ability damage from attacks by undead creatures at a rate of 2 points per ability score per day (rather than the normal 1 point per ability score per day). Halflings can take this trait in place of weapon familiarity.

effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on saving throws to remove negative levels, and recover physical ability damage from attacks by undead creatures at a rate of 2 points per ability score per day (rather than the normal 1 point per ability score per day).

alternateTraits.name: Shadowplay (1 RP)
alternateTraits.description: Characters with this trait cast spells with the darkness, light, or shadow descriptor at +1 caster level. Halflings can take this trait in place of weapon familiarity.

alternateTraits.name: Shiftless
alternateTraits.description: Halflings have a reputation for larceny and guile-and sometimes it's well deserved. Halflings with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Bluff and Sleight of Hand checks, and Sleight of Hand is always a class skill for them. This racial trait replaces sure-footed.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Bluff and Sleight of Hand checks, and Sleight of Hand is always a class skill for them.

alternateTraits.name: Skulker
alternateTraits.description: Oppressed halflings train from a young age to take advantage of times when their oppressors ignore them. Such halflings gain a +1 racial bonus on attacks against foes who are denied their Dexterity bonus to AC. This racial trait replaces fearless and weapon familiarity.

effects.appliesWhen: against foes who are denied their Dexterity bonus to AC
effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus on attacks against foes who are denied their Dexterity bonus to AC.

alternateTraits.name: Small Quarter Ally
alternateTraits.description: A halfling with this racial trait grants herself and all allies of the same size category within 60 feet a +1 luck bonus on saving throws against fear effects. This replaces fearless.

effects.sourceText: +1 luck bonus on saving throws against fear effects.

alternateTraits.name: Swift as Shadows
alternateTraits.description: Halflings possess incredible stealth even while moving through obstructed areas. Halflings with this racial trait reduce the penalty for using Stealth while moving by 5, and reduce the Stealth check penalty for sniping by 10. This racial trait replaces sure-footed.

alternateTraits.name: Underfoot
alternateTraits.description: Halflings must train hard to effectively fight bigger opponents. Halflings with this racial trait gain a +1 dodge bonus to AC against foes larger than themselves and a +1 bonus on Reflex saving throws to avoid trample attacks. This racial trait replaces halfling luck.

effects.appliesWhen: against foes larger than themselves and a +1 bonus on Reflex saving throws to avoid trample attacks
effects.sourceText: +1 dodge bonus to AC against foes larger than themselves and a +1 bonus on Reflex saving throws to avoid trample attacks.

alternateTraits.name: Underfoot Dodger
alternateTraits.description: City-dwelling halflings do not treat crowd squares as difficult terrain and they gain a +5 bonus on Acrobatics checks to move through the spaces of larger foes. This racial trait replaces fearless and weapon familiarity.

effects.sourceText: +5 bonus on Acrobatics checks to move through the spaces of larger foes.

alternateTraits.name: Unfettered
alternateTraits.description: Former slips liberated from slavery train to ensure they will never be slaves again. They gain a +4 racial bonus on Escape Artist checks and a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against effects that cause the entangled condition, to CMD against grapples, and on combat maneuver checks to escape a grapple. This racial trait replaces halfling luck and keen senses.

effects.appliesWhen: against effects that cause the entangled condition, to CMD against grapples, and on combat maneuver checks to escape a grapple
effects.sourceText: +4 racial bonus on Escape Artist checks and a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against effects that cause the entangled condition, to CMD against grapples, and on combat maneuver checks to escape a grapple.

alternateTraits.name: Unlucky Halfling
alternateTraits.description: These halflings take a -1 penalty on saving throws but also gain a +1 racial bonus to the caster level and save DC of all curse spells and spell-like abilities. In addition, such halflings can use ill omen as a spell-like ability once per day. This racial trait replaces halfling luck.

effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus to the caster level and save DC of all curse spells and spell-like abilities.

alternateTraits.name: Wanderlust
alternateTraits.description: Halflings love travel and maps. Halflings with this racial trait receive a +2 bonus on Knowledge (geography) and Survival checks. When casting spells or using abilities that provide or enhance movement, halflings treat their caster level as +1 higher than normal. This racial trait replaces fearless and halfling luck.

effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on Knowledge (geography) and Survival checks.

alternateTraits.name: Warslinger
alternateTraits.description: Halflings are experts at the use of the sling. Halflings with this racial trait can reload a sling as a free action. Reloading a sling still requires two hands and provokes attacks of opportunity. This racial trait replaces sure-footed.

alternateTraits.name: Avenging
alternateTraits.description: Unlike most halflings, members of this subtype actively look for trouble in their quest to avenge slights and wrongdoings. Whether resisting a local bully, monster, or troops of an oppressive ruler, halfling warriors of this secret subculture don masks and strike back on behalf of their community. These halflings have the low blow, underfoot, and warslinger alternate racial traits.

alternateTraits.name: Nomadic
alternateTraits.description: These halflings were born on the road and most follow it until the end of their days. They travel fast and light and never miss a chance for either profit or adventure. These halflings have the fleet-footed, polyglot, and wanderlust alternate racial traits.

alternateTraits.name: Slave Born
alternateTraits.description: These halflings come from lineages that have spent countless generations as property. Though usually free themselves, the weight of slavery still bears down on their souls, making them eager to please and prone to sudden fits of fear. These halflings have the craven and ingratiating alternate racial traits.

Add +1/2 hit point to the paladin's lay on hands ability (whether using it to heal or harm).
The psychic treats her Charisma bonus as 1/3 point higher for the purpose of determining the number of uses or rounds per day of her discipline powers.
Add a +1/4 dodge bonus to Armor Class against the ranger's favored enemies.

Choose a weapon from the following list: sling, dagger, or any weapon with "halfling" in its name. Add a +1/2 bonus on critical hit confirmation rolls with that weapon (maximum bonus +4). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
Add 1/2 to the shaman's effective class level for the purpose of determining her spirit animal's natural armor adjustment, Intelligence, and special abilities.

Choose a weapon from the following list: dagger, sling, or any weapon with the word "halfling" in its name. Add a +1/2 bonus on critical hit confirmation rolls with that weapon (maximum bonus +4). This bonus doesn't stack with those gained through Critical Focus and similar effects.
Add a +1/4 dodge bonus to Armor Class against the slayer's studied target.

Select one bloodline power at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + the sorcerer's Charisma modifier. The sorcerer adds +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that bloodline power.
Add 1/4 to the number of rounds that the spiritualist's incorporeal phantom can be out of sight and line of effect before being sent back to the Ethereal Plane.
Add +1 skill rank to the summoner's eidolon.
Increase the number of times the swashbuckler can use charmed life by 1/4.
Gain 1/6 of a new social talent.
Add 1/4 to the warpriest's effective level when determining the damage of his sacred weapon.
Add +1/4 to the witch's caster level when determining the effects of the spells granted to her by her patron.
Add +1/2 to the wizard's effective class level for the purposes of determining his familiar's natural armor adjustment, Intelligence, and special abilities.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Human characters gain a +2 racial bonus to one ability score of their choice at creation to represent their varied nature.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Humans are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Humans have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Humans begin play speaking Common. Humans with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want (except secret languages, such as Druidic). See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Bonus Feat
standardTraits.description: Humans select one extra feat at 1st level.

standardTraits.name: Skilled
standardTraits.description: Humans gain an additional skill rank at first level and one additional rank whenever they gain a level.

alternateTraits.name: Adoptive Parentage
alternateTraits.description: Humans are sometimes orphaned and adopted by other races. Choose one humanoid race without the human subtype. You start play with that race's languages and gain that race's weapon familiarity racial trait (if any). If the race does not have weapon familiarity, you gain either Skill Focus or Weapon Focus as a bonus feat that is appropriate for that race instead. This racial trait replaces the bonus feat trait.

alternateTraits.name: Alchemically Enhanced
alternateTraits.description: Some humans use alchemical or scientific enhancements to push their bodies beyond the limits of nature. However, doing so comes at a significant price. A human with this trait gains a +3 racial bonus to Constitution, Dexterity, or Strength. However, the character's biology is now more susceptible to chemicals, causing her to take a -2 penalty on Fortitude saving throws against poison. This racial trait replaces the +2 bonus to any one ability score and the bonus feat racial trait.

effects.sourceText: +3 racial bonus to Constitution, Dexterity, or Strength.

alternateTraits.name: Aquatic Ancestry
alternateTraits.description: Humans with deep one or skum ancestry may exhibit prominent round eyes or webbed fingers and toes. They gain a racial bonus equal to half their character level on Swim checks and Swim is always a class skill for them. In addition, they can hold their breath for twice as long as normal. When the racial bonus on Swim checks from this ability becomes +8 or higher, they can always take 10 on Swim checks, even when threatened or distracted. This racial trait replaces skilled.

alternateTraits.name: Awareness
alternateTraits.description: Humans raised within monastic traditions or communities that encourage mindfulness seem to shrug off many dangers more easily than other humans. They gain a +1 racial bonus on all saving throws and concentration checks. This racial trait replaces humans' bonus feat.

effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus on all saving throws and concentration checks.

alternateTraits.name: Comprehensive Education
alternateTraits.description: Humans raised with skilled teachers draw upon vast swathes of knowledge gained over centuries of civilization. They gain all Knowledge skills as class skills, and they gain a +1 racial bonus on skill checks for each Knowledge skill that they gain as a class skill from their class levels. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus on skill checks for each Knowledge skill that they gain as a class skill from their class levels.

alternateTraits.name: Dimdweller (2 RP)
alternateTraits.description: Whenever characters with this trait benefit from concealment or full concealment due to darkness or dim light, they gain a +2 racial bonus on Intimidate, Perception, and Stealth checks. Humans can take this trait in place of the skilled trait, also gaining darkvision to a range of 60 feet.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Intimidate, Perception, and Stealth checks.

alternateTraits.name: Draconic Heritage (4 RP)
alternateTraits.description: At times, a human's family history can have a dragon's power bound to the bloodline. Humans with this trait gain darkvision with a range of 10 feet and low-light vision. They can also ignore the Charisma prerequisite for Eldritch Heritage and any feat that has Eldritch Heritage as a prerequisite, but can select only the draconic bloodline with these feats. This replaces the bonus skill rank humans receive at each level.

alternateTraits.name: Dragon Scholar (4 RP)
alternateTraits.description: Dragons have a long history of individual interactions with specific humans, and some humans seek to better understand this relationship. Humans with this trait receive a +2 racial bonus on caster level checks to overcome a dragon's spell resistance. In addition, they receive a +3 racial bonus on Knowledge (arcana) checks related to creatures of the dragon type. This trait replaces humans' bonus feat racial trait.

effects.sourceText: +3 racial bonus on Knowledge (arcana) checks related to creatures of the dragon type.

alternateTraits.name: Dual Talent
alternateTraits.description: Some humans are uniquely skilled at maximizing their natural gifts. These humans pick two ability scores and gain a +2 racial bonus in each of those scores. This racial trait replaces the +2 bonus to any one ability score, the bonus feat, and the skilled traits.

alternateTraits.name: Eye for Talent
alternateTraits.description: Humans have great intuition for hidden potential. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Sense Motive checks. In addition, when they acquire an animal companion, bonded mount, cohort, or familiar, that creature gains a +2 bonus to one ability score of the character's choice. This racial trait replaces the bonus feat trait.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Sense Motive checks.

alternateTraits.name: Fey Magic (2 RP)
alternateTraits.description: The character has a mystic connection to one terrain type, selected from the ranger's favored terrain list. The character selects three 0-level druid spells and one 1st-level druid spell. If the character has a Charisma score of 11 or higher, when in the selected terrain, she gains these spells as spell-like abilities that can be cast once per day. The caster level for these effects is equal to the user's character level. The DC for the spell-like abilities is equal to 10 + the spell's level + the user's Charisma modifier. These spells are treated as being from a fey source for the purposes of the druid's resist nature's lure class feature and similar abilities. In addition, select two of the following skills: Acrobatics, Bluff, Climb, Diplomacy, Disguise, Escape Artist, Fly, Knowledge (nature), Perception, Perform, Sense Motive, Sleight of Hand, Stealth, Swim, or Use Magic Device. The selected skills are always class skills for the character. Lastly, the human also gains low-light vision. This trait replaces skilled.

alternateTraits.name: Focused Study
alternateTraits.description: All humans are skillful, but some, rather than being generalists, tend to specialize in a handful of skills. At 1st, 8th, and 16th level, such humans gain Skill Focus in a skill of their choice as a bonus feat. This racial trait replaces the bonus feat trait.

alternateTraits.name: Frontier Survivor
alternateTraits.description: Humans with this trait gain the Technologist feat, which grants them understanding of technological subjects. Additionally, they gain a +2 racial bonus on Survival checks in the ruins of cities. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Survival checks in the ruins of cities.

alternateTraits.name: Giant Ancestry
alternateTraits.description: Humans with ogre or troll ancestry end up having hulking builds and asymmetrical features. Such humans gain a +1 bonus on combat maneuver checks and to CMD, but a -2 penalty on Stealth checks. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.sourceText: +1 bonus on combat maneuver checks and to CMD, but a -2 penalty on Stealth checks.

alternateTraits.name: Heart of the Fey
alternateTraits.description: You gain low-light vision, gain a +1 racial bonus on Reflex and Will saves, and treat Knowledge (nature) and Perception as class skills. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus on Reflex and Will saves, and treat Knowledge (nature) and Perception as class skills.

alternateTraits.name: Heart of the Fields
alternateTraits.description: Humans born in rural areas are used to hard labor. They gain a racial bonus equal to half their character level to any one Craft or Profession skill, and once per day they may ignore an effect that would cause them to become fatigued or exhausted. This racial trait replaces skilled.

alternateTraits.name: Heart of the Mountains
alternateTraits.description: Humans born in the mountains are skilled at negotiating heights and precipices. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Climb checks and Acrobatics checks to move on narrow surfaces and uneven ground. Furthermore, they are considered acclimated to the effects of high altitude. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Climb checks and Acrobatics checks to move on narrow surfaces and uneven ground.

alternateTraits.name: Heart of the Sea
alternateTraits.description: Humans born near the sea are always drawn to it. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Profession (sailor) and Swim checks, and these are always class skills for them. They can hold their breath twice as long as normal, and spellcasters gain a +4 racial bonus on concentration checks when attempting to cast spells underwater. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Profession (sailor) and Swim checks, and these are always class skills for them.

alternateTraits.name: Heart of the Slums
alternateTraits.description: Humans who eke out a life in a city's teeming slums must be quick and clever. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Sleight of Hand and Stealth checks, and a +4 racial bonus on Survival checks in urban and underground settings. In addition, they may roll twice when saving against disease, taking the better roll. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Sleight of Hand and Stealth checks, and a +4 racial bonus on Survival checks in urban and underground settings.

alternateTraits.name: Heart of the Snows
alternateTraits.description: Humans born in chilly climes treat cold climates as one category less severe. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Fortitude saving throws against the effects of cold climates, on any check or saving throw to avoid slipping and falling, and to CMD against trip combat maneuvers. This bonus applies on Acrobatics and Climb checks made in slippery conditions. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.appliesWhen: against the effects of cold climates, on any check or saving throw to avoid slipping and falling, and to CMD against trip combat maneuvers
effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Fortitude saving throws against the effects of cold climates, on any check or saving throw to avoid slipping and falling, and to CMD against trip combat maneuvers.

alternateTraits.name: Heart of the Streets
alternateTraits.description: Humans from bustling cities are skilled with crowds. They gain a +1 racial bonus on Reflex saves and a +1 dodge bonus to Armor Class when adjacent to at least two other allies. Crowds do not count as difficult terrain for them. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.appliesWhen: when adjacent to at least two other allies
effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus on Reflex saves and a +1 dodge bonus to Armor Class when adjacent to at least two other allies.

alternateTraits.name: Heart of the Sun
alternateTraits.description: Humans born in tropical climates treat hot climates as one category less severe. They also gain a +2 racial bonus on Fortitude saving throws against the effects of a hot climate, as well as against the poison and distraction ability of swarms and vermin. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.appliesWhen: against the effects of a hot climate, as well as against the poison and distraction ability of swarms and vermin
effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Fortitude saving throws against the effects of a hot climate, as well as against the poison and distraction ability of swarms and vermin.

alternateTraits.name: Heart of the Wilderness
alternateTraits.description: Humans raised in the wild learn the hard way that only the strong survive. They gain a racial bonus equal to half their character level on Survival checks. They also gain a +5 racial bonus on Constitution checks to stabilize when dying and add half their character level to their Constitution score when determining the negative hit point total necessary to kill them. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.appliesWhen: when dying and add half their character level to their Constitution score when determining the negative hit point total necessary to kill them
effects.sourceText: +5 racial bonus on Constitution checks to stabilize when dying and add half their character level to their Constitution score when determining the negative hit point total necessary to kill them.

alternateTraits.name: Heroic
alternateTraits.description: Some humans are born heroes. In campaigns that use the optional hero point system, each time these humans gain a level, they gain 2 hero points instead of 1. If they take the Blood of Heroes feat, they gain 3 hero points each level instead of 2. This racial trait replaces the bonus feat trait.

alternateTraits.name: History of Terrors
alternateTraits.description: Humans with this trait gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws to resist mind-affecting effects. The bonus increases to +4 if the effect is also a fear effect. This racial trait replaces the skilled trait.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on saving throws to resist mind-affecting effects.

alternateTraits.name: Imposter-Wary
alternateTraits.description: You gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against illusion spells and effects, 1 free rank in Sense Motive at 1st level, and 1 additional rank in Sense Motive whenever they gain a level. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.appliesWhen: against illusion spells and effects, 1 free rank in Sense Motive at 1st level, and 1 additional rank in Sense Motive whenever they gain a level
effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against illusion spells and effects, 1 free rank in Sense Motive at 1st level, and 1 additional rank in Sense Motive whenever they gain a level.

alternateTraits.name: Industrious
alternateTraits.description: Humans are known for their drive and work ethic. Humans with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on concentration checks and checks with their choice of one Craft or Profession skill. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on concentration checks and checks with their choice of one Craft or Profession skill.

alternateTraits.name: Innovative
alternateTraits.description: Humans have come to shape the world because they are inveterate innovators. Humans with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Knowledge (arcana) and Spellcraft checks to independently research spells, create magic items they have never encountered before, and identify unique magical effects. They also gain a +2 racial bonus on Charisma-based skill checks to persuade others to adopt a new ideology or further the cause of discovery and progress. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Knowledge (arcana) and Spellcraft checks to independently research spells, create magic items they have never encountered before, and identify unique magical effects.
+2 racial bonus on Charisma-based skill checks to persuade others to adopt a new ideology or further the cause of discovery and progress.

alternateTraits.name: Institutional Memory
alternateTraits.description: Humans rely on their institutions to remember the distant past and to preserve their own memories for the distant future. They gain a +4 racial bonus on Knowledge checks to answer questions about any organizations, guilds, or religions to which they belong, and they can attempt such skill checks untrained. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.sourceText: +4 racial bonus on Knowledge checks to answer questions about any organizations, guilds, or religions to which they belong, and they can attempt such skill checks untrained.

alternateTraits.name: Military Tradition
alternateTraits.description: Several human cultures raise all children (or all children of a certain social class) to serve in the military or defend themselves with force of arms. They gain proficiency with up to two martial or exotic weapons appropriate to their culture. This racial trait replaces the bonus feat trait.

alternateTraits.name: Mixed Heritage
alternateTraits.description: Often human civilization is defined by more than one characteristic. A human with this trait may select a second "Heart of the" racial trait. This replaces the bonus feat racial trait.

alternateTraits.name: One of the Multitude
alternateTraits.description: City-dwelling humans are skilled at blending in with the busy multitudes of the city. They gain a +1 racial bonus on Bluff, Diplomacy, Disguise, Sleight of Hand, and Stealth checks when within 10 feet of at least two other humanoids. They gain a +1 racial bonus on attacks of opportunity made while flanking. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.appliesWhen: when within 10 feet of at least two other humanoids
effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus on Bluff, Diplomacy, Disguise, Sleight of Hand, and Stealth checks when within 10 feet of at least two other humanoids.

alternateTraits.name: Piety
alternateTraits.description: Humans place great trust in the gods to protect them. Humans with this trait receive a +2 racial bonus on Knowledge (religion) checks and Knowledge (religion) is always a class skill for them. In addition, once per day before attempting an attack roll, saving throw, ability check, or skill check, such a human can call out to his deity in order to receive a +2 racial bonus on that roll; he can use this ability only if he is able to speak. This racial trait replaces the bonus feat racial trait.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Knowledge (religion) checks and Knowledge (religion) is always a class skill for them.

alternateTraits.name: Poison Minion (4 RP)
alternateTraits.description: Drow sometimes augment their slaves and frontline warriors by making them toxic, causing their bodies to internally produce mawbane poison (see below). The resulting poisonous creature makes a potent weapon in the effort to discourage neighboring monsters. Any creature that hits such a character with a bite attack is immediately exposed to its poison. The save DC for this poison is equal to 10 + 1/2 the character's Hit Dice + the character's Constitution modifier. Mawbane Poison-ingested; save Fortitude as above; frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect 1d2 Constitution damage; cure 1 save. Humans can take this trait in place of skilled.

alternateTraits.name: Practiced Hunter
alternateTraits.description: Members of some human cultures train from youth to find and follow the trails of vital game and at the same time hide the evidence of their own passage. These humans gain a +2 racial bonus on Stealth and Survival checks, and Stealth and Survival are always class skills for them. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Stealth and Survival checks, and Stealth and Survival are always class skills for them.

alternateTraits.name: Psychic Defense
alternateTraits.description: Humans from cultures steeped in the occult sometimes train their minds to resist outside influence. They gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against psychic spells and spell-like abilities, including those that originate from the psychic magic ability. This racial trait replaces the bonus feat trait.

effects.appliesWhen: against psychic spells and spell-like abilities, including those that originate from the psychic magic ability
effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against psychic spells and spell-like abilities, including those that originate from the psychic magic ability.

alternateTraits.name: Rationalize
alternateTraits.description: Humans have the ability to assuage their own fears by convincing themselves that what they saw or read is not real. Humans with this trait gain a +3 bonus on saving throws against effects that cause sanity damage. This racial trait replaces the bonus feat trait.

effects.appliesWhen: against effects that cause sanity damage
effects.sourceText: +3 bonus on saving throws against effects that cause sanity damage.

alternateTraits.name: Reptilian Ancestry
alternateTraits.description: Humans with reptoid or serpentfolk ancestry sometimes have nictitating membranes or patches of scaly skin. They gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects and poisons. This racial trait replaces the bonus feat trait.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects and poisons.

alternateTraits.name: Self-Made Fate
alternateTraits.description: Some humans build nations that deny the importance of gods and divine magic, and those raised to avoid divine influence develop a knack for defying divine magic. They gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against divine spells and spell-like abilities, as well as the spells and spell-like abilities of aeons, psychopomps, and outsiders with an alignment subtype. This racial trait replaces the bonus feat trait.

effects.appliesWhen: against divine spells and spell-like abilities, as well as the spells and spell-like abilities of aeons, psychopomps, and outsiders with an alignment subtype
effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against divine spells and spell-like abilities, as well as the spells and spell-like abilities of aeons, psychopomps, and outsiders with an alignment subtype.

alternateTraits.name: Shadowhunter (2 RP)
alternateTraits.description: Characters with this trait deal 50% weapon damage to incorporeal creatures when using non-magical weapons (including natural and unarmed attacks), as if using magic weapons. They also gain a +2 bonus on saving throws to remove negative levels, and recover physical ability damage from attacks by undead creatures at a rate of 2 points per ability score per day (rather than the normal 1 point per ability score per day). Humans can take this trait in place of their bonus feat, also gaining Iron Will as a bonus feat.

effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on saving throws to remove negative levels, and recover physical ability damage from attacks by undead creatures at a rate of 2 points per ability score per day (rather than the normal 1 point per ability score per day).

alternateTraits.name: Silver Tongued
alternateTraits.description: Human are often adept at subtle manipulation and putting even sworn foes at ease. Humans with this trait gain a +2 bonus on Diplomacy and Bluff checks. In addition, when they use Diplomacy to shift a creature's attitude, they can shift up to three steps up rather than just two. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on Diplomacy and Bluff checks.

alternateTraits.name: Social Ties
alternateTraits.description: Some human societies run on complex webs of favors and loyalties that canny members can intuitively exploit with relative ease. These humans gain a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy checks, and on any skill checks to recruit members and teams for an organization. They also add a +1 racial bonus to their Leadership scores (if they gain the Leadership feat). This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy checks, and on any skill checks to recruit members and teams for an organization.

alternateTraits.name: Tribalistic
alternateTraits.description: Many humans naturally form into cliques or tribes, and these humans work exceptionally well with those they view as fellow tribe members. Such humans gain a +2 racial bonus on attack rolls and skill checks to use the aid another action to aid humans of the same ethnicity. Humans with this racial trait must hail from an ethnicity that has its own language other than Common, and they only start with that language; if they have high Intelligence scores, they can select their bonus languages from among Common, Giant, Goblin, and Halfling. This racial trait alters starting and bonus languages.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on attack rolls and skill checks to use the aid another action to aid humans of the same ethnicity.

alternateTraits.name: Unstoppable Magic
alternateTraits.description: Humans from civilizations built upon advanced magic are educated in a variety of ways to accomplish their magical goals. They gain a +2 racial bonus on caster level checks against spell resistance. This racial trait replaces the bonus feat trait.

alternateTraits.name: Wayfarer
alternateTraits.description: Humans maintain the largest trade networks and the farthest-reaching civilizations, putting them in contact with a huge number of cultures. Humans with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Survival checks to avoid becoming lost, Knowledge (geography) checks, and Knowledge (local) checks. Whenever these humans gain a rank in Linguistics, they learn two languages rather than one. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Survival checks to avoid becoming lost, Knowledge (geography) checks, and Knowledge (local) checks.

alternateTraits.name: Cosmopolitan
alternateTraits.description: Adept as city living, these humans can navigate crowds and fulfill the need for skilled labor in such settlements. Replace the skilled racial trait with heart of the streets and the bonus feat racial trait with focused study.

alternateTraits.name: Country Folk
alternateTraits.description: These humans are suited to life in the countryside. Replace the skilled racial trait with heart of the fields and the bonus feat racial trait with focused study.

alternateTraits.name: Gutter Rat
alternateTraits.description: Often second-class citizens living in sprawling ghettos and slums, these humans work hard to eke out an existence in a city. Replace the skilled racial trait with heart of the slums and the bonus feat racial trait with mixed heritage (heart of the streets).

alternateTraits.name: Imperious Human
alternateTraits.description: Hailing from either an empire, an emerging nation, or a controlling city-state, these humans are arrogant expansionists, absorbing others to their causes and culture. Replace the skilled racial trait with silver tongued and the bonus feat racial trait with eye for talent.

alternateTraits.name: Trailblazer
alternateTraits.description: Adaptive and inventive, these humans must have quick wits and a dose of heroic luck to survive in the lands they settle. Replace the skilled racial trait with heart of the wilderness and the bonus feat racial trait with heroic. At the GM's discretion, you can swap out the heart of the wilderness racial trait for either heart of the mountains, heart of the sea, heart of the snows, or heart of the sun, depending on the type of terrain these humans are settling.

alternateTraits.name: Versatile Human
alternateTraits.description: While they lack some of the training of other humans, the natural talents of versatile humans more than make up for this lack. Replace the +2 bonus to any ability score, the skilled racial trait, and the bonus feat racial trait with dual talent.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add one extract formula from the alchemist formula list to the character's formula book. This formula must be at least one level below the highest formula level the alchemist can create.
Add one spell from the arcanist spell list to the arcanist's spellbook. The spell must be at least 1 spell level below the highest level the arcanist can cast.
Add a +1/2 bonus to trap sense or +1/3 to the bonus from the superstitious rage power.
Add one spell known from the bard spell list. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level the bard can cast.
Increase the bloodrager's total number of bloodrage rounds per day by 1.
Gain a +1 bonus to the brawler's CMD when resisting two combat maneuvers of the brawler's choice.

effects.appliesWhen: when resisting two combat maneuvers of the brawler's choice
effects.sourceText: +1 bonus to the brawler's CMD when resisting two combat maneuvers of the brawler's choice.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add +1/4 to the cavalier's banner bonus.
Add a +1 bonus on caster level checks made to overcome the spell resistance of outsiders.
Add a +1/2 bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks to change a creature's attitude.
Add +1 to the Fighter's CMD when resisting two combat maneuvers of the character's choice.
Add +1/4 point to the gunslinger's grit points.
Add 1 skill rank to the hunter's animal companion. If the hunter replaces his animal companion, the new animal companion gains these bonus skill ranks.
Add one spell known from the inquisitor spell list. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level the inquisitor can cast.
Add a +1/2 bonus on Perception checks to see through magical disguises or pinpoint invisible creatures.
Add one extract formula from the investigator's formula list to his formula book. This formula must be at least 1 formula level below the highest level the investigator can create.
Gain 1/6 of an Extra Wild Talent feat.
Add +1/4 point to the magus' arcane pool.
When gaining a taboo, the medium can use spirit surge without incurring influence an additional 1/4 time per day.
Increase the mesmerist's towering ego bonus by 1/3 point (to a maximum increase of +2).
Add +1/4 point to the monk's ki pool.
Gain 1/6 of a new focus power.
Add a +1/3 bonus on any skill check attempted as a part of an occult ritual.
Add one spell known from the oracle spell list. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level the oracle can cast.
Add +1 to the paladin's energy resistance to one kind of energy (maximum +10).
Add one spell known from the psychic spell list. This spell must be at least 1 level lower than the highest spell level the psychic can cast.
Add a +1/4 bonus to AC when flatfooted, to a maximum of what the psychic's AC would be if not flat-footed.
Add +1 hit point or +1 skill rank to the ranger's animal companion. If the ranger ever replaces his companion, the new companion gains these bonus hit points or skill ranks.
The rogue gains +1/6 of a new rogue talent.

Add one spell from the cleric spell list that isn't on the shaman spell list to the list of spells the shaman knows. This spell must be at least 1 level below the highest spell level the shaman can cast.
Add one spell from the skald's spell list to the skald's known spells. This spell must be at least 1 spell level below the highest level the skald can cast.
Gain 1/6 of a new slayer talent.
Add one spell known from the sorcerer spell list. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level the sorcerer can cast.
Add 1 skill rank or 1 hit point to the spiritualist's phantom.
Add +1 hit point or +1 skill rank to the summoner's eidolon.
Increase the total number of points in the swashbuckler's panache pool by 1/4.
Gain +1/2 on the Disguise bonus provided by seamless guise.
Gain 1/6 of a new bonus combat feat.

Add one spell from the witch spell list to the witch's familiar. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level she can cast. If the witch ever replaces her familiar, the new familiar knows these bonus spells.
Add one spell from the wizard spell list to the wizard's spellbook. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level the wizard can cast.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Catfolk are sociable and agile, but often lack common sense. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, -2 Wisdom.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Catfolk are humanoids with the catfolk subtype.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Catfolk are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Catfolk have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Catfolk begin play speaking Common and Catfolk. Catfolk with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Elven, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Halfling, Orc, and Sylvan.

standardTraits.name: Cat's Luck (Ex)
standardTraits.description: Once per day when a catfolk makes a Reflex saving throw, he can roll the saving throw twice and take the better result. He must decide to use this ability before the saving throw is attempted.

standardTraits.name: Natural Hunter
standardTraits.description: Catfolk receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks.

standardTraits.name: Sprinter
standardTraits.description: Catfolk gain a 10-foot racial bonus to their speed when using the charge, run, or withdraw actions.

standardTraits.name: Low-Light Vision
standardTraits.description: Catfolk have low-light vision allowing them to see twice as far as humans in dim light.

alternateTraits.name: Cat's Claws
alternateTraits.description: Some catfolk have stronger and more developed claws than other members of their race, and can use them to make attacks. Catfolk with this racial trait have a pair of claws they can use as natural weapons. These claws are primary attacks that deal 1d4 points of damage. This racial trait replaces natural hunter.

alternateTraits.name: Clever Cat
alternateTraits.description: Catfolk's generally friendly disposition doesn't preclude craftiness. Some of them see social obstacles as games to be played and won. These catfolk receive a +2 racial bonus on Bluff, Diplomacy, and Sense Motive checks. This racial trait replaces natural hunter.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Bluff, Diplomacy, and Sense Motive checks.

alternateTraits.name: Climber
alternateTraits.description: Catfolk hunters excel at hunting prey from trees and other high vantage points. Catfolk with this racial trait possess a climb speed of 20 feet (along with the +8 racial bonus on Climb checks a climb speed affords). This racial trait replaces sprinter.

effects.sourceText: +8 racial bonus on Climb checks a climb speed affords).

alternateTraits.name: Curiosity
alternateTraits.description: Catfolk are naturally inquisitive about the world around them, though some are more curious than others. Such catfolk gain a +4 bonus on Diplomacy checks to gather information, and Knowledge (history) and Knowledge (local) are always class skills for them. If they choose a class that has either of these Knowledge skills as class skills, they gain a +2 racial bonus on those skills instead. This racial trait replaces natural hunter.

effects.sourceText: +4 bonus on Diplomacy checks to gather information, and Knowledge (history) and Knowledge (local) are always class skills for them.

alternateTraits.name: Jungle Stalker
alternateTraits.description: Catfolk often live in deeply forested terrain and they have become naturally sure-footed to maintain their hunting prowess in these dangerous environments. Such catfolk gain a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics checks and can ignore the first square of difficult terrain caused by foliage each round. This racial trait replaces cat's luck and sprinter.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics checks and can ignore the first square of difficult terrain caused by foliage each round.

alternateTraits.name: Nimble Faller
alternateTraits.description: Some catfolk have an amazing sense of balance and keen knowledge of their own center of gravity. Catfolk with this trait land on their feet even when they take lethal damage from a fall. Furthermore, catfolk with this trait gain a +1 bonus to their CMD against trip maneuvers. This racial trait replaces sprinter.

effects.sourceText: +1 bonus to their CMD against trip maneuvers.

alternateTraits.name: Scent
alternateTraits.description: Some catfolk favor a keen sense of smell over sensitive sight. Catfolk with this racial trait gain the scent ability. This racial trait replaces the low-light vision racial trait.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Gain 1/6 of a bonus discovery.
Add +1/2 to the bard's bardic knowledge bonus.

Add 1 foot to the bloodrager's base speed. In combat, this has an effect only for every five increases in base speed. This bonus stacks with the bloodrager's fast movement feature, and applies under the same conditions as that feature.
Add +1/4 to the cavalier's banner bonus.
Add +1 hit points to the druid's animal companion. If the druid ever replaces her animal companion, the new animal companion gains these bonus hit points.
Gain 1/6 of a bonus teamwork feat.
Add 1/2 to the inquisitor's track bonus.

Add 1 to the bonus provided to a single skill (maximum +2) by inspiration. This skill must be one the investigator can already apply inspiration to. The investigator can select a different skill each level.
Add 1/3 to the result of any spirit surge die that the medium rolls.

Add 1/2 to the monk's damage rolls with claw attacks and claw blades. A monk who selects this bonus at 1st level also treats claw blades as a monk weapon. If he is an unchained monk, he can use his style strikes with unarmed strike or claw blade attacks.
Add one spell known from the oracle spell list. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level the oracle can cast.

Choose a weapon from the following list: claws, kukri, longbow, longsword, short spear, or shortbow. Add +1/2 on critical hit confirmation rolls made while using that weapon (maximum bonus of +4). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
Add a +1/2 bonus on Bluff checks to feint and Sleight of Hand checks to pickpocket.
Add 1/6 to the shaman's class level for the purpose of determining the effects of one hex.
Add 1/3 to the result of any sneak attack damage that the slayer deals after all sneak attack damage dice have been totaled.

Select one bloodline power at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times equal to 3 + the sorcerer's Charisma modifier. The sorcerer adds + 1/2 to the number of uses per day of that bloodline power.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Duergar are hearty and observant, but also belligerent. They gain +2 Constitution, +2 Wisdom, and -4 Charisma.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Duergar are humanoids with the dwarf subtype.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Duergar are Medium creatures and thus have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Slow and Steady- Duergar have a base speed of 20 feet, but their speed is never modified by armor or encumbrance.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Duergar begin play speaking Common, Dwarven, and Undercommon. Duergar with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aklo, Draconic, Giant, Goblin, Orc, and Terran. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Duergar Immunities
standardTraits.description: Duergar are immune to paralysis, phantasms, and poison. They gain a +2 racial bonus on saves against spells and spell-like abilities.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on saves against spells and spell-like abilities.

standardTraits.name: Stability
standardTraits.description: Duergar receive a +4 racial bonus to their CMD against bull rush or trip attempts while on solid ground.

effects.appliesWhen: against bull rush or trip attempts while on solid ground
effects.sourceText: +4 racial bonus to their CMD against bull rush or trip attempts while on solid ground.

standardTraits.name: Enlarge Person Spell-Like Ability (Sp)
standardTraits.description: A duergar can use enlarge person once per day, using its character level as its caster level and affecting itself only.

standardTraits.name: Invisibility Spell-Like Ability (Sp)
standardTraits.description: A duergar can use invisibility once per day, using its character level as its caster level and affecting itself only.

standardTraits.name: Superior Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Duergar have superior darkvision, allowing them to see perfectly in the dark up to 120 feet.

standardTraits.name: Light Sensitivity
standardTraits.description: Duergar are dazzled in areas of bright light.

alternateTraits.name: Blood Enmity
alternateTraits.description: Duergar have long warred against their dwarven cousins and the hated drow. Duergar with this racial trait receive a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against humanoid creatures of the dwarf or elf subtypes. This racial trait replaces the invisibility spell-like ability.

effects.appliesWhen: against humanoid creatures of the dwarf or elf subtypes
effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against humanoid creatures of the dwarf or elf subtypes.

alternateTraits.name: Daysighted
alternateTraits.description: The cruel light of the sun harms some duergar less than others. Such duergar lack the light sensitivity racial trait, but have darkvision of only 60 feet.

alternateTraits.name: Deep Magic
alternateTraits.description: Duergar spellcasters labor long to overcome the inborn spell resistance (SR) held by so many of their underground foes. Duergar with this racial trait receive a +2 racial bonus on caster level checks made to overcome spell resistance and a +2 racial bonus on dispel checks. This racial trait replaces the enlarge person and invisibility spell-like abilities.

alternateTraits.name: Dwarf Traits
alternateTraits.description: Duergar can select any dwarf racial trait that replaces stability. They can select dwarf racial traits that replace the hardy dwarf racial trait by giving up duergar immunities instead.

alternateTraits.name: Magical Taskmaster
alternateTraits.description: Some duergar demonstrate magic of a more insidious kind than the rest of their kin. They can use charm person once per day as a spell-like ability. The save DC is equal to 10 + 1/2 duergar's Hit Dice + duergar's Wisdom modifier. This racial trait replaces the invisibility spell-like ability racial trait.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add a +1/2 bonus on checks made to craft magic items.
Add +1 to the Fighter's CMD when resisting a bull rush or trip attempt.
Add +1/6 to the number of times per day the inquisitor can use the judgment class feature.
Add 1/5 of an Extra Wild Talent feat that must be spent on an earth element wild talent.
The psychic treats her Wisdom bonus as 1/3 point higher for the purpose of determining the number of uses or rounds per day of her discipline powers.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Flexible (+2 Str, +2 Con) (2 RP)

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Humanoid (gnoll) (0 RP)

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Medium (0 RP)

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Normal (0 RP)

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Xenophobic (0 RP) Gnolls start knowing their racial language only.

standardTraits.name: Natural Armor
standardTraits.description: Gnoll hides are remarkably tough, granting them a +1 natural armor bonus.

standardTraits.name: Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Gnolls have darkvision and so can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet. (2 RP)
