standardTraits.name: Ability Score Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: Gripplis are nimble and alert, but spindly. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, and -2 Strength.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Gripplis are Small creatures and thus gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty to their CMB and CMD, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

effects.sourceText: +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty to their CMB and CMD, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Gripplis are humanoids with the grippli subtype.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Gripplis have a base speed of 30 feet and a climb speed of 20 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Gripplis begin play speaking Common and Grippli. Gripplis with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Boggard, Draconic, Elven, Gnome, Goblin, and Sylvan. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Camouflage
standardTraits.description: Gripplis receive a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks in marshes and forested areas.

effects.sourceText: +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks in marshes and forested areas.

standardTraits.name: Swamp Stride (Ex)
standardTraits.description: A grippli can move through difficult terrain at its normal speed while within a swamp. Magically altered terrain affects a grippli normally.

standardTraits.name: Weapon Familiarity
standardTraits.description: Gripplis are proficient with nets.

standardTraits.name: Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Gripplis can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

alternateTraits.name: Defensive Training
alternateTraits.description: Gripplis often live in close proximity to very large animals and dangerous creatures they must learn to avoid in order to survive. They gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC against Large or larger animals and magical beasts. This racial trait replaces swamp stride and weapon familiarity.

effects.appliesWhen: against Large or larger animals and magical beasts
effects.sourceText: +2 dodge bonus to AC against Large or larger animals and magical beasts.

alternateTraits.name: Glider
alternateTraits.description: Gripplis' aerodynamic bodies and thick webbing between the toes enable a falling grippli to treat the distance fallen as half the actual distance. The grippli can steer himself while falling, moving horizontally up to a number of feet equal to half the vertical distance fallen. The grippli cannot use this trait if it is wearing heavy armor, is carrying a heavy load, or is unable to react to the fall (such as being helpless). This racial trait replaces swamp stride.

alternateTraits.name: Jumper
alternateTraits.description: Gripplis with this trait are always considered to have a running start when making Acrobatics checks to jump. This racial trait replaces camouflage.

alternateTraits.name: Princely
alternateTraits.description: The grippli gains proficiency with rapiers and a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks. This racial trait replaces swamp stride and weapon familiarity.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks.

alternateTraits.name: Toxic Skin (Ex)
alternateTraits.description: Once per day as a swift action, a grippli can create a poison that can be applied to a weapon or delivered as a touch attack. Alternatively, the grippli can smear the poison on its own body as a standard action, affecting the first creature to hit it with an unarmed strike or natural weapon. The poison loses its potency after 1 hour. The grippli is immune to its own poison. This racial trait replaces swamp stride and camouflage. Grippli Poison: Skin or weapon-contact or injury; save Fort DC 10 + 1/2 the grippli's Hit Dice plus its Constitution modifier; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Dexterity damage; cure 1 save.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add +1/4 to the number of toxic skin uses per day.
Add 1/5 to the armor bonus granted by hide armor or bone armor the barbarian wears (maximum +3).
Add 5 feet to the range of one bardic performance.
Add a +1/2 bonus on concentration checks. This bonus doubles in a forest or swamp terrain.
Add 1/4 to any checks modified by the medium's spirit surge ability.

Add one spell known with the poison or water descriptor from the druid's spell list. This spell must be at least 1 level below the highest spell level the oracle can cast. The spell is treated as 1 spell level higher, unless it is also on the oracle spell list.
Add a +1/4 bonus on attack rolls when making a utility shot or a dead shot.
Add a +1/2 bonus on Perception checks while in a forest or swamp.
Add a +1 racial bonus on Swim skill checks. When this bonus reaches +8, the ranger gains a swim speed of 15 feet (this does not grant the ranger another +8 racial bonus on Swim checks).

effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus on Swim skill checks.
+8 racial bonus on Swim checks).

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add one spell from the druid spell list that isn't on the shaman spell list to the list of spells the shaman knows. This spell must be at least 1 level below the highest spell level the shaman can cast.
Increase the skald's total number of raging song rounds per day by 1.
Add 1/3 to the damage the slayer deals with bone weapons (maximum +4).
Add 1/2 to the swashbuckler's Acrobatics, Climb, Escape Artist, Fly, Ride, and Swim checks when using the derring-do deed.
Add 1/3 to the saving throw DC to resist the poison of the witch's familiar.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Goblins are fast, but weak and unpleasant to be around. They gain +4 Dexterity, -2 Strength, and -2 Charisma.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Goblins are humanoids with the goblinoid subtype.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Goblins are Small creatures and thus gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty to their CMB and CMD, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

effects.sourceText: +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty to their CMB and CMD, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Goblins are fast for their size, and have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Goblins begin play speaking Goblin. Goblins with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Gnoll, Gnome, Halfling, and Orc. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Skilled
standardTraits.description: Goblins gain a +4 racial bonus on Ride and Stealth checks.

effects.sourceText: +4 racial bonus on Ride and Stealth checks.

standardTraits.name: Fast Movement
standardTraits.description: Goblins gain a +10 foot bonus to their base speed (this is already added to their Base Speed above.)

standardTraits.name: Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Goblins see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

alternateTraits.name: Cave Crawler
alternateTraits.description: Some goblins are born and raised in caves and rarely see the light of day. Goblins with this trait gain a climb speed of 10 feet and the +8 racial bonus on Climb checks associated with having a climb speed. Goblins with this racial trait have a base speed of 20 feet and lose the fast movement racial trait.

effects.sourceText: +8 racial bonus on Climb checks associated with having a climb speed.

alternateTraits.name: City Scavenger
alternateTraits.description: Goblins who live within the boundaries of human cities survive by scavenging for refuse and hunting stray animals. Goblins with this trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception and Survival checks, and can use Survival to forage for food while in a city. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Perception and Survival checks, and can use Survival to forage for food while in a city.

alternateTraits.name: Eat Anything
alternateTraits.description: Raised with little or no proper food, many goblins have learned to survive by eating whatever they happen across and can digest nearly anything without getting sick. Goblins with this trait gain a +4 on Survival checks to forage for food and a +4 racial bonus on saves versus effects that cause the nauseated or sickened conditions. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.appliesWhen: versus effects that cause the nauseated or sickened conditions
effects.sourceText: +4 racial bonus on saves versus effects that cause the nauseated or sickened conditions.

alternateTraits.name: Hard Head, Big Teeth
alternateTraits.description: Goblins are known for their balloon-like heads and enormous maws, but some have even more exaggeratedly large heads filled with razor-sharp teeth. Goblins with this trait gain a bite attack as a primary natural attack that deals 1d4 points of damage. This racial trait replaces skilled.

alternateTraits.name: Junk Tinker
alternateTraits.description: Goblins use ramshackle equipment and vehicles that seem like they should never function. Goblins gain a +2 racial bonus on driving checks and on Craft checks to build or repair weapons or vehicles without the proper tools. They can make the attempt with any material that can hold the right shape for a few uses, but normally unfit materials produce items with the fragile quality. This racial trait alters skilled, replacing the racial bonus on Stealth checks.
modifies: replacing the racial bonus on stealth checks

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on driving checks and on Craft checks to build or repair weapons or vehicles without the proper tools.

alternateTraits.name: Over-Sized Ears
alternateTraits.description: While goblins' ears are never dainty, these goblins have freakishly large ears capable of picking up even the smallest sounds. Goblins with this racial trait gain a +4 bonus on Perception checks. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.sourceText: +4 bonus on Perception checks.

alternateTraits.name: Tree Runner
alternateTraits.description: In trackless rain forests and marshes, it can be difficult to find dry ground to build on. goblin tribes living in such areas have learned to live in the treetops. These goblins gain a +4 racial bonus on Acrobatics and Climb checks. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.sourceText: +4 racial bonus on Acrobatics and Climb checks.

alternateTraits.name: Weapon Familiarity
alternateTraits.description: Goblins' traditional weapons are the dogslicer and the horsechopper, weapons designed specifically to bring down their most hated foes. Goblins with this trait are proficient with the dogslicer and the horsechopper, and treat any weapon with the word "goblin" in it as martial weapons. This racial trait replaces skilled.

alternateTraits.name: Advantageous Distraction
alternateTraits.description: Advantageous Distraction

alternateTraits.description: Balloon Headed

alternateTraits.description: Big Ears

alternateTraits.description: Bouncy

alternateTraits.description: Color Thief

alternateTraits.description: Dog-Sniff-Hate

alternateTraits.description: Goblin Foolhardiness

alternateTraits.description: Pustular

alternateTraits.description: Rude Songs

alternateTraits.description: Ugly Swine

favoredClassBonuses.description: The alchemist gains fire resistance 1. Each time this reward is selected, increase fire resistance by +1. This fire resistance does not stack with fire resistance gained from other sources.

effects.sourceText: fire resistance 1

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add +1/2 on critical hit confirmation rolls for attacks made with unarmed strikes or natural weapons (maximum bonus of +4). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
Add +1 to the bard's total number of bardic performance rounds per day.
Add +1 hit points to the cavalier's mount companion. If the cavalier ever replaces his mount, the new mount gains these bonus hit points.
Add +1 hit points to the druid's animal companion. If the druid ever replaces her animal companion, the new animal companion gains these bonus hit points.
Add +1/3 on critical hit confirmation rolls made with firearms (maximum bonus of +5). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
Add +1 on concentration checks made when casting spells with the fire descriptor.
Gain a +1/2 bonus on damage dealt to dogs (and dog-like creatures) and horses (and horse-like creatures).
Add a +1 bonus on the rogue's sneak attack damage rolls during the surprise round or before the target has acted in combat.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add +1 spell known from the sorcerer spell list. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level the sorcerer can cast, and must have the fire descriptor.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Hobgoblins are fast and hardy. They gain +2 Dexterity, and +2 Constitution.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Hobgoblins are humanoids with the goblinoid subtype.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Hobgoblins are Medium creatures and thus have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Hobgoblins have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Hobgoblins begin play speaking Common and Goblin. Hobgoblins with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Draconic, Dwarven, Infernal, Giant, and Orc. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Sneaky
standardTraits.description: Hobgoblins receive a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks.

effects.sourceText: +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks.

standardTraits.name: Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Hobgoblins can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

alternateTraits.name: Authoritative
alternateTraits.description: Hobgoblins often develop a knack for controlling others. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks. Both skills are always class skills for them. This racial trait replaces sneaky.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks.

alternateTraits.name: Bandy-Legged
alternateTraits.description: Bandy-legged hobgoblins have an even more exaggerated stature than other hobgoblins, with bowed legs and massive shoulders. Hobgoblins with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Climb and Ride checks, and a +2 racial bonus to their CMD against bull rush or trip attempts while on solid ground. The base speed of bandy-legged hobgoblins is reduced to 20 feet.

effects.appliesWhen: against bull rush or trip attempts while on solid ground
effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Climb and Ride checks, and a +2 racial bonus to their CMD against bull rush or trip attempts while on solid ground.

alternateTraits.name: Battle-Hardened
alternateTraits.description: Incessant drills make defense second nature to some hobgoblins. Hobgoblins with this racial trait gain a +1 bonus to CMD. This racial trait replaces sneaky.

effects.sourceText: +1 bonus to CMD.

alternateTraits.name: Engineer
alternateTraits.description: hobgoblin engineers tinker endlessly with fire, explosives, and the engines of war. Hobgoblins with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy) and Knowledge (engineering) checks. This racial trait replaces sneaky.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy) and Knowledge (engineering) checks.

alternateTraits.name: Fearsome
alternateTraits.description: Some hobgoblins scorn caution and subtlety for swagger and bluster. Hobgoblins with this racial trait gain a +4 racial bonus on Intimidate checks. This racial trait replaces sneaky.

effects.sourceText: +4 racial bonus on Intimidate checks.

alternateTraits.name: Magehunter
alternateTraits.description: Hobgoblins hate and fear arcane casters. A magehunter gains a +2 racial bonus on Spellcraft checks made to identify a spell being cast and a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against arcane spellcasters. He only gains this bonus against creatures that use spells, and not against those that only use spell-like abilities. This racial trait replaces sneaky.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Spellcraft checks made to identify a spell being cast and a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against arcane spellcasters.

alternateTraits.name: Pit Boss
alternateTraits.description: Slave blood fuels the hobgoblin war machine. Pit bosses extract the last breath of labor from their charges with a liberal touch of the lash. Hobgoblins with this racial trait gain proficiency with whips and a +1 racial bonus on combat maneuver checks made to disarm or trip with a whip. This racial trait replaces sneaky.

effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus on combat maneuver checks made to disarm or trip with a whip.

alternateTraits.name: Scarred
alternateTraits.description: A hobgoblin can scar himself with both blade and fire to toughen his hide into a mass of horny scars. Hobgoblins with this racial trait gain a +1 natural armor bonus to Armor Class. However, the repeated exposure to fire permanently damages their eyes. This racial trait replaces the darkvision racial trait.

effects.sourceText: +1 natural armor bonus to Armor Class.

alternateTraits.name: Slave Hunter
alternateTraits.description: hobgoblin slavers excel at tracking down runaway slaves and surviving in filthy conditions. Hobgoblins with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Survival checks and a +2 racial bonus on Fortitude saves against disease. This racial trait replaces sneaky.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Survival checks and a +2 racial bonus on Fortitude saves against disease.

alternateTraits.name: Unfit
alternateTraits.description: Hobgoblins who failed to secure a position in the military hold the lowest status in hobgoblin society, and quickly learn the value of currying favor with their betters. Hobgoblins with this racial trait gain proficiency in a single martial weapon and +1 racial bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy checks. This racial trait replaces sneaky.

effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy checks.

Add a +1/2 bonus on Intimidate checks and Ride checks.

Add +1/4 to the gunslinger's grit points.
Add a +1 bonus on concentration checks made to cast inquisitor spells.
Add a +1/4 bonus on combat maneuver checks made to grapple or trip.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Ifrits are passionate and quick, but impetuous and destructive. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, and -2 Wisdom.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Ifrits are outsiders with the native subtype.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Ifrits are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Ifrits have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Ifrits begin play speaking Common and Ignan. Ifrits with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aquan, Auran, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Halfling, and Terran. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Energy Resistance
standardTraits.description: Ifrits have fire resistance 5.

effects.sourceText: fire resistance 5

standardTraits.name: Spell-Like Ability (Sp)
standardTraits.description: Ifrits can use burning hands 1/day as a spell-like ability (caster level equals the ifrit's level; DC 11 + Charisma modifier).

standardTraits.name: Fire Affinity
standardTraits.description: Ifrit sorcerers with the elemental (fire) bloodline treat their Charisma score as 2 points higher for all sorcerer spells and class abilities. Ifrit spellcasters with the Fire domain use their domain powers and spells at +1 caster level.

standardTraits.name: Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Ifrits can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

alternateTraits.name: Brazen Flame
alternateTraits.description: Ifrits sometimes flames infuse their weapons in mortal combat, rather than protect them or grant spells. An ifrit with this racial trait deals 1 point of fire damage with its melee attacks. This racial trait replaces the energy resistance and spell-like ability traits.

alternateTraits.name: Desert Mirage
alternateTraits.description: Ifrits thrive in the deserts of the world, where their keen instincts and resistance to heat give them a huge edge over their competitors. Those with this trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks in desert environments and on saves to resist starvation and thirst. This racial trait replaces fire affinity.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks in desert environments and on saves to resist starvation and thirst.

alternateTraits.name: Efreeti Magic
alternateTraits.description: Some ifrits inherit an efreeti ancestor's ability to magically change a creature's size. They can cast either enlarge person or reduce person (the ifrit chooses when using this ability) once per day as a spell-like ability (caster level equals the ifrit's level). The ifrit can use this ability to affect other ifrits as though they were humanoid creatures. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

alternateTraits.name: Fire in the Blood
alternateTraits.description: Ifrits with this racial trait mimic the healing abilities of the mephits, gaining fast healing 2 for 1 round anytime they take fire damage (whether or not this fire damage gets through their fire resistance). The ifrits can heal up to 2 hit points per level per day with this ability, after which it ceases to function. This racial trait replaces fire affinity.

alternateTraits.name: Fire Insight
alternateTraits.description: ifrit spellcasters sometimes find that their elemental heritage makes creatures of fire more willing to serve them. Summon monster and summon nature's ally spells that the ifrit casts last 2 rounds longer than normal when used to summon creatures with the fire subtype. This racial trait replaces fire affinity.

alternateTraits.name: Fire-Starter
alternateTraits.description: Ifrits with this racial trait derive sadistic satisfaction from watching others burn. Anytime the ifrit causes a creature to catch fire, he gains a +1 morale bonus on the next single attack roll, saving throw, skill check, or ability check that he makes in the next round. The ifrit only gains this bonus the first time he causes a particular creature to catch fire; subsequent times the creature catches fire provide no bonus. This racial trait replaces fire affinity.

effects.sourceText: +1 morale bonus on the next single attack roll, saving throw, skill check, or ability check that he makes in the next round.

alternateTraits.name: Forge-Hardened
alternateTraits.description: Not all ifrits are descended from efreet-some instead descend from azers or even salamanders. Such ifrits gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft (armor and weapons) checks and saves to resist fatigue and exhaustion. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Craft (armor and weapons) checks and saves to resist fatigue and exhaustion.

alternateTraits.name: Hypnotic
alternateTraits.description: Ifrits with this racial trait evoke the entrancing nature of flame, adding +1 to the DC for all saving throws against spells or effects they cast that inflict the fascinated condition. Once per day, when a creature rolls a saving throw against such an effect from the ifrit, the ifrit can spend an immediate action to force that creature to reroll the saving throw and use the second result, even if it is worse. The ifrit must announce he is using this ability before the results of the first roll are revealed. This racial trait replaces fire affinity.

alternateTraits.name: Mostly Human
alternateTraits.description: A few ifrits have appearances much closer to those of their human ancestors; in fact, they may not even realize their true race. Such geniekin appear to be human, save perhaps minor features like unusual eye color, and they count as humanoid (human) as well as outsider (native) for all purposes (such as humanoid-affecting spells such as charm person or enlarge person). These geniekin do not automatically gain their associated elemental language (but may select it as a bonus language if their Intelligence is high enough). This ability alters the geniekin's type, subtype, and languages.

alternateTraits.name: Wildfire Heart
alternateTraits.description: Ifrits with this trait are as swift and dangerous as a blazing wildfire. They gain a +4 racial bonus on initiative checks. This racial trait replaces energy resistance.

effects.sourceText: +4 racial bonus on initiative checks.

alternateTraits.name: Magma Affinity
alternateTraits.description: This racial trait functions as and can be replaced as the base ifrit's fire affinity, except it benefits sorcerers with the efreeti bloodline and spellcasters with the Ash subdomain.

alternateTraits.name: Solar Affinity
alternateTraits.description: This racial trait functions as and can be replaced as the base ifrit's fire affinity, except it benefits sorcerers with the celestial bloodline and spellcasters with the Sun domain.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add +1/2 to the alchemist's bomb damage.
Add +1/6 to the number of people the bard can affect with the fascinate bardic performance.
Add a +1/2 bonus on Knowledge (planes) checks relating to the Plane of Fire and creatures with the fire subtype.
Add +1/2 to the bonus on initiative checks the gunslinger makes while using her gunslinger initiative deed.
Add a +1/2 bonus on Intimidate checks made against creatures with the fire subtype and a +1/2 bonus on Knowledge (planes) checks relating to the Plane of Fire.
Add +1/6 to the oracle's level for the purpose of determining the effects of one revelation.
Add a +1/2 bonus on Acrobatics checks to jump and a +1/2 bonus on Intimidate checks to demoralize enemies.

Choose a bloodline power from the elemental (fire) bloodline or the efreeti bloodline that the sorcerer can use. The sorcerer treats her class level as though it were +1/6 higher (to a maximum of +4) when determining the effects of that power.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Kobolds are fast but weak. They gain +2 Dexterity, -4 Strength, and -2 Constitution.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Kobolds are humanoids with the reptilian subtype.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Kobolds are Small creatures and thus gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty on their combat maneuver checks and to Combat Maneuver Defense, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

effects.sourceText: +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty on their combat maneuver checks and to Combat Maneuver Defense, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Kobolds have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Kobolds begin play speaking only Draconic. Kobolds with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Common, Dwarven, Gnome, and Undercommon. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Armor
standardTraits.description: Kobolds naturally scaly skin grants them a +1 natural armor bonus.

standardTraits.name: Crafty
standardTraits.description: Kobolds gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft (trapmaking), Perception, and Profession (miner) checks. Craft (trapmaking) and Stealth are always class skills for a kobold.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Craft (trapmaking), Perception, and Profession (miner) checks.

standardTraits.name: Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Kobolds can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

standardTraits.name: Light Sensitivity
standardTraits.description: Kobolds lives in darkness have caused them to suffer from light sensitivity.

alternateTraits.name: Beast Bond
alternateTraits.description: Some kobolds have a talent for training animals and beasts to help them both on and off the battlefield. Kobolds with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Handle Animal and Ride checks. Handle Animal and Ride are always class skills for them. This racial trait replaces crafty.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Handle Animal and Ride checks.

alternateTraits.name: Day Raider
alternateTraits.description: You're one of the few kobolds born with a greater tolerance for sunlight. You don't have light sensitivity, and you have low-light vision instead of darkvision. This racial trait replaces light sensitivity and darkvision.

alternateTraits.name: Dragon Affinity
alternateTraits.description: Kobold sorcerers with the draconic bloodline or kobold bloodline treat their Charisma scores as 2 points higher for all sorcerer spells and class abilities. This racial trait replaces the armor trait.

alternateTraits.name: Dragonmaw
alternateTraits.description: Your draconic heritage makes you smile- not just because it makes you happy, but also because your powerful teeth and jaws are proof of your kinship with a chromatic dragon. You gain a bite attack that deals 1d4 points of damage. Once per day, you can deal 1d6 points of additional energy damage with your bite attack. The damage type depends on your scale color: acid for black or green; electricity for blue; fire for red; cold for white. If you have a different scale color, you still gain a bite attack, but cannot deal the additional energy damage. This racial traits replaces the armor racial trait.

alternateTraits.name: Dragon-Scaled
alternateTraits.description: Some kobolds are hatched with scales of such vivid color that their connection to a particular sort of chromatic dragon seems undeniable. Whether this coloration is just a quirk of a stray egg or a trait shared by all the members of a tribe, these kobolds gain a resistance that makes them especially suited to work alongside dragons matching the color of the kobold's scales. Black-scaled and green-scaled kobolds with this racial trait gain acid resistance 5. Blue-scaled kobolds with this racial trait gain electricity resistance 5. Red-scaled kobolds with this racial trait gain fire resistance 5. White-scaled kobolds with this racial trait gain cold resistance 5. This racial trait replaces the armor racial trait.

effects.sourceText: acid resistance 5
electricity resistance 5
fire resistance 5
cold resistance 5

alternateTraits.name: Echo Whistler
alternateTraits.description: By observing the noises in underground tunnels, you learned to uncannily mimic any voice or sound you heard. Three times per day, you can attempt to trick someone in this way by making a Bluff check against the listener's Sense Motive check. You get a +2 circumstance bonus on this check if you're in tunnels or other structures where your voice can echo. This racial trait replaces crafty.

alternateTraits.name: Frightener
alternateTraits.description: Like the great dragons, you can strike fear in the hearts of your foes with your majestic presence. Few enemies suspect that you make yourself look more dangerous with simple tricks you learned back when you were newly hatched. You gain a +1 racial bonus to the DC of saving throws against spells you cast with the fear descriptor. This racial trait replaces the armor racial trait.

effects.appliesWhen: against spells you cast with the fear descriptor
effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus to the DC of saving throws against spells you cast with the fear descriptor.

alternateTraits.name: Gliding Wings
alternateTraits.description: Some kobolds are born with wings that, while too weak for actual flying, do allow them to fall at a very slow and safe pace. A kobold with wings can use them to glide. It can make a DC 15 Fly check to fall safely from any height without taking falling damage, as if using feather fall. When falling safely, it may make an additional DC 15 Fly check to glide, moving 5 feet laterally for every 20 feet it falls. This racial trait replaces crafty.

alternateTraits.name: Jester
alternateTraits.description: Some kobolds swallow their pride and survive by groveling, placating, and amusing the powerful. Kobolds with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Perform checks. Diplomacy and Perform are always class skills for them. This racial trait replaces crafty.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Perform checks.

alternateTraits.name: Prehensile Tail
alternateTraits.description: Your tail is especially flexible and strong, so you've learned to use it for both movement and simple tricks. You gain a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics and Climb checks, and you can use your tail to draw a hidden weapon as a move action instead of as a standard action. This racial trait replaces the armor racial trait.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics and Climb checks, and you can use your tail to draw a hidden weapon as a move action instead of as a standard action.

alternateTraits.name: Secret Strider
alternateTraits.description: You have the ability to traverse the wilderness without a trace. Twice per day, you can move through natural surroundings without leaving a trail for 1 minute, increasing the DC of any attempts to track you by 10. This racial trait replaces crafty.

alternateTraits.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
alternateTraits.description: Having lived and worked in close quarters with your tribe-mates, you've learned how to maneuver within their personal space without disturbing them. You can occupy the same space as one other Small ally without penalty. If you share a space with another kobold who has this trait, you each gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC, as you help jostle one another out of the way of incoming attacks. You also gain a +1 racial bonus on aid another rolls. This racial trait replaces crafty.

effects.sourceText: +1 circumstance bonus to AC, as you help jostle one another out of the way of incoming attacks.

alternateTraits.name: Spellcaster Sneak
alternateTraits.description: Traversing the tunnels near big, nasty, hungry creatures, you learned to keep quiet- and to keep your spells quiet too. You gain a +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks, and once per day you can gain the benefit of the Silent Spell feat on a spell you cast. This racial trait replaces crafty.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks, and once per day you can gain the benefit of the Silent Spell feat on a spell you cast.

alternateTraits.name: Wild Forest Kobold
alternateTraits.description: You're one of the barbaric kobolds dwelling in the forests of the surface world. Your culture shuns artifice, but teaches how to endure the hunt. You gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception and Survival checks, and Stealth and Survival are always class skills for you. This racial trait replaces crafty.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Perception and Survival checks, and Stealth and Survival are always class skills for you.

alternateTraits.name: Wyrmcrowned
alternateTraits.description: Your horns have grown to the extent that they appear similar to those of a dragon who shares your scale color, lending a draconic power or menace to your dealings with others. Choose either Diplomacy or Intimidate. You gain a +2 racial bonus on checks with that skill, and it is always a class skill for you. This racial trait replaces crafty.

effects.sourceText: +4 bonus to Dexterity, but suffer a -2 penalty to Wisdom and Charisma.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Monkey goblins are Small creatures and thus gain a +1 size bonus to their AC and attack rolls, but suffer a -1 penalty to their CMD and on combat maneuver checks, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

effects.sourceText: +1 size bonus to their AC and attack rolls, but suffer a -1 penalty to their CMD and on combat maneuver checks, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

standardTraits.name: Natural Climber

standardTraits.name: Languages

standardTraits.name: Low-Light Vision

standardTraits.name: Prehensile Tail

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Orcs are brutal and savage. They gain +4 Strength, -2 Intelligence, -2 Wisdom, and -2 Charisma.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Orcs are humanoids with the orc subtype.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Orcs are Medium creatures and thus have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Orcs have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Orcs begin play speaking Common and Orc. Orcs with high Intelligence scores can chose from the following: Dwarven, Giant, Gnoll, Goblin, Undercommon. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Ferocity
standardTraits.description: Orcs possess the ferocity ability which allows them to remain conscious and continue fighting even if their hit point totals fall below 0. Orcs are still staggered at 0 hit points or lower and lose 1 hit point each round as normal.

standardTraits.name: Weapon Familiarity
standardTraits.description: Orcs are always proficient with greataxes and falchions, and treat any weapon with the word "orc" in its name as a martial weapon.

standardTraits.name: Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Orcs can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

standardTraits.name: Light Sensitivity
standardTraits.description: Orcs are dazzled in areas of bright sunlight or within the radius of a daylight spell.

alternateTraits.name: Dayrunner
alternateTraits.description: Orcs refuse to yield to any foe, including the sun. Some spend hour upon hour glaring at the sun until their ruined eyes acclimatize to bright light. Orcs with this racial trait take a -2 penalty on all ranged attack rolls. This racial trait replaces light sensitivity.

alternateTraits.name: Feral
alternateTraits.description: Orcs have the ability to fend for themselves long before they master the rudiments of their language and culture. Having needed to hunt bugs and tiny animals for food to survive while still infants, feral orcs fight all the harder to survive when at the brink of death. Orcs with this racial trait gain Survival as a class skill and gain a +1 racial bonus on melee weapon attack and damage rolls when at negative hit points. This racial trait replaces the orc's weapon familiarity and automatic languages. Feral orcs without additional languages due to high Intelligence scores or ranks in Linguistics can only communicate with grunts and gestures.

effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus on melee weapon attack and damage rolls when at negative hit points.

alternateTraits.name: Reckless Climber
alternateTraits.description: Mountain-dwelling orcs thrive on taking insane risks to defeat foes and show up rivals. They gain a +4 racial bonus on Climb checks without rope and on Acrobatics checks to maintain balance. This racial trait replaces ferocity.

effects.sourceText: +4 racial bonus on Climb checks without rope and on Acrobatics checks to maintain balance.

alternateTraits.name: Smeller
alternateTraits.description: Orcs with this racial trait gain a limited scent ability with half the normal range. This racial trait replaces ferocity and weapon familiarity.

alternateTraits.name: Squalid
alternateTraits.description: Some orcs exist in surroundings so filthy and pestilent that even other orcs would have difficulty living in them. Orcs with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws made to resist nausea, the sickened condition, and disease. This racial trait replaces ferocity.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on saving throws made to resist nausea, the sickened condition, and disease.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add +10 minutes to the duration of the alchemist's mutagens.
Add +1 to the barbarian's total number of rage rounds per day.
Add +1 to the cavalier's CMB when making bull rush or overrun combat maneuvers against a challenged target.
Add +1/2 to the damage dealt by the druid's animal companion's natural attacks.
Add +2 to the Fighter's Constitution score for the purpose of determining when he dies from negative hit points.
Add +1 hit point to the ranger's animal companion. If the ranger ever replaces his animal companion, the new animal companion gains these bonus hit points.

Add one spell from the witch spell list to the witch's familiar. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level she can cast. If the witch ever replaces her familiar, the new familiar knows these bonus spells.
The bard gains a +1/6 bonus to his inspire competence ability.
Add +1/2 point of fire damage to cleric spells cast that deal fire damage.
Add a +1/3 bonus on attack rolls when using the pistol whip deed.
Add +1/2 to the attack roll bonus when the inquisitor is at or below 0 hit points.
Add +1/2 point of fire damage to magus spells cast that deal fire damage.
Add +1 to the monk's CMD when resisting a grapple and +1/2 to the number of stunning attacks he can attempt per day.

Reduce the penalty for not being proficient with one weapon by 1. When the nonproficiency penalty for a weapon becomes 0 because of this ability, the oracle is treated as having the appropriate Martial or Exotic Weapon Proficiency feat with that weapon.
Add +1/3 on critical hit confirmation rolls made while using smite evil (maximum bonus of +5). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
Add +1/2 to damage rolls when the rogue is at or below 0 hit points.
Add +1/2 point of fire damage to sorcerer spells cast that deal fire damage.
Add +1 hit point to the summoner's eidolon.
Add a +1 bonus on concentration checks made due to taking damage while casting wizard spells.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Oreads are strong, solid, stable, and stoic. They gain +2 Strength, +2 Wisdom, and -2 Charisma.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Oreads are outsiders with the native subtype.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Oreads are Medium creatures and thus have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Speed (Slow)
standardTraits.description: Oreads have a base speed of 20 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Oreads begin play speaking Common and Terran. Oreads with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aquan, Auran, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Halfling, Ignan, and Undercommon. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Energy Resistance
standardTraits.description: Oreads have acid resistance 5.

effects.sourceText: acid resistance 5

standardTraits.name: Spell-Like Ability (Sp)
standardTraits.description: Oread can use magic stone 1/day (caster level equals the oread's total level; DC 11 + Charisma modifier).

standardTraits.name: Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Oreads can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

standardTraits.name: Earth Affinity
standardTraits.description: Oread sorcerers with the elemental (earth) bloodline treat their Charisma score as 2 points higher for all sorcerer spells and class abilities. Oread clerics with the Earth domain use their domain powers and spells at +1 caster level.

alternateTraits.name: Crystalline Form
alternateTraits.description: Oreads with this trait gain a +2 racial bonus to AC against rays thanks to their reflective crystalline skin. In addition, once per day, they can deflect a single ray attack targeted at them as if they were using the Deflect Arrows feat. This racial trait replaces earth affinity.

effects.appliesWhen: against rays thanks to their reflective crystalline skin
effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus to AC against rays thanks to their reflective crystalline skin.

alternateTraits.name: Earth Insight
alternateTraits.description: Oread spellcasters sometimes find that their elemental heritage makes creatures of earth more willing to serve them. Summon monster and summon nature's ally spells that such oreads cast last 2 rounds longer than normal when used to summon creatures with the earth subtype. This racial trait replaces earth affinity.

alternateTraits.name: Ferrous Growth
alternateTraits.description: Oreads with this racial trait learn how to mimic the magic of their shaitan ancestors. Once per day, such an oread can cause a touched piece of non-magical iron or steel to grow into an object up to 10 pounds in weight, such as a sword, crowbar, or light steel shield. This object remains in this form for 10 minutes or until broken or destroyed, at which point it shrinks back to its original size and shape. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

alternateTraits.name: Fertile Soil
alternateTraits.description: Oread sorcerers with the verdant bloodline treat their Charisma score as 2 points higher for all sorcerer spells and class abilities. Oread clerics with the Plant domain use their domain powers and spells at +1 caster level. This racial trait replaces earth affinity.

alternateTraits.name: Granite Skin
alternateTraits.description: Rocky growths cover the skin of oreads with this racial trait. They gain a +1 racial bonus to natural armor. This racial trait replaces energy resistance.

alternateTraits.name: Isolated
alternateTraits.description: Many oreads are loners and raise their families in isolated groups, either in deep caverns or high mountains. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks and Knowledge (dungeoneering) checks, and they can use Knowledge (dungeoneering) untrained. They begin play speaking only Terran, rather than Common and Terran. This racial trait replaces energy resistance and alters the oread's starting languages.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Perception checks and Knowledge (dungeoneering) checks, and they can use Knowledge (dungeoneering) untrained.

alternateTraits.name: Mountain-Born
alternateTraits.description: Oreads are drawn to mountains and other high places, and after many generations they've grown well suited to their environment. Oreads with this racial trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics checks made to cross narrow ledges and on saves against altitude fatigue and sickness. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics checks made to cross narrow ledges and on saves against altitude fatigue and sickness.

alternateTraits.name: Mostly Human
alternateTraits.description: A few oreads have appearances much closer to those of their human ancestors; in fact, they may not even realize their true race. Such geniekin appear to be human, save perhaps minor features like unusual eye color, and they count as humanoid (human) as well as outsider (native) for all purposes (such as humanoid-affecting spells such as charm person or enlarge person). These geniekin do not automatically gain their associated elemental language (but may select it as a bonus language if their Intelligence is high enough). This ability alters the geniekin's type, subtype, and languages.

alternateTraits.name: Oread Gem Magic (1 RP)
alternateTraits.description: Oreads' proclivity for long spans of study and concentration makes them natural wizards, witches, and oracles. Oreads with this racial trait can augment their earth-related spells and spell-like abilities through the use of precious and semiprecious gemstones as additional material components (see Table: Oread Gem Magic below). The gems are destroyed in the process, granting the spell the listed effects in addition to its normal effects unless otherwise noted. Only one instance of oread gem magic can be applied to a spell at a time; excess expended gems do not stack. This racial trait replaces the earth affinity racial trait.

alternateTraits.name: Stone in the Blood
alternateTraits.description: Oreads with this racial trait mimic the healing abilities of the mephits, gaining fast healing 2 for 1 round anytime they are subject to acid damage (the acid damage does not need to overcome the oread's resistances or immunities to activate this ability). The oread can heal up to 2 hit points per level per day with this ability, after which it ceases to function. This racial trait replaces earth affinity.

alternateTraits.name: Treacherous Earth
alternateTraits.description: Once per day, an oread with this racial trait can will the earth to rumble and shift, transforming a 10-foot-radius patch of earth, unworked stone, or sand into an area of difficult terrain, centered on an area the oread touches. This lasts for a number of minutes equal to the oread's level, after which the ground returns to normal. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

alternateTraits.name: Crystal Affinity
alternateTraits.description: This racial trait functions as and can be replaced as the base oread's earth affinity, except it benefits sorcerers with the deep earth bloodline and spellcasters with the Charm domain.

alternateTraits.name: Metal Affinity
alternateTraits.description: This racial trait functions as and can be replaced as the base oread's earth affinity, except it benefits sorcerers with the shaitan bloodline and spellcasters with the Metal subdomain.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add +5 feet to the range of one of the bard's bardic performances (max +30 feet to any one performance).
Add a +1/2 bonus on Knowledge (planes) checks relating to the Plane of Earth and creatures with the earth subtype.
Add a +1/2 bonus on Knowledge (nature) checks relating to plants and burrowing animals.
Add +1 to the Fighter's CMD when resisting a bull rush or drag attempt.
Add +1/3 on critical hit confirmation rolls made with unarmed strikes (maximum bonus of +5). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
Add +1/4 to the bonus the paladin grants her allies with her aura of courage and aura of resolve special abilities.
Add +1/4 to the natural armor bonus of the ranger's animal companion. If the ranger ever replaces his animal companion, the new animal companion gains this bonus.
Add a +1/4 natural armor bonus to the AC of the summoner's eidolon.

races.skillBonuses: Craft (alchemy), Handle Animal (+4), Perception, Use Magic Device
races.name: Ratfolk

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Ratfolk are agile and clever, yet physically weak. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, and -2 Strength.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Ratfolk are humanoids with the ratfolk subtype.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Ratfolk are Small and thus gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty on combat maneuver checks and to their CMD, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

effects.sourceText: +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty on combat maneuver checks and to their CMD, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

standardTraits.name: Speed (Slow)
standardTraits.description: Ratfolk have a base speed of 20 ft.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Ratfolk begin play speaking Common. Ratfolk with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aklo, Draconic, Dwarven, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Halfling, Orc, and Undercommon. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Tinker
standardTraits.description: Ratfolk gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy), Perception, and Use Magic Device checks.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy), Perception, and Use Magic Device checks.

standardTraits.name: Rodent Empathy
standardTraits.description: Ratfolk gain a +4 racial bonus on Handle Animal checks made to influence rodents.

standardTraits.name: Swarming
standardTraits.description: Ratfolk are used to living and fighting communally, and are adept at swarming foes for their own gain and their foes' detriment. Up to two ratfolk can share the same square at the same time. If two ratfolk in the same square attack the same foe, they are considered to be flanking that foe as if they were in two opposite squares.

standardTraits.name: Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Ratfolk can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

alternateTraits.name: Cornered Fury
alternateTraits.description: Ratfolk can fight viciously when cut off from friends and allies. Whenever a ratfolk with this racial trait is reduced to half or fewer of his hit points, and has no conscious ally within 30 feet, he gains a +2 racial bonus on melee attack rolls and to Armor Class. This racial trait replaces swarming.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on melee attack rolls and to Armor Class.

alternateTraits.name: Market Dweller
alternateTraits.description: Some ratfolk are practiced at taking advantage of foes. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Bluff, Sense Motive, and Sleight of Hand checks. This racial trait replaces tinker.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Bluff, Sense Motive, and Sleight of Hand checks.

alternateTraits.name: Scent
alternateTraits.description: Some ratfolk have much more strongly developed senses of smell, instead of keen eyes and ears. These ratfolk have the scent ability, but take a -2 penalty on all Perception checks based primarily on sight or hearing. This racial trait replaces tinker.

alternateTraits.name: Skulk
alternateTraits.description: Some ratfolk can blend easily into their environments, and move with surprising grace. Ratfolk gain a +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks, and take only a -5 penalty on Stealth checks made to hide from creatures they have distracted with a Bluff check (rather than the normal -10 penalty). This racial trait replaces tinker.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks, and take only a -5 penalty on Stealth checks made to hide from creatures they have distracted with a Bluff check (rather than the normal -10 penalty).

alternateTraits.name: Unnatural
alternateTraits.description: Some ratfolk unnerve normal animals, and train to defend themselves against the inevitable attacks from such creatures. These ratfolk take a -4 penalty on all Charisma-based skill checks to affect creatures of the animal type, and receive a +2 dodge bonus to AC against animals. An animal's starting attitude toward ratfolk is one step worse than normal. This racial trait replaces rodent empathy.

effects.sourceText: +2 dodge bonus to AC against animals.

favoredClassBonuses.description: The alchemist gains +1/6 of a new discovery.
Add 1/3 to the number of times per day the arcanist can use the consume magic items exploit.
When raging, add +1/4 to the barbarian's swarming trait's flanking bonus on attack rolls.
Increase the bonus provided by the bard's inspire competence performance by 1/6, and add 1/6 to the number of allies the bard can affect with his inspire greatness performance.
Add a +1 bonus on wild empathy checks made to influence animals and magical beasts that live underground.
Add +1 to the Fighter's CMD when resisting a bull rush or grapple attempt.
Add a +1/2 bonus on initiative checks when the gunslinger has at least 1 grit point.
Add 1 skill rank to the hunter's badger, dire rat, or riding rat (Pathfinder RPG Monster Codex 177) animal companion.
Add 1/2 to Sense Motive checks and Knowledge (dungeoneering) checks to identify creatures.

Add 1 to the bonus provided to a single skill (maximum +2) by inspiration. This skill must be one to which the investigator can already apply inspiration. The investigator can select a different skill at each level.

Add +1 feet to the speed the monk can move while making a Stealth check without taking a penalty. This has no effect unless the monk has selected this reward five times (or another increment of five). This does not allow the monk to use Stealth while running or charging.
Gain a +1 bonus on concentration checks to maintain the mesmerist's hypnotic stare.
Gain 1/6 of a new focus power.
Gain 1/6 of a new phrenic amplification.
Add +1 to an animal companion's CMD when adjacent to the ranger. If the ranger ever replaces his animal companion, the new animal companion gains this bonus.
Add a +1/2 bonus on Escape Artist checks.
Add 1/2 hit point and 1/2 skill point to the spiritualist's phantom.
Add a +1 bonus on saving throws against poison made by the summoner's eidolon.

effects.appliesWhen: against poison made by the summoner's eidolon
effects.sourceText: +1 bonus on saving throws against poison made by the summoner's eidolon.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add 1/4 to the AC bonus provided by cover or improved cover.
Add +5 feet to the range of one hex with a range other than "touch."

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Skinwalkers are well attuned to the natural order of things and value passion above reason. They gain +2 Wisdom, -2 Intelligence, and +2 to one physical ability score while shapechanged (1 RP). While in their bestial form, they gain a +2 racial bonus to either Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution (see Change Shape). Skinwalkers of specific heritages (see below) gain different ability score modifiers, as indicated.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus to either Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution (see Change Shape).

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Skinwalkers are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Skinwalkers are humanoids with the skinwalker and shapechanger subtypes.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Skinwalkers have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Skinwalkers speak Common. Skinwalkers with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want (except secret languages, such as Druidic).

standardTraits.name: Animal-Minded (2 RP)
standardTraits.description: Skinwalkers have a +2 racial bonus on Handle Animal and wild empathy checks. Skinwalkers of specific heritages gain a +2 bonus to different checks as indicated.

standardTraits.name: Change Shape (Su, 5 RP)
standardTraits.description: A skinwalker can change shape to and from a bestial form as a standard action. In bestial form, a skinwalker gains a +2 racial bonus to either Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. While in this form, a skinwalker also takes on an animalistic feature that provides a special effect. Each time a skinwalker assumes bestial form, she can choose to gain one of the following features: 2 claw attacks that each deal 1d4 points of damage

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus to either Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution.

standardTraits.name: Darkvision to a range of 60 feet.
standardTraits.description: Darkvision to a range of 60 feet.

standardTraits.name: +1 racial bonus to natural armor.
standardTraits.description: +1 racial bonus to natural armor.

standardTraits.name: Spell-Like Ability
standardTraits.description: Skinwalkers with a Wisdom score of 11 or higher can use speak with animals once per day as a spell-like ability. The caster level for this ability is equal to the skinwalker's character level. Skinwalkers of specific heritages gain other spell-like abilities.

standardTraits.name: Low-Light Vision (Ex)
standardTraits.description: Skinwalkers can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

standardTraits.name: Marked by Nature's Magic
standardTraits.category: Race Traits
standardTraits.description: Marked by Nature's Magic

standardTraits.name: Mastery of Form
standardTraits.category: Race Traits
standardTraits.description: Mastery of Form

standardTraits.name: Traumatic Shift
standardTraits.category: Race Traits
standardTraits.description: Traumatic Shift

alternateTraits.name: Beast Talker
alternateTraits.description: Some skinwalkers' ability to communicate with animals is stronger than their ability to transform. Such skinwalkers can only use their change shape ability once per day for 1 minute per level, but they can use their speak with animals spell-like ability at will. This racial trait alters the change shape and spell-like ability racial traits.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: Sylphs are quick and insightful, but slight and delicate. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, and -2 Constitution.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Sylphs are outsiders with the native subtype.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Sylphs are Medium creatures and thus have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Speed
standardTraits.description: Sylphs have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Sylphs begin play speaking Common and Auran. Sylphs with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aquan, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Halfling, Ignan, and Terran. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Energy Resistance
standardTraits.description: Sylphs have electricity resistance 5.

effects.sourceText: electricity resistance 5

standardTraits.name: Spell-Like Ability (Sp)
standardTraits.description: Sylphs can use feather fall 1/day (caster level equals the sylph's total level).

standardTraits.name: Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Sylphs can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

standardTraits.name: Air Affinity
standardTraits.description: Sylph sorcerers with the elemental (air) bloodline treat their Charisma score as 2 points higher for all sorcerer spells and class abilities. Sylph spellcasters with the Air domain use their domain powers and spells at +1 caster level.

alternateTraits.name: Air Insight
alternateTraits.description: Sylph spellcasters sometimes find that their elemental heritage makes creatures of air more willing to serve them. Summon monster and summon nature's ally spells that the Sylph casts last 2 rounds longer than normal when used to summon creatures with the air subtype. This racial trait replaces air affinity.

alternateTraits.name: Breeze-Kissed
alternateTraits.description: Breezes seem to follow most sylphs wherever they go, but some sylphs are better able to control these winds than others. A Sylph with this racial trait surrounds herself with swirling winds, gaining a +2 racial bonus to AC against non-magical ranged attacks. The Sylph can calm or renew these winds as a swift action. Once per day, the Sylph can channel this wind into a single gust, making a bull rush or trip combat maneuver attempt against one creature within 30 feet. Whether or not the attempt succeeds, the winds are exhausted and no longer provide a bonus to the sylph's AC for 24 hours. This is a supernatural ability. This racial trait replaces air affinity.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus to AC against non-magical ranged attacks.

alternateTraits.name: Like the Wind
alternateTraits.description: A sylph with this racial trait gains a +5 foot bonus to her base speed. This racial trait replaces energy resistance.

alternateTraits.name: Mostly Human
alternateTraits.description: A few sylphs have appearances much closer to those of their human ancestors; in fact, they may not even realize their true race. Such geniekin appear to be human, save perhaps minor features like unusual eye color, and they count as humanoid (human) as well as outsider (native) for all purposes (such as humanoid-affecting spells such as charm person or enlarge person). These geniekin do not automatically gain their associated elemental language (but may select it as a bonus language if their Intelligence is high enough). This ability alters the geniekin's type, subtype, and languages.

alternateTraits.name: Sky Speaker
alternateTraits.description: Sylphs with this racial trait feel kinship toward the creatures of the air, and can use speak with animals once per day to speak to birds or other flying animals. Her caster level for these effects is equal to her level. This racial trait replaces the sylph's spell-like ability racial trait.

alternateTraits.name: Secretive
alternateTraits.description: Sylphs gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against enchantment and divination spells and effects. This racial trait replaces energy resistance and the spell-like ability racial trait.

effects.appliesWhen: against enchantment and divination spells and effects
effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against enchantment and divination spells and effects.

alternateTraits.name: Storm in the Blood
alternateTraits.description: A sylph with this racial trait gains fast healing 2 for 1 round anytime she takes electricity damage (whether or not this electricity damage gets through her electricity resistance). The sylph can heal up to 2 hit points per level per day with this ability, after which it ceases to function. This racial trait replaces air affinity.

alternateTraits.name: Thunderous Resilience
alternateTraits.description: Sylphs with this racial trait gain sonic resistance 5. This racial trait replaces energy resistance.

effects.sourceText: sonic resistance 5

alternateTraits.name: Weather Savvy
alternateTraits.description: Some sylphs are so in tune with the air and sky that they can sense the slightest change in atmospheric conditions. Sylphs with this trait can spend a full-round action to predict the weather in an area for the next 24 hours. The sylph's prediction is always accurate, but cannot account for spells or supernatural effects that might alter the forecast. This racial trait replaces the sylph's spell-like ability racial trait.

alternateTraits.name: Whispering Wind
alternateTraits.description: Some sylphs are especially thin and wispy, as though they were made more of air than flesh. Sylphs with this racial trait gain a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks. This racial trait replaces the sylph's spell-like ability racial trait.

effects.sourceText: +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks.

alternateTraits.name: Smoke Affinity
alternateTraits.description: This racial trait functions as and can be replaced as the base sylph's air affinity, except it benefits sorcerers with the shadow bloodline and spellcasters with the Smoke subdomain.

alternateTraits.name: Lightning Affinity
alternateTraits.description: This racial trait functions as and can be replaced as the base sylph's air affinity, except it benefits sorcerers with the stormborn bloodline and spellcasters with the Weather domain.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add a +1/2 bonus on Knowledge (planes) checks relating to the Plane of Air and creatures with the air subtype.
Add a +1/2 bonus on Knowledge (nature) checks relating to weather and flying animals.
Add a +1/2 bonus on Stealth checks while motionless and on opposed Perception checks.
Add +1/6 to the oracle's level for the purpose of determining the effects of one revelation.
Add a +1/2 bonus on Acrobatics checks to jump and a +1/2 bonus on Sense Motive checks.

Choose a bloodline power from the djinni or elemental (air) bloodline that the sorcerer can use. The sorcerer treats her class level as though it were +1/6 higher (to a maximum of +2) when determining the effects of that power.
Add a +1/2 bonus on Stealth checks and Perception checks made by the witch's familiar. If the Sylph ever replaces her familiar, the new familiar gains these bonus skill ranks.

Select one arcane school power from the air or wood elemental schools that the wizard can currently use. The wizard treats her class level as though it were +1/6 higher (to a maximum of +2) when determining the effects of that power.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Triaxians are a hardy and wily race, as befits their constantly changing environment, but their lean forms have trouble maintaining large amounts of muscle mass. They gain +2 Constitution, +2 Wisdom, -2 Strength

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Triaxians are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Speed
standardTraits.description: Triaxians have a base speed of 30 ft.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Triaxians speak Triaxian. Triaxians with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages (except secret languages, such as Druidic).

standardTraits.name: Low-Light Vision
standardTraits.description: Triaxians can see twice as far as humans in dim light.

standardTraits.name: Keen Senses
standardTraits.description: Triaxians' unique ear construction grants them a +2 bonus on Perception checks.

effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on Perception checks.

alternateTraits.name: Transitional Lore
alternateTraits.description: Transitional triaxians are often instilled from a young age with the lore they need to prepare for the next winter or summer; they gain a +1 racial bonus on Knowledge (nature) and Survival checks. This racial trait replaces seasoned.

effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus on Knowledge (nature) and Survival checks.
