standardTraits.description: Kasathas are nimble and perceptive. They gain +2 Dexterity and +2 Wisdom) (2 RP)

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Humanoid (kasatha) (0 RP)

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Kasathas are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size. (0 RP)

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Kasathas have a base speed of 30 feet. (0 RP)

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Kasathas speak Common and Kasatha. A kasatha with a high Intelligence score can choose from the following: Dwarven, Draconic, Gnoll, Orc, and Sphinx. (0 RP)

standardTraits.name: Defensive Training, Greater
standardTraits.description: Kasathas have a +2 dodge bonus to Armor Class. (4 RP)

effects.sourceText: +2 dodge bonus to Armor Class.

standardTraits.name: Desert Runner
standardTraits.description: Kasathas have a +4 racial bonus on Constitution checks and Fortitude saves to avoid fatigue, exhaustion, and other ill effects from running, forced marches, starvation, thirst, and hot or cold environments. (2 RP)

effects.sourceText: +4 racial bonus on Constitution checks and Fortitude saves to avoid fatigue, exhaustion, and other ill effects from running, forced marches, starvation, thirst, and hot or cold environments.

standardTraits.name: Stalker
standardTraits.description: Perception and Stealth are class skills for kasathas. (1 RP)

standardTraits.name: Spinal Sword Proficiency
standardTraits.description: Kasathas treat kasatha spinal swords as martial weapons.

standardTraits.name: Jumper
standardTraits.description: Kasathas are always considered to have a running start when attempting Acrobatics checks to jump. (2 RP)

standardTraits.name: Desert Stride
standardTraits.description: Kasathas move through non-magical difficult terrain in desert environments at normal speed. (1 RP)

standardTraits.name: Multi-Armed
standardTraits.description: A kasatha has four arms. One hand is considered its primary hand; all others are considered off hands. It can use any of its hands for other purposes that require free hands. (4 arms; 8 RP)

alternateTraits.name: Stealthy
alternateTraits.description: Kasatha must often take great pains to hide their existence from others. Such kasathas gain a +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks. Stealth is always a class skill for them. This racial trait replaces jumper and stalker.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Lashunta are almost universally intelligent and eager to learn. As a result, lashunta gain a +2 bonus to Intelligence.

effects.sourceText: +2 bonus to Intelligence.

standardTraits.name: Sexual Dimorphism
standardTraits.description: Male and female lashunta have very different body and personality types, more so than most humanoid species. Male lashunta are muscular (+2 Strength) and often brash and unobservant (-2 Wisdom). Female lashunta, though beautiful and commanding (+2 Charisma), lack the males' rugged builds (-2 Constitution).

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Lashunta are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Lashunta have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Lashunta begin play speaking Elven and Lashunta. Lashunta with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want (except Druidic and other secret languages). See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Knowledgeable
standardTraits.description: A lashunta gains a +2 racial bonus to any one Knowledge skill.

standardTraits.name: Lashunta Magic (5 RP)
standardTraits.description: A lashunta possessing an Intelligence score of 11 or higher gains the following spell-like abilities: At will-daze, mage hand; 1/day-detect thoughts. The caster level for these effects is equal to the lashunta's class levels.

standardTraits.name: Limited Telepathy (3 RP)
standardTraits.description: A lashunta is able to mentally communicate with any creature within 30 feet with whom she shares a language. Otherwise this ability is identical to the telepathy ability.

alternateTraits.name: Insidious Telepathy
alternateTraits.description: Some lashunta have a knack for manipulating the minds of those they communicate with telepathically. They gain a +1 racial bonus on Charisma-based skill checks to influence any creature with whom they are telepathically communicating. If a lashunta telepathically issues a command to a charmed or dominated creature, she gains a +1 racial bonus on Charisma checks to compel the creature to follow that order. This racial trait replaces lashunta magic.

effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus on Charisma-based skill checks to influence any creature with whom they are telepathically communicating.
+1 racial bonus on Charisma checks to compel the creature to follow that order.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Shabti have powerful bodies and presences to match. They gain +2 Constitution and +2 Charisma.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Shabti are outsiders with the native subtype.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Shabti are Medium creatures and receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Speed
standardTraits.description: Shabti have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Shabti begin play speaking Common. Those with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want (except secret languages, such as Druidic).

standardTraits.name: Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Shabti can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

standardTraits.name: Immortal (1 RP)
standardTraits.description: Shabti do not age naturally and cannot die of old age. While some might come into being at age categories other than adulthood, they never leave their original age category. Spells and effects that cause aging affect a shabti as normal.

standardTraits.name: Immune to Undeath (1 RP)
standardTraits.description: Shabti can't become undead. Spells and abilities that would transform a shabti into an undead creature have no effect.

standardTraits.name: Resist Level Drain (1 RP)
standardTraits.description: A shabti takes no penalties from energy drain effects, though he can still be killed if he accrues more negative levels than he has Hit Dice. After 24 hours, any negative levels a shabti takes are automatically removed without the need for an additional saving throw.

standardTraits.name: Past Life Knowledge (2 RP)
standardTraits.description: Shabti remember bits of their past lives. As a result, they treat all Knowledge skills as class skills.

standardTraits.name: Shattered Soul (-1 RP)
standardTraits.description: Shabti who are killed are exceptionally difficult to return to life. Those who attempt to return a shabti to life using raise dead, resurrection, or similar spells must succeed at a caster level check equal to 10 + the shabti's Hit Dice. If this check fails, the spell fails and the caster can't return the shabti to life for the next 24 hours (though the caster can try again after this period).

standardTraits.name: Spell-Like Ability (3 RP)
standardTraits.description: Shabti can use suggestion once per day as a spell-like ability, with the caster level equal to the shabti's class level.

alternateTraits.name: Blank Slate
alternateTraits.description: Some shabti are bereft of memories of their past lives but can accomplish great improvisations. Shabti with this racial trait can, once per day as a free action, treat any skill as though they had a number of ranks equal to half of their character levels for one skill check (minimum 1 rank). This racial trait replaces past life knowledge.

alternateTraits.name: Facsimile
alternateTraits.description: A few shabti are made with such skill they are nearly perfect copies of a mortal. Shabti with this racial trait appear to be human, save perhaps for minor features like unusual skin color. They count as humanoid (human) as well as outsider (native) for all purposes (such as humanoid-affecting spells like charm person). This racial trait replaces immune to undeath and alters the native subtype.

alternateTraits.name: Pharaonic Will
alternateTraits.description: Rather than working to influence others, some shabti focus inward. Once per day as an immediate action after failing a save against a charm, compulsion, or fear effect, a shabti with this racial trait can reroll the save with a +2 racial bonus. This racial trait replaces spell-like ability.

alternateTraits.name: Soul Sympathy
alternateTraits.description: Crafted to suffer punishments intended for their masters, some shabti can use this mortal connection to serve as reciprocal conduits. As an immediate action after being afflicted by temporary negative levels, a shabti with this racial trait can force the creature that inflicted the negative levels to suffer the same cumulative penalties, hit point loss, and caster level reduction. The shabti can use this ability only on an enemy within 60 feet and can share penalties with only one creature at a time. The shabti can sever this link as a free action. This racial trait replaces resist level drain.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add 1/2 to the bard's bardic knowledge bonus.
Add 1/4 to the bloodrager's effective class level when determining the power of her bloodrager bloodline powers.
Add 1/6 rounds to the duration of the investigator's studied combat.
Add 1/5 to the bonus allies gain from shared séance. This doesn't increase the medium's séance boon.

Add one spell from the psychic spell list that isn't on the cleric spell list to the list of spells the oracle knows. This spell must be at least 1 level below the highest spell level the oracle can cast.
Add 1/2 to the paladin's level when determining the effect of smite evil against incorporeal and ethereal creatures.
Add 1/4 to a single existing favored terrain bonus (maximum bonus +1 per favored terrain).

Add one spell from the psychic spell list that isn't on the shaman spell list to the list of spells the shaman knows. This spell must be at least 1 level below the highest spell level the shaman can cast.
Add 1/2 to the skald's bardic knowledge bonus.
Add 1 foot to the limit of etheric tether. This includes how far the spiritualist's phantom can be before needing to concentrate and before the tether is broken.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Syrinx are contemplative and patient, traits that make them somewhat slow to act. As a result, syrinx gain a +2 bonus to Wisdom but suffer a -2 penalty to Dexterity.

effects.sourceText: +2 bonus to Wisdom but suffer a -2 penalty to Dexterity.

standardTraits.name: Speed
standardTraits.description: Syrinx have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Flight
standardTraits.description: Syrinx have a fly speed of 60 feet with average maneuverability.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Syrinx begin play speaking Syrinx. Syrinx with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Auran, Celestial, Strix, or Infernal. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Pride (2 RP)
standardTraits.description: Syrinx receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects.

standardTraits.name: Nocturnal
standardTraits.description: Syrinx gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception and Stealth checks at night.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Perception and Stealth checks at night.

standardTraits.name: Speak with Avians (0 RP)
standardTraits.description: Syrinx can speak with all birds of the animal creature type and birdlike magical beasts (like phoenixes and thunderbirds).

standardTraits.name: Low-Light Vision
standardTraits.description: Syrinx can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

standardTraits.name: Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Syrinx have darkvision and so can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

alternateTraits.name: Oppressive
alternateTraits.description: Syrinxes often have a natural talent for sensing how to unsettle and oppress other creatures. As a swift action, a syrinx can attempt a Sense Motive check against a DC of 10 + a creature's Hit Dice + its Charisma modifier or a DC of 10 + the creature's Bluff modifier, whichever is higher. On a success, syrinx gains a +4 racial bonus on Intimidate checks against that target and a +1 racial bonus to the DC of any fear effects she uses against that target. This racial trait replaces nocturnal and pride.

effects.appliesWhen: against that target and a +1 racial bonus to the DC of any fear effects she uses against that target
effects.sourceText: +4 racial bonus on Intimidate checks against that target and a +1 racial bonus to the DC of any fear effects she uses against that target.

races.name: Suli

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: Sulis are brawny and charming, but slow-witted. They gain +2 Strength, +2 Charisma, and -2 Intelligence.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Sulis are outsiders with the native subtype.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Sulis are Medium creatures and thus have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Sulis have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Sulis begin play speaking Common and one elemental language (Aquan, Auran, Ignan, or Terran). Sulis with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aquan, Auran, Draconic, Ignan, and Terran. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Energy Resistance 5
standardTraits.description: Sulis have resistance to acid 5, cold 5, electricity 5, and fire 5.

standardTraits.name: Negotiator
standardTraits.description: Sulis are keen negotiators, and gain a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Sense Motive checks.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Sense Motive checks.

standardTraits.name: Elemental Assault (Su)
standardTraits.description: Once per day as a swift action, a suli can shroud her arms in acid, cold, electricity, or fire. This lasts for one round per level, and can be dismissed as a free action. Unarmed strikes with her arms or hands (or attacks with weapons held in those hands) deal +1d6 points of damage of the appropriate energy type.

standardTraits.name: Low-Light Vision
standardTraits.description: Sulis can see twice as far as humans in dim light.

alternateTraits.name: Energy Strike (Su)
alternateTraits.description: A suli with this racial trait has a stronger connection to one energy type than to the other three used by sulis. Choose one energy type: acid, cold, electricity, or fire. The suli's elemental assault ability can only deal energy damage of this type. The suli has resistance 5 to this energy type and no racial resistance to the other three types. While her elemental assault is active, the suli gains an additional ability based on the chosen energy type. This racial trait otherwise works like and replaces elemental assault. Earthfoot (acid): Whenever the suli moves through difficult terrain related to earth and stone (rubble, mud, sand, and so on), she may move through 5 feet of that difficult terrain each round as if it were normal terrain. This allows the suli to take a 5-foot step into that difficult terrain. Other kinds of difficult terrain (ice, caltrops, foliage, and so on) affect the suli normally.

alternateTraits.name: Firehand (fire)
alternateTraits.description: Instead of adding damage to a melee attack, the suli may hurl a piece of her arm-flames as if it were a thrown weapon. The suli makes a ranged touch attack; if the attack hits, the target takes 1d6 points of fire damage. The flames have a range increment of 10 feet.

alternateTraits.name: Icewalk (cold)
alternateTraits.description: The suli can walk on water-based liquids as if using water walk, except instead of hovering above the surface, she creates a temporary layer of ice that supports her and immediately melts once she moves away from it. This ice is not slippery to the suli and does not affect her balance or speed, though other ice affects her normally. Other creatures cannot travel on this ice, but the suli may carry a creature while moving.

alternateTraits.name: Shockshield (electricity)
alternateTraits.description: Once per round as an immediate action, the suli can shock a creature that touches or attacks her with a natural attack, unarmed strike, or metal melee weapon, dealing 1d6 points of electricity damage to the creature.

alternateTraits.name: Mostly Human
alternateTraits.description: A few sulis have appearances much closer to those of their human ancestors; in fact, they may not even realize their true race. Such geniekin appear to be human, save perhaps minor features like unusual eye color, and they count as humanoid (human) as well as outsider (native) for all purposes (such as humanoid-affecting spells such as charm person or enlarge person). These geniekin do not automatically gain their associated elemental language (but may select it as a bonus language if their Intelligence is high enough). This ability alters the geniekin's type, subtype, and languages.

alternateTraits.name: Trusted Mediator
alternateTraits.description: Sulis are renowned as impartial mediators, and they learn to shroud their minds to prevent magic from tampering with their judgments. They gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects. This racial trait replaces energy resistance and low-light vision.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add +1/4 point to the magus's arcane pool.
Add +1/2 point of damage to elemental assault.
Add +1 to acid resistance, cold resistance, electricity resistance, or fire resistance.
Elemental Knight (Magus)

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: Tengus are fast and observant, but relatively fragile and delicate. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, -2 Constitution.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Tengus are humanoids with the tengu subtype.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Tengus are Medium creatures and receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Speed
standardTraits.description: Tengus have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Tengus begin play speaking Common and Tengu. Tengus with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want (except for secret languages, such as Druidic). See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Sneaky
standardTraits.description: Tengus gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception and Stealth checks.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Perception and Stealth checks.

standardTraits.name: Gifted Linguist
standardTraits.description: Tengus gain a +4 racial bonus on Linguistics checks, and learn 2 languages each time they gain a rank in Linguistics rather than 1 language.

effects.sourceText: +4 racial bonus on Linguistics checks, and learn 2 languages each time they gain a rank in Linguistics rather than 1 language.

standardTraits.name: Swordtrained
standardTraits.description: Tengus are trained from birth in swordplay, and as a result are automatically proficient with sword-like weapons (including bastard swords, daggers, elven curve blades, falchions, greatswords, kukris, longswords, punching daggers, rapiers, scimitars, short swords, and two-bladed swords).

standardTraits.name: Natural Weapons
standardTraits.description: A tengu has a bite attack that deals 1d3 points of damage.

standardTraits.name: Senses
standardTraits.description: Tengus have low-light vision allowing them to see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

alternateTraits.name: Carrion Sense
alternateTraits.description: Many tengus have a natural ability to sniff out carrion. While their sense of smell isn't as keen as that of other species, it is particularly attuned to the scent of injuries or death. Tengus with this racial trait have a limited scent ability, which only functions for corpses and badly wounded creatures (50% or fewer hit points). This racial trait replaces gifted linguist.

alternateTraits.name: Claw Attack
alternateTraits.description: Tengus with this racial trait have learned to use their claws as natural weapons. They gain two claw attacks as primary natural attacks that deal 1d3 points of damage, and are treated as having the Improved Unarmed Strike feat for the purpose of qualifying for other feats. This racial trait replaces swordtrained.

alternateTraits.name: Deft Swords
alternateTraits.description: Some tengu learn dazzling blade techniques that allow them to use their weapons to protect against combat maneuvers. They gain a +2 dodge bonus to CMD while wielding a swordlike weapon. This racial trait replaces natural weapon and sneaky.

effects.sourceText: +2 dodge bonus to CMD while wielding a swordlike weapon.

alternateTraits.name: Exotic Weapon Training
alternateTraits.description: Instead of swords, some tengus are trained in exotic weaponry. Such tengus choose a number of eastern weapons equal to 3 + their Intelligence bonus, and gain proficiency with these weapons. This racial trait replaces swordtrained.

alternateTraits.name: Glide
alternateTraits.description: Some tengus can use their feathered arms and legs to glide. Tengus with this racial trait can make a DC 15 Fly check to fall safely from any height without taking falling damage, as if using feather fall. When falling safely, a tengu may make an additional DC 15 Fly check to glide, moving 5 feet laterally for every 20 feet he falls. This racial trait replaces gifted linguist.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add +1/3 to the bonus from the superstitious rage power.
Add +1 to the fighter's CMD when resisting a grapple or trip attempt.
Add +1/4 point to the monk's ki pool.
Add +1/2 to the oracle's level for the purpose of determining the effects of the oracle's curse ability.

Choose a weapon from those listed under the tengu's swordtrained ability. Add a +1/2 bonus on critical hit confirmation rolls with that weapon (maximum bonus +4). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.

Select one bloodline power at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + the sorcerer's Charisma modifier. The sorcerer adds +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that bloodline power.

Add one spell from the witch spell list to the witch's familiar. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level she can cast. If the witch ever replaces her familiar, the new familiar knows these bonus spells.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Tieflings are quick in body and mind, but are inherently strange and unnerving. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, and -2 Charisma.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Tieflings are outsiders with the native subtype.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Tieflings are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Speed
standardTraits.description: Tieflings have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Tieflings begin play speaking Common and either Abyssal or Infernal. Tieflings with high intelligence scores can choose from the following: Abyssal, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Goblin, Halfling, Infernal, and Orc. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Fiendish Resistance
standardTraits.description: Tieflings have cold resistance 5, electricity resistance 5, and fire resistance 5.

effects.sourceText: cold resistance 5
electricity resistance 5
fire resistance 5

standardTraits.name: Skilled
standardTraits.description: Tieflings gain a +2 racial bonus on Bluff and Stealth checks.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Bluff and Stealth checks.

standardTraits.name: Spell-like ability
standardTraits.description: Tieflings can use darkness once per day as a spell-like ability. The caster level for this ability equals the tiefling's class level.

standardTraits.name: Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Tieflings can see perfectly in the dark for up to 60 feet.

standardTraits.name: Fiendish Sorcery
standardTraits.description: Tiefling sorcerers with the Abyssal or Infernal bloodlines treat their Charisma score as 2 points higher for all sorcerer class abilities.

alternateTraits.name: Beguiling Liar
alternateTraits.description: Many tieflings find that the best way to get along in the world is to tell others what they want to hear. These tieflings' practice of telling habitual falsehoods grants them a +4 racial bonus on Bluff checks to convince an opponent that what they are saying is true when they tell a lie. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.sourceText: +4 racial bonus on Bluff checks to convince an opponent that what they are saying is true when they tell a lie.

alternateTraits.name: Bullying
alternateTraits.description: Tieflings are often disparaged and kept low in the social order, where they commonly resort to robbing those weaker than themselves. Tieflings with this racial trait gain a +1 racial bonus on combat maneuver checks to disarm or steal. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus on combat maneuver checks to disarm or steal.

alternateTraits.name: Fiendish Sprinter
alternateTraits.description: Some tieflings have feet that are more bestial than human. Whether their feet resemble those of a clawed predator or are the cloven hooves common to many of their kind, tieflings with this trait gain a 10-foot racial bonus to their speed when using the charge, run, or withdraw actions. This racial trait replaces skilled.

alternateTraits.name: Light from the Darkness
alternateTraits.description: Tieflings who deny the evil of their heritage to go on to become heroes refuse to use the dark magic of their blood, but their struggle grants them uncanny resilience against evil's touch. As long as they retain a good alignment, they gain the aasimar's incorruptible alternate racial trait. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

alternateTraits.name: Maw or Claw
alternateTraits.description: Some tieflings take on the more bestial aspects of their fiendish ancestors. These tieflings exhibit either powerful, toothy maws or dangerous claws. The tiefling can choose a bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage or two claws that each deal 1d4 points of damage. These attacks are primary natural attacks. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability racial trait.

alternateTraits.name: Pass for Human
alternateTraits.description: Discrimination against tieflings with horrifically fiendish features is so intense that even tieflings look up to those precious few of their kind who can pass as human. These tieflings have otherworldly features that are so subtle, they aren't often noticed unless the tiefling points them out (for example, eyes that flash red in the throes of passion, or fingernails that are naturally hard and pointed). Such a tiefling doesn't need to succeed at a Disguise check to appear to be human and count as humanoid (human) as well as outsider (native) for all purposes (such as humanoid-affecting spells like charm person or enlarge person). The tiefling does not automatically gain his associated outsider language (but may select it as a bonus language if his Intelligence score is high enough), and he may not select other racial traits that would grant him obviously fiendish features (such as the fiendish sprinter, maw or claw, prehensile tail, scaled skin, or vestigial wings alternate racial traits). This ability alters the tiefling's type, subtype, and languages.

alternateTraits.name: Prehensile Tail
alternateTraits.description: Many tieflings have tails, but some have long, flexible tails that can be used to carry items. While they cannot wield weapons with their tails, they can use them to retrieve small, stowed objects carried on their persons as a swift action. This racial trait replaces fiendish sorcery.

alternateTraits.name: Scaled Skin
alternateTraits.description: The skin of these tieflings provides some energy resistance, but is also as hard as armor. Choose one of the following energy types: cold, electricity, or fire. A tiefling with this trait gains resistance 5 in the chosen energy type and also gains a +1 natural armor bonus to AC. This racial trait replaces fiendish resistance.

effects.sourceText: +1 natural armor bonus to AC.

alternateTraits.name: Smite Good
alternateTraits.description: Once per day, a tiefling with this racial trait can smite a good-aligned creature. As a swift action, the tiefling chooses one target within sight to smite. If this target is good, the tiefling adds her Charisma bonus (if any) to attack rolls against the target and gains a bonus on damage rolls against the target equal to her number of Hit Dice. This effect lasts until the first time the tiefling successfully hits her designated target. This racial trait replaces fiendish sorcery and the tiefling's spell-like ability.

alternateTraits.name: Soul Seer
alternateTraits.description: Rare tieflings have a peculiar sight that allows them to see the state of a creature's soul. They can use deathwatch at will as spell-like ability. This racial trait replaces the spell-like ability and fiendish sorcery racial traits.

alternateTraits.name: Underworld Guide (2 RP)
alternateTraits.description: Those who brave the lightless tunnels below the world's surface learn to identify the dangerous phenomena that characterize the Underworld. Characters with this trait gain a +2 bonus on initiative checks, and on saves against traps and hazards when underground (from a lifetime of dodging accursed pools, cave-ins, and green slime). Tieflings can take this trait in place of the darkness spell-like ability.

effects.appliesWhen: against traps and hazards when underground (from a lifetime of dodging accursed pools, cave-ins, and green slime)
effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on initiative checks, and on saves against traps and hazards when underground (from a lifetime of dodging accursed pools, cave-ins, and green slime).

alternateTraits.name: Vestigial Wings
alternateTraits.description: Some tieflings possess a pair of undersized, withered, or stunted wings like a mockery of those of their fiendish forbearer. Sometimes these wings are leathery, like those of a bat. Other times they are covered with a scattering of black, red, or violet feathers. Rare manifestations can take even more bizarre forms. These wings do not provide the lift required for actual flight, but do have enough power to aid flight attained by some other method, and grant a +4 racial bonus on Fly skill checks. This racial trait replaces skilled.

effects.sourceText: +4 racial bonus on Fly skill checks.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add +1/2 to the alchemist's bomb damage.
Add a +1 bonus on caster level checks made to overcome the spell resistance of outsiders.
Add a +1 bonus on wild empathy checks made to improve the attitude of fiendish animals.
Add a +1/2 bonus on Intimidate checks and Knowledge checks to identify creatures.
Add +1/4 point to the magus's arcane pool.
Add +1 to the amount of damage the paladin heals with lay on hands, but only when the paladin uses that ability on herself.
Add +1/2 to sneak attack damage dealt to creatures with the outsider type.

Add +1/2 to the number of times per day a sorcerer can use the corrupting touch infernal bloodline power, or +1 to the total number of rounds per day the sorcerer can use the claws abyssal bloodline power. The sorcerer must possess the applicable power to select these bonuses.
Add +1 hit point or +1 skill rank to the summoner's eidolon.

The witch's familiar gains resistance 1 against cold, electricity, or fire. Each time the witch selects this reward, increase the familiar's resistance to one of these energy types by 1 (maximum 5 for any one type). If the witch ever replaces her familiar, the new familiar has these resistances.

Select one arcane school power at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + the wizard's Intelligence modifier. The wizard adds +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that arcane school power.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Vishkanyas are graceful and elegant, but they are often irrational. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, and -2 Wisdom.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Vishkanyas are humanoids with the vishkanya subtype.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Vishkanyas are Medium creatures and thus have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Vishkanyas have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Vishkanyas begin play speaking Common and Vishkanya. Vishkanyas with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aklo, Draconic, Elven, Goblin, Sylvan, and Undercommon. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Poison Resistance
standardTraits.description: A vishkanya has a racial bonus on saving throws against poison equal to its Hit Dice.

standardTraits.name: Keen Senses
standardTraits.description: Vishkanyas receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

standardTraits.name: Limber
standardTraits.description: Vishkanyas receive a +2 racial bonus on Escape Artist and Stealth checks.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Escape Artist and Stealth checks.

standardTraits.name: Low-Light Vision
standardTraits.description: Vishkanyas can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

standardTraits.name: Poison Use
standardTraits.description: Vishkanyas are skilled in the use of poison and never accidentally poison themselves when using or applying poison.

standardTraits.name: Toxic
standardTraits.description: A number of times per day equal to his Constitution modifier (minimum 1/day), a vishkanya can envenom a weapon that he wields with his toxic saliva or blood (using blood requires the vishkanya to be injured when he uses this ability). Applying venom in this way is a swift action. Vishkanya Venom: Injury; save Fort DC 10 + 1/2 the vishkanya's Hit Dice + the vishkanya's Constitution modifier; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Dex; cure 1 save.

standardTraits.name: Weapon Familiarity
standardTraits.description: Vishkanyas are always proficient with blowguns, kukri, and shuriken.

alternateTraits.name: Deceptive
alternateTraits.description: Vishkanya clans that make their livings robbing or killing humans train to distract targets at critical moments. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Bluff checks. This racial trait replaces the racial bonus on Escape Artist checks.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Bluff checks.

alternateTraits.name: Sensual
alternateTraits.description: You are trained in drawing attention to yourself. You gain a +2 bonus on any one Perform skill. This racial trait replaces keen senses.

effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on any one Perform skill.

alternateTraits.name: Subtle Appearance
alternateTraits.description: You have normal (human-like) eyes, and your beauty is more conventional. You gain a +4 bonus on Disguise checks to look fully human. This racial trait replaces low-light vision.

effects.sourceText: +4 bonus on Disguise checks to look fully human.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add +1 to the bard's total number of bardic performance rounds per day.
Add +1 to the rogue's CMD when resisting a grapple or reposition attempt.

Select one bloodline power at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + the sorcerer's Charisma modifier. The sorcerer adds +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that bloodline power.

standardTraits.description: Standard (+2 Dex, +2 Int, -2 Cha) (0 RP)

standardTraits.description: Construct (20 RP)

standardTraits.name: Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Wyrwoods have darkvision and so can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

standardTraits.name: Low-Light Vision
standardTraits.description: Wyrwood can see twice as far as humans in dim light (they have low-light vision). (0 RP)

alternateTraits.name: Experimental Body
alternateTraits.description: Some wyrwoods have been built from rare materials in an effort to imbue them with special properties. Choose one of the following abilities. This replaces darkvision and low-light vision. Wyrwoods with this trait can use divine favor once per day as a spell-like ability with a caster level equal to their Hit Dice.

alternateTraits.name: Enchanted
alternateTraits.description: Crafted from the remnants of broken staves, wands and other items, these wyrwoods have a natural attunement to the arcane. Wyrwoods with this trait treat their Intelligence score as 2 higher for the purpose of determining bonus spells or extracts per day.

alternateTraits.name: Fey-Touched
alternateTraits.description: These wyrwoods have components that create a powerful link to the First World. Wyrwoods with this trait can use charm animal once per day as a spell-like ability with a caster level equal to their Hit Dice

alternateTraits.name: Scorched
alternateTraits.description: These wyrwoods are built from the ruins of cities and structures destroyed by conflict. Once per day, after a successful melee attack against an enemy, wyrwoods with this trait can deal an additional number of points of damage equal to their Wisdom modifier as a free action.

alternateTraits.name: Living Machine
alternateTraits.description: Through generations of refining the techniques of creation, many young wyrwoods have become closer to organic beings than constructs. These wyrwoods are constructs with the living machine subtype. They gain a Constitution score and can be targeted by spells and effects that target living creatures or constructs, as well as those that require a Fortitude save. They are no longer immune to ability damage, ability drain, energy drain, exhaustion, or fatigue. Wyrwoods with this trait require sleep, but they do not need to breathe or eat. They are not destroyed when reduced to 0 hit points, instead becoming unconscious and stable. They are destroyed when reduced to a negative number of hit points equal to their Constitution score. They can be raised or resurrected when destroyed. This alters the wyrwood's creature type.

alternateTraits.name: Repair Magic
alternateTraits.description: Some wyrwoods have developed magic to keep them more self-sufficient. They can use make whole as a spell-like ability once per day. This racial trait replaces darkvision.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Reduce the mental ability score penalty of the alchemist's mutagens by 1/5 (minimum 0).
Add 1/4 to the arcanist's level for the spell resistance exploit.
Add 1/4 to the cleric's caster level when casting spells or using abilities from the Law domain or one of its subdomains, or when casting spells with the lawful descriptor.
Add 2 rounds to the duration of the magus' arcane pool enhancements.

Add one spell known from the wizard's evocation school spell list. This spell must be at least 1 level below the highest-level spell the oracle can cast. That spell is treated as 1 level higher unless it is also on the oracle spell list.
The paladin gains 1/4 of a bonus spell per day of the highest-level spell that the paladin can cast.
The psychic gains 1/6 of a phrenic amplification.
The rogue gains 1/6 of a rogue talent.
The slayer gains 1/6 of a slayer talent.
The wizard gains 1/6 of a bonus item creation, metamagic, or spell mastery feat.

standardTraits.description: Standard (+2 Dex, -2 Int, +2 Wis) (0 RP)

standardTraits.name: Fly
standardTraits.description: Wyvaran have a fly speed of 30 ft. (clumsy maneuverability) (4 RP)

standardTraits.name: Natural Attacks
standardTraits.description: Slapping tail (3 RP)

standardTraits.name: Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Wyvarans have darkvision and so can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

standardTraits.name: Low-Light Vision
standardTraits.description: Wyvaran can see twice as far as humans in dim light (they have low-light vision). (0 RP)

alternateTraits.name: Evasive Maneuvers
alternateTraits.description: Coastal wyvarans often take to the air to defend their territory from intruding ships, and are forced to learn aerial maneuvers to avoid siege fire. They fly with an average maneuverability instead of clumsy, and they gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC and on Reflex saving throws against siege weapons. This racial trait replaces darkvision and slapping tail.

effects.sourceText: +2 dodge bonus to AC and on Reflex saving throws against siege weapons.

alternateTraits.name: Memories of the Forgotten
alternateTraits.description: Generations of wyvaran elders pass down tales that predate written history. While many ignore these or dismiss them as simple stories, others revere the lore of their elders. These wyvarans consider it their sacred duty to study the lost histories and pass them down to others. They gain a +2 racial bonus on two Knowledge skills of their choice. Those Knowledge skills are class skills for them. This racial trait replaces flight.

alternateTraits.name: Vestigial Wings
alternateTraits.description: When resources are particularly scarce, some young wyvarans develop smaller-than-average wings incapable of flight. However, these wings are perfectly suited for other acrobatic maneuvers. These wyvarans gain a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics and Climb checks, and one of these is a class skill for them. In addition, they can ignore the first 20 feet of falling damage when they make a successful Acrobatics check. This racial trait replaces flight.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics and Climb checks, and one of these is a class skill for them.

alternateTraits.name: Neglected Heritage
alternateTraits.description: Because of their dwindling population and cultural stagnation, some wyvarans have given up on their people, favoring a life among other races instead. These wyvarans lose Draconic as a starting language, but gain a +1 racial bonus on Diplomacy checks when making requests and gathering information. They can't take Draconic as a bonus language, but can learn it normally with Linguistics. This ability alters the wyvaran's languages.

effects.appliesWhen: when making requests and gathering information
effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus on Diplomacy checks when making requests and gathering information.

alternateTraits.name: Greed
alternateTraits.description: Most wyvarans crave treasure, but for some, amassing wealth is a compulsion. Wyvarans with this trait gain a +2 on racial bonus on Appraise checks, and Appraise is a class skill for them. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Sleight of Hand checks when attempting to take items from other creatures. They can also use their tails to attempt these Sleight of Hand checks. This racial trait replaces slapping tail.

effects.sourceText: +2 on racial bonus on Appraise checks, and Appraise is a class skill for them.

effects.appliesWhen: when attempting to take items from other creatures
effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Sleight of Hand checks when attempting to take items from other creatures.

races.defensiveTraits: +2 AC, +2 to all saving throws, spell resistance
races.name: Svirfneblin

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin are fast and observant but relatively weak and emotionally distant. They gain -2 Strength, +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, and -4 Charisma.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin are humanoids with the gnome subtype.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin are Small creatures and thus gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty to their CMB and CMD, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

effects.sourceText: +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty to their CMB and CMD, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

standardTraits.name: Speed
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin have a base speed of 20 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin begin play speaking Gnome and Undercommon. Those with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aklo, Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Goblin, Orc, and Terran. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Defensive Training
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin gain a +2 dodge bonus to Armor Class.

effects.sourceText: +2 dodge bonus to Armor Class.

standardTraits.name: Fortunate
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin gain a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on all saving throws.

standardTraits.name: Spell Resistance
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin have spell resistance (SR) equal to 11 + their class levels.

standardTraits.name: Skills
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin gain a +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks; this improves to a +4 bonus underground. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks and Perception checks.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks;
+2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks and Perception checks.

standardTraits.name: Stonecunning
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin gain stonecunning (as dwarves.)

standardTraits.name: Svirfneblin Magic
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin add +1 to the DC of any illusion spells they cast. Svirfneblin also gain the following spell-like abilities: Constant-nondetection; 1/day-blindness/deafness (DC 12 + Charisma modifier), blur, disguise self; caster level equals the svirfneblin's class levels.

standardTraits.name: Hatred
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin receive a +1 bonus on attack rolls against humanoid creatures of the reptilian and dwarf subtypes due to training against these hated foes.

effects.appliesWhen: against humanoid creatures of the reptilian and dwarf subtypes due to training against these hated foes
effects.sourceText: +1 bonus on attack rolls against humanoid creatures of the reptilian and dwarf subtypes due to training against these hated foes.

standardTraits.name: Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Svirfneblin can see perfectly in the dark up to 120 feet.

standardTraits.name: Low-Light Vision
standardTraits.description: In addition to their ability to see perfectly in the dark up to 60 ft, svirfneblin have low-light vision, allowing them to see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

alternateTraits.name: Healthy
alternateTraits.description: Svirfneblin gain a +4 bonus on Fortitude saves against disease and poison, including magical diseases. This racial trait replaces fortunate.

effects.appliesWhen: against disease and poison, including magical diseases
effects.sourceText: +4 bonus on Fortitude saves against disease and poison, including magical diseases.

alternateTraits.name: Stalwart Watcher
alternateTraits.description: Some svirfneblin seek to thwart the schemes of evil fey. Those who still keep to this mission gain a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against fey creatures and a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects. This racial trait replaces hatred and skilled.

effects.appliesWhen: against fey creatures and a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects
effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against fey creatures and a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects.

alternateTraits.name: Stoneseer
alternateTraits.description: Svirfneblin add +1 to the caster level of any spells with the earth descriptor they cast. Svirfneblin also gain the following spell-like abilities: Constant-nondetection; 1/day-magic stone, stone shape, stone tell; caster level equals the svirfneblin's class levels. This racial trait replaces Svirfneblin magic.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add one extract formula from the alchemist's list to the alchemist's formula book. This formula must be at least one level below the highest formula level the alchemist can create.
Add one spell known from the oracle spell list. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level the oracle can cast.

Add DR 1/magic to the ranger's animal companion. Each additional time the ranger selects this benefit, the DR/magic increases +1/2 (maximum DR 10/magic). If the ranger ever replaces his animal companion, the new companion gains this DR.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: Drow are nimble and manipulative. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, and -2 Constitution.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Drow are humanoids with the elf subtype.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Drow are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Drow have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Weapon Familiarity
standardTraits.description: Drow are proficient with the hand crossbow, rapier, and shortsword.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Drow begin play speaking Elven and Undercommon. Drow with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Abyssal, Aklo, Aquan, Common, Draconic, Drow Sign Language, Gnome, or Goblin. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Immunities
standardTraits.description: Drow are immune to magic sleep effects and gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells and effects.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells and effects.

standardTraits.name: Spell Resistance
standardTraits.description: Drow possess spell resistance (SR) equal to 6 plus their total number of class levels.

standardTraits.name: Keen Senses
standardTraits.description: - Drow gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

standardTraits.name: Spell-Like Abilities (Su)
standardTraits.description: Drow can cast dancing lights, darkness, and faerie fire, once each per day, using their total character level as caster level.

standardTraits.name: Poison Use
standardTraits.description: Drow are skilled in the use of poisons and never risk accidentally poisoning themselves.

standardTraits.name: Superior Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Drow have superior darkvision, allowing them to see perfectly in the dark up to 120 feet.

standardTraits.name: Light Blindness
standardTraits.description: As deep underground dwellers naturally, drow suffer from light blindness. Abrupt exposure to any bright light blinds drow for 1 round. On subsequent rounds, they are dazzled as long as they remain in the affected area.

alternateTraits.name: Ambitious Schemer
alternateTraits.description: Seduction and treachery are tools for advancement in drow society, even for the martially inclined. Drow with this racial trait may choose either Bluff or Diplomacy as a class skill, and gain a +2 bonus on such skill checks. This racial trait replaces keen senses.

effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on such skill checks.

alternateTraits.name: Ancestral Grudge
alternateTraits.description: The enmity between the drow and elves and dwarves is long-standing and deeply entrenched. Drow with this racial trait gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls against humanoids with the dwarf or elf subtypes (with the exception of drow) because of their special training against these reviled foes. This racial trait replaces poison use.

effects.appliesWhen: against humanoids with the dwarf or elf subtypes (with the exception of drow) because of their special training against these reviled foes
effects.sourceText: +1 bonus on attack rolls against humanoids with the dwarf or elf subtypes (with the exception of drow) because of their special training against these reviled foes.

alternateTraits.name: Blasphemous Covenant
alternateTraits.description: Since their twisted beginnings, the drow have consorted with demons. Some drow have strong ties with these creatures and may call upon ancient and obscene associations to sway demonic cooperation. Drow with this racial trait gain a +2 bonus on Diplomacy checks made against unbound creatures with the demon subtype. Furthermore, demons conjured with any summon spell gain +2 hit points per Hit Die. Lastly, the cost of bribes or offerings for any planar ally spell cast by these drow to summon a demon is reduced by 20%. This racial trait replaces keen senses and poison use.

effects.appliesWhen: against unbound creatures with the demon subtype
effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on Diplomacy checks made against unbound creatures with the demon subtype.

alternateTraits.name: Champion of Dark Powers
alternateTraits.description: Some drow offer themselves to dark patrons, particularly demon lords. Drow with this racial trait apply their spell resistance only against spells with the good or healing descriptor or against spells cast by a divine spellcaster who worships a good-aligned deity. Anytime a drow with this racial trait casts a spell with the evil descriptor, the DC to resist the spell's effects increases by 2. This modifies the spell resistance racial trait.

alternateTraits.name: Defensive Training
alternateTraits.description: Many drow cities are frequently beset by attacks from aberrations, prompting the residents train themselves to defend against them. Drow gain a +4 dodge bonus to AC against aberrations. This racial trait replaces drow immunities, keen senses, and poison use.

effects.sourceText: +4 dodge bonus to AC against aberrations.

alternateTraits.name: Poison Minion (4 RP)
alternateTraits.description: Drow sometimes augment their slaves and frontline warriors by making them toxic, causing their bodies to internally produce mawbane poison (see below). The resulting poisonous creature makes a potent weapon in the effort to discourage neighboring monsters. Any creature that hits such a character with a bite attack is immediately exposed to its poison. The save DC for this poison is equal to 10 + 1/2 the character's Hit Dice + the character's Constitution modifier. Mawbane Poison-ingested; save Fortitude as above; frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect 1d2 Constitution damage; cure 1 save. Drow can take this trait in place of drow immunities, light blindness, spell resistance, and weapon familiarity.

alternateTraits.name: Seducer
alternateTraits.description: Certain drow possess an innate understanding of the darkest desires that lurk in every heart. Drow with this racial trait add +1 to the saving throw DCs for spells and spell-like abilities of the enchantment school. In addition, drow with a Wisdom score of 15 or higher may use charm person once per day as a spell-like ability (caster level equal to the drow's character level). This racial trait replaces drow immunities.

alternateTraits.name: Stalker
alternateTraits.description: The lands outside of drow cities, from rough-hewn tunnels to rocky caverns, are treacherous to navigate. Drow with this racial trait may move through difficult terrain without penalty while underground. In addition, drow with a Dexterity of 13 or higher gain Nimble Moves as a bonus feat. This racial trait replaces the spell-like abilities racial trait.

alternateTraits.name: Sure Step (2 RP)
alternateTraits.description: Adventurers can spend their whole careers in the alleys and sewers of large cities or the tunnels of the Underworld. Characters with this trait suffer no movement penalties when blinded or moving in darkness. Drow can take this trait in place of keen senses.

alternateTraits.name: Surface Infiltrator
alternateTraits.description: Some drow dwell close to the surface lands, either because they serve drow causes or they were exiled. Drow with this racial trait gain low-light vision, allowing them to see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light. This racial trait replaces the darkvision and light blindness racial traits.

alternateTraits.name: Underworld Guide (2 RP)
alternateTraits.description: Those who brave the lightless tunnels below the world's surface learn to identify the dangerous phenomena that characterize the Underworld. Characters with this trait gain a +2 bonus on initiative checks, and on saves against traps and hazards when underground (from a lifetime of dodging accursed pools, cave-ins, and green slime). Drow can take this trait in place of keen senses.

effects.appliesWhen: against traps and hazards when underground (from a lifetime of dodging accursed pools, cave-ins, and green slime)
effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on initiative checks, and on saves against traps and hazards when underground (from a lifetime of dodging accursed pools, cave-ins, and green slime).

alternateTraits.name: Voice in the Darkness (2 RP)
alternateTraits.description: Prerequisite(s): Charisma 13+. Characters who practice coercion and intimidation in the Underworld or on the Shadow Plane learn to do so in dim light or no light at all. As long as they are in dim light or darker conditions, characters with this trait gain a +2 bonus on Intimidate and Stealth checks. Drow can take this trait in place of weapon familiarity.

effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on Intimidate and Stealth checks.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add +10 minutes to the duration of the alchemist's mutagens.
The antipaladin adds +1/4 to the number of cruelties he can inflict.

Select one domain power granted at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + the cleric's Wisdom modifier. The cleric adds +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that domain power.
Choose the disarm or reposition combat maneuver. Add +1/3 to the Fighter's CMB when attempting this maneuver (maximum bonus of +4).
Add a +1/2 bonus on Bluff checks to feint and pass secret messages.
Add one spell known from the sorcerer spell list. This spell must have the curse, evil, or pain descriptor, and be at least one level below the highest spell level the sorcerer can cast.

Select one arcane school power at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + the wizard's Intelligence modifier. The wizard adds +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that arcane school power.

standardTraits.description: Flexible (+2 Con, +2 Wis) (2 RP)

standardTraits.description: (3 RP) Driders gain spell resistance equal to 11 + their character level.

standardTraits.name: Natural Armor
standardTraits.description: Driders have a tough exoskeleton, granting them a +2 natural armor bonus.

standardTraits.name: Hard to Trip
standardTraits.description: Due to drider's 8 legs, they gain a racial bonus vs. trip attempts (see Quadruped below.)

standardTraits.name: Climb
standardTraits.description: Driders have a natural climb speed (2 RP) They have a climb speed of 20 feet, and gain a +8 racial bonus on Climb checks.

effects.sourceText: +8 racial bonus on Climb checks.

standardTraits.description: Driders have darkvision and so can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

standardTraits.description: Medium (0 RP)

standardTraits.description: Normal speed (0 RP)

standardTraits.description: Standard (0 RP)

standardTraits.name: Damage Reduction (10/magic) (6 RP)
standardTraits.description: Damage Reduction (10/magic) (6 RP)

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Aquatic elves are nimble, both in body and mind, but their form is frail. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, and -2 Constitution.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Aquatic elves are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Aquatic elves are Humanoids with the elf and aquatic subtypes. Creatures with the aquatic subtype can move in water without making Swim checks. Aquatic creatures always treat Swim as a class skill.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Aquatic elves have a base speed of 30 feet and a swim speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Aquatic elves begin play speaking Common and Elven. Elves with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Celestial, Draconic, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, and Sylvan. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Elven Immunities
standardTraits.description: Aquatic elves are immune to magic sleep effects and gain a +2 racial saving throw bonus against enchantment spells and effects.

standardTraits.name: Keen Senses
standardTraits.description: Aquatic elves receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

standardTraits.name: Elven Magic
standardTraits.description: Aquatic elves receive a +2 racial bonus on caster level checks made to overcome spell resistance. In addition, elves receive a +2 racial bonus on Spellcraft skill checks made to identify the properties of magic items.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Spellcraft skill checks made to identify the properties of magic items.

standardTraits.name: Weapon Familiarity
standardTraits.description: Aquatic elves are proficient with rapiers, short swords, tridents, and treat any weapon with the word "elven" in its name as a martial weapon.

standardTraits.name: Low-Light Vision
standardTraits.description: Aquatic elves can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

alternateTraits.name: Deep Sea Dweller
alternateTraits.description: Aquatic elves who live far beneath the surface have adapted to the inhospitable conditions of the ocean depths. Aquatic elves with this racial trait gain darkvision with a range of 60 feet and cold resistance 5. This racial trait replaces low-light vision and elven immunities.

effects.sourceText: cold resistance 5

alternateTraits.name: Surface Features
alternateTraits.description: Some aquatic elves appear almost indistinguishable from surface elves. Their coloring, height, and weight all suggest those of a surface elf, and the webbing between their digits is almost transparent. Aquatic elves with this racial trait gain a +4 bonus on Bluff and Disguise checks when attempting to pass themselves off as surface elves. This racial trait replaces keen senses.

effects.appliesWhen: when attempting to pass themselves off as surface elves
effects.sourceText: +4 bonus on Bluff and Disguise checks when attempting to pass themselves off as surface elves.

alternateTraits.name: Surfacer Antagonist
alternateTraits.description: Aquatic elves generally distrust humans, but for some, the suspicion has become festering hatred. Those who have lost loved ones to human aggression or have watched humans loot artifacts from venerated undersea ruins view all humans as enemies. Aquatic elves with this racial trait receive a +1 bonus on attack rolls against humans. This racial trait replaces elven magic.

effects.sourceText: +1 bonus on attack rolls against humans.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add 1/4 to the arcanist's caster level when casting spells with the water descriptor.
Add 1 skill rank to the cavalier's mount. If the cavalier ever replaces his mount, the new mount gains these bonus skill ranks.

Add 1 hit point to the druid's animal companion. If the druid ever replaces her animal companion, the new animal companion gains these bonus hit points. For a druid whose nature bond gives her a cleric domain, select one cleric domain power at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + the druid's Wisdom modifier. The druid adds 1/2 to the number of uses per day of that domain power.

Choose a weapon from the following list: rapier, short sword, trident, or any weapon with "elven" in its name. Gain a +1/2 bonus on critical hit confirmation rolls made while using that type of weapon (maximum bonus +4). This bonus does not stack with those gained through Critical Focus and similar effects.

Add one spell from the cleric, druid, or wizard spell list with the water descriptor to the magus's spellbook. This spell must be at least 1 level below the highest spell level he can cast. This spell is treated as 1 level higher unless it also appears on the magus spell list.
Choose a weapon from the following list: longbow, shortbow, or any weapon with "elven" in its name. Reduce the penalty on ranged attack rolls underwater made with this weapon by 1.
As long as the summoner's eidolon has a swim speed, add 5 feet to its swim speed (max +20 feet).
When casting a witch spell underwater, add 1/3 to the effective caster level of the spell for the purpose of determining the spell's duration.
Add 1 to the wizard's caster level check when attempting to cast a spell with the fire descriptor underwater.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Astomoi ever pursue enlightenment through self-denial and are psychically attuned to their surroundings, but their delicate bodies are more susceptible to the physical dangers of the world. They gain +2 Intelligence and +2 Wisdom but suffer -2 Constitution.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Astomoi are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Speed
standardTraits.description: Astomoi have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Astomoi begin play knowing Common, but as they have no mouths, they cannot speak. They have telepathy with a range of 100 feet. Astomoi with high Intelligence scores can choose any of the following languages: Abyssal, Aklo, Celestial, Elven, Gnome, Infernal, and Sylvan. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Scent
standardTraits.description: Astomoi have the scent special ability.

standardTraits.name: Telepathic Senses
standardTraits.description: Astomoi can't speak or see, but can mentally sense the area within 60 feet, as per darkvision, and can speak telepathically. An astomoi can't see anything beyond 60 feet. An astomoi must provide thought components for spells that normally require verbal components. It can use language-dependent abilities with its telepathy, but not abilities that depend on audible components.

standardTraits.name: Sensitive Breath
standardTraits.description: Astomoi take a -2 penalty on saving throws against disease and inhaled poisons.

standardTraits.name: Mouthless
standardTraits.description: Astomoi don't need to eat or drink to survive. Instead, they absorb the essence of food and drink; this consumes the nutrients of the meal as though it had been eaten, rendering the food useless to others. Astomoi consume potions and other ingested materials in the same fashion. Since they never actually ingest anything, they can't normally be exposed to ingested poisons.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Changelings are frail, but are clever and comely. They gain +2 Wisdom, +2 Charisma, -2 Constitution.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Changelings are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Changelings are humanoids with the changeling subtype.

standardTraits.name: Base Speed
standardTraits.description: Changelings have a base speed of 30 feet.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Changelings begin play speaking Common and the primary language of their host society. Changelings with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aklo, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Gnoll, Goblin, and Orc.

standardTraits.name: Natural Armor
standardTraits.description: Changelings have a +1 natural armor bonus.

standardTraits.name: Claws
standardTraits.description: Changelings' fingernails are hard and sharp, granting them two claw attacks (1d4 points of damage each).

standardTraits.name: Darkvision
standardTraits.description: Changelings see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

standardTraits.name: Hulking Changeling
standardTraits.description: (Annis Hag): The changeling gains a +1 racial bonus on melee damage.

standardTraits.name: Pyrophile
standardTraits.description: (Ash Hag): The changeling gains a +1 racial bonus on damage rolls when using spells with the fire descriptor. This bonus increases by 1 for every 4 levels the changeling has beyond 1st.

effects.appliesWhen: when using spells with the fire descriptor
effects.sourceText: +1 racial bonus on damage rolls when using spells with the fire descriptor.

standardTraits.name: Green Widow
standardTraits.description: (Green Hag): The changeling gains a +2 racial bonus on Bluff checks against creatures that are sexually attracted to her.

effects.appliesWhen: against creatures that are sexually attracted to her
effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on Bluff checks against creatures that are sexually attracted to her.

standardTraits.name: Sea Lungs
standardTraits.description: (Sea Hag): The changeling may hold her breath for a number of rounds equal to three times her Constitution before she risks drowning.

standardTraits.name: Gaze Blindness
standardTraits.description: (Mute Hag): The changeling gains a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against gaze attacks.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against gaze attacks.

standardTraits.name: Heartstone Heritor
standardTraits.description: (Night Hag): The changeling gains a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against disease.

effects.sourceText: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against disease.

standardTraits.name: Ice Climber
standardTraits.description: (Winter Hag): The changeling gains a +5 racial bonus on Climb checks on icy or slippery surfaces.

effects.sourceText: +5 racial bonus on Climb checks on icy or slippery surfaces.

standardTraits.name: Inscrutable
standardTraits.description: (Blood Hag): The Sense Motive check DC to gain a hunch about the changeling increases by 5.

standardTraits.name: Wind Breaker
standardTraits.description: (Storm Hag): The changeling is treated as two size categories larger for the purpose of resolving wind effects.

alternateTraits.name: Hag Magic
alternateTraits.description: Some changelings develop a gift for spellcasting instead of their mothers' overtly fearsome traits. A changeling with this trait displays one or more stark white streaks in her hair as a child. The DCs of any saving throws against enchantment spells she casts increase by 1, and if her Charisma score is 11 or higher, she also gains the following spell-like abilities, usable once per day each: dancing lights, detect magic, disguise self, and pass without trace. The caster level of these spell-like abilities is equal to the changeling's character level. The DC for these spell-like abilities is equal to 10 + the spell's level + the changeling's Charisma modifier. This racial trait replaces the claws and natural armor racial abilities.

alternateTraits.name: Hag Magic
alternateTraits.description: Some changelings have an innate talent for magic. They can choose one 1st- or 0-level spell from the witch spell list that does not have a material component costing more than 1 gp. They can use the chosen spell as a spell-like ability once per day if it is a 1st-level spell or three times per day if it is a 0-level spell (caster level equal to the changeling's character level). This racial trait replaces natural armor.

alternateTraits.name: Mist Child
alternateTraits.description: When the changeling has concealment or total concealment, the miss chance of attacks against her increases by 5%. This racial trait replaces hulking changeling.

alternateTraits.name: Object of Desire
alternateTraits.description: The changeling adds +1 to her caster level when casting charm person and charm monster. This replaces green widow.

alternateTraits.name: Ocean's Daughter
alternateTraits.description: The changeling gains a +1 trait bonus on Swim checks. She automatically succeeds at Swim checks made to avoid nonlethal damage from swimming. This racial trait replaces sea lungs.

effects.sourceText: +1 trait bonus on Swim checks.

alternateTraits.name: Witchborn
alternateTraits.description: Most changelings are talented witches. They gain a +2 bonus to Intelligence and Charisma instead of a +2 bonus to Wisdom and Charisma. This racial trait alters the changeling's racial ability score modifiers.

effects.sourceText: +2 bonus to Intelligence and Charisma instead of a +2 bonus to Wisdom and Charisma.

favoredClassBonuses.description: Add +1/2 to the oracle's level for the purpose of determining the effects of the oracle's curse ability.
The rogue gains 1/6 of a new rogue talent.

Add one spell from the witch spell list to the witch's familiar. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level she can cast. If the witch ever replaces her familiar, the new familiar knows these bonus spells.

standardTraits.name: Ability Score Modifiers
standardTraits.description: Deep one hybrids are hearty and devout, but tend to be somewhat slow and awkward in their movements. They gain +2 Constitution and +2 Wisdom but suffer -2 Dexterity.

standardTraits.name: Type
standardTraits.description: Deep One Hybrids are Humanoids with the Human and Deep One subtypes.

standardTraits.name: Size
standardTraits.description: Deep One Hybrids are Medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

standardTraits.name: Speed
standardTraits.description: A deep one hybrid's base speed is 20 feet, as it walks with a shuffling gait. A deep one hybrid has a swim speed of 30 feet, and gains a +8 racial bonus on all Swim checks.

effects.sourceText: +8 racial bonus on all Swim checks.

standardTraits.name: Languages
standardTraits.description: Deep one hybrids begin play speaking Aklo and Common. Hybrids with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Abyssal, Aquan, Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Gnome, Goblin, Halfling, Orc, and Undercommon. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.

standardTraits.name: Natural Armor
standardTraits.description: A deep one hybrid's thick skin and dense fatty tissues grant it a +1 natural armor bonus to AC.

effects.sourceText: +1 natural armor bonus to AC.

standardTraits.name: Final Change (Su)
standardTraits.category: Misc. Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: A deep one hybrid ages at the same rate as a half-orc. A mere 1d12 months after a deep one hybrid reaches venerable age (at 60 years old), it dies a painful, agonizing death, only to have its body transform into that of a mature deep one. This transformation functions as the reincarnate spell, with the newly formed deep one gaining the following modifications to its physical ability scores: +6 Strength, -2 Dexterity, and +6 Constitution.

standardTraits.name: Sea Longing (Ex)
standardTraits.category: Misc. Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: Every 24 hours a deep one hybrid spends in an area more than 10 miles from the sea, it must succeed at a DC 20 Will save or take 1 point of Wisdom drain.

standardTraits.name: Take to the Water (Ex)
standardTraits.category: Misc. Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: A deep one hybrid can hold its breath 10 times longer than a human can, and gains a +2 bonus on Initiative checks and Reflex saving throws while swimming.

effects.sourceText: +2 bonus on Initiative checks and Reflex saving throws while swimming.

standardTraits.name: Low-Light Vision
standardTraits.category: Senses Racial Traits
standardTraits.description: A deep one hybrid can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of dim light.
